papers.title: Abiotic Stressors and Infectious Disease in Aquaculture: Emerging Evidence for Environmental Contaminants as Hidden Disease Drivers
papers.authors: Hu, Yang; Gu, Bing‐nan; Shan, Li‐peng; Liu, Lei; Chen, Jiong
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Infectious disease in aquaculture is shaped by interactions among pathogens, hosts and the surrounding environment. Temperature, salinity and other physicochemical conditions are established modifiers of several aquatic diseases, whereas environmental contaminants have been studied predominantly for their direct toxic effects. Whether contaminant exposure also alters subsequent infection has received much less integrated attention. We critically evaluate evidence linking environmental contaminants with viral, bacterial and parasitic infections in aquatic animals, while using established physicochemical stressors as a reference framework. Direct challenge studies show that pesticides, persistent organic contaminants, microplastics, mycotoxins and other pollutants can alter pathogen replication, infection severity or infection‐associated mortality in specific host–pathogen systems. Several studies report altered infection outcomes after sublethal exposure despite limited or absent mortality, growth impairment or overt cytotoxicity before pathogen challenge. Pathogen challenge can therefore reveal functional effects of contaminant exposure that may be missed by conventional apical toxicity endpoints. However, the relationship is not uniform. Null, non‐monotonic and occasionally protective effects have also been reported, and most direct evidence remains confined to laboratory studies in fish and shrimp. Evidence for transmission, commercial production systems, molluscs and parasitic diseases is comparatively scarce. Environmental contaminants should therefore be regarded as context‐dependent modifiers of infectious‐disease risk rather than universal causes of disease outbreaks. Where contaminant‐associated susceptibility is demonstrated, disease control may need to address both the relevant contaminant exposure and the pathogen. This evidence supports exploring dual‐function interventions that restore or mitigate contaminant‐induced host dysfunction while directly inhibiting the pathogen.
papers.summary_cn: 本文系统评估了环境污染物作为水产养殖传染病隐性驱动因素的研究证据，以温度、盐度等理化胁迫因子为参照框架，梳理了污染物暴露对水生动物病毒、细菌及寄生虫感染的影响。直接攻毒实验表明，农药、持久性有机污染物、微塑料和霉菌毒素等可改变特定宿主-病原系统中的病原复制、感染严重程度或感染相关死亡率，且亚致死暴露在无明显毒性终点时仍可影响感染结局。然而该关系并不一致，无效应、非单调甚至保护性效应亦有报道，现有直接证据多局限于鱼虾的实验室研究，在传播途径、商业养殖系统、软体动物及寄生虫病方面证据相对匮乏。作者据此提出污染物应被视为传染病风险的语境依赖性调节因子而非暴发的普遍原因，并建议在证实污染物相关易感性的情形下探索兼顾宿主功能修复与病原直接抑制的双功能干预策略。

papers.title:
<scp>IUCN</scp>
                    Red List of Ecosystems Assessment of Tropical
                    <scp>Saccostrea</scp>
                    Oyster Reef Ecosystems in Queensland, Australia
papers.authors: Richardson, Marina A.; Traurig, Michael J.; Sievers, Michael; Nenadic, Nikolina; Waltham, Nathan J.; Gilby, Ben L.; McDougall, Carmel; Gillies, Chris L.; Connolly, Rod. M.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Tropical oyster reefs are ecologically important ecosystems that support significant ecosystem services across coastal seascapes. Yet their current distribution and conservation needs remain poorly understood, limiting the effectiveness of management. In tropical Queensland, Australia, historical oyster reef declines and current threats have not been evaluated within a standardised risk‐assessment framework. Here, we apply the IUCN Red List of Ecosystems (RLE) criteria to assess the conservation status of tropical eastern Australian Saccostrea (TEAS) reef ecosystems. We synthesised historical records, contemporary satellite imagery and field surveys to delineate TEAS reef ecosystem characteristics, define functional and collapsed states and quantify changes in distribution. Our analysis reveals a reduction in reef ecosystem occurrences since 1750, restricted contemporary distributions, pervasive environmental degradation driven by increased catchment modification and sediment loads and identifies ongoing climate change and declining water quality as continuing and persistent risks to their conservation. We conclude that TEAS reef ecosystems are Vulnerable to extinction under three of five criteria (A: reduction in geographic distribution, B: restricted geographic range and C: environmental degradation). Criterion D (disruption of biotic processes and interactions) and Criterion E (quantitative risk analysis) were Data Deficient and not assessed. Formal recognition of TEAS reefs within state and federal conservation frameworks, alongside integrated catchment management, climate‐adaptive restoration approaches and improved species‐level taxonomic resolution, is essential for safeguarding these ecosystems. This assessment establishes the first baseline conservation evaluation for tropical oyster reefs in the world and provides a foundation for future regional and international assessments.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次将IUCN Red List of Ecosystems (RLE) 标准应用于澳大利亚昆士兰热带Saccostrea牡蛎礁生态系统，综合历史记录、卫星影像和野外调查界定其生态系统特征、功能状态与崩溃状态，并量化分布变化。结果显示自1750年以来牡蛎礁生态系统发生范围缩减、现代分布受限，流域改造与泥沙负荷导致普遍环境退化，气候变化和水质下降构成持续风险。评估判定该生态系统在五项标准中的三项（A地理分布缩减、B地理范围受限、C环境退化）下属于Vulnerable，D和E标准因数据缺乏未予评估。研究呼吁将该礁体纳入州与联邦保护框架，并推进流域综合管理、气候适应性修复及物种级分类厘定。

papers.title: Governing Across Scales: A Multi-Level, Participatory Governance Framework for Recreational Fisheries Sustainability in Southern Chile
papers.authors: Figueroa Hernández, David Alejandro; Muñoz-Vera, Francisco Javier; Jerez Briones, Jorge; Aguayo Arias, Carlos; Escalona Ulloa, Miguel; Molina Lopez, Sebastian Alonso; Aguayo Arias, Miguel Ángel
papers.abstract: Environmental governance in socio-ecological systems requires coordination among actors and institutions operating across different territorial and administrative scales. This study develops a multi-level environmental governance framework for recreational fisheries in the Toltén River Basin, southern Chile. A mixed-methods case study combined a socioeconomic survey of 188 stakeholders, semi-structured interviews with public-sector representatives, and participatory workshops conducted across the basin. Quantitative and qualitative evidence were integrated to identify governance challenges, territorial priorities, stakeholder roles, and opportunities for institutional coordination. The results identified resource-use pressures alongside institutional fragmentation, limited inter-municipal coordination, weak organisational capacity, and the limited availability of permanent mechanisms for collective action. Participatory mapping identified 61 priority areas for recreational fisheries and 74 conflict hotspots, highlighting the spatial extent of these challenges beyond municipal boundaries. Based on these findings, a governance framework was structured around municipal, river basin, and regional scales, linking local priorities with basin-scale coordination and regional planning. The framework builds on existing municipal and regional coordination mechanisms, while proposing basin-level coordination as a subsequent stage to strengthen cross-municipal articulation. The study illustrates how participatory processes can inform the development of place-based, multi-level governance arrangements for complex river basin systems and provides a case-based contribution to the study of recreational fisheries governance in territorially fragmented socio-ecological contexts.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在为智利南部Toltén河流域的休闲渔业构建多层级环境治理框架。采用混合方法，结合188名利益相关者的社会经济调查、公共部门代表半结构化访谈及全流域参与式研讨会，识别治理挑战、地域优先事项与制度协调机会。结果揭示资源利用压力与制度碎片化并存，市际协调有限、组织能力薄弱且缺乏集体行动的常设机制；参与式制图识别出61个休闲渔业优先区和74个冲突热点，显示问题跨越市政边界。据此提出涵盖市政、流域和区域三个尺度的治理框架，以流域级协调作为强化跨市衔接的后续阶段。

papers.title: Decarbonizing Turkish Black Sea Commercial Fisheries Requires Pairing Industrial Engine-Power Limits with Capacity Reduction
papers.authors: Tunca, Sezgin
papers.journal: Turkish Journal of Maritime and Marine Sciences
papers.abstract: Commercial marine fisheries face growing pressure to cut carbon emissions while struggling with fleet overcapacity and volatile fuel prices. This study examines the Turkish Black Sea fleet (6584 vessels across 34 ports) by combining vessel registry records, long-run catch and cost accounts, hull-resistance estimates, port-level spatial patterns, fleet efficiency comparisons, and policy simulations. Registry data show that installed engine power is heavily concentrated in industrial purse seiners and trawlers, with nearly half of trawlers and one-fifth of purse seiners exceeding gear-specific power-to-tonnage reference ranges. Theoretical resistance estimates indicate that wave-making drag accounts for most hull resistance during free-running transit (58-79%) but becomes negligible during low-speed towing and net setting. Across the coast, vessel engine intensity clusters regionally, whereas total installed power is concentrated in major fishing ports. Financial accounts for 2023 show that fuel absorbs roughly one-fifth of gross revenue, leaving a 29.5% net margin after capital costs and exposing operators to sharp margin compression when diesel prices rise, while efficiency comparisons point to moderate room for emission reductions across regional fleet segments. Against a realistic operational baseline of 366.98 kt CO2 yr-1 (784.92 kt yr-1 at theoretical full capacity), a hypothetical policy combining a 441 kW active-gear engine-power limit with the retirement of vessels over 35 years old cuts projected emissions by 29.3% (107.55 kt CO2 yr-1, or 166.95 kt against the upper bound). Even so, retiring older vessels on its own barely shifts surviving-fleet profitability unless lower fleet crowding is assumed to improve catch rates. Long-run multi-basin records further show that broader catch diversity is associated with steadier revenues in smaller fleets, a relationship that weakens as vessel numbers grow.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于船舶登记、渔获与成本核算、船体阻力估算及政策模拟，分析土耳其黑海商业船队（6584艘、34个港口）的碳排放与产能问题。结果显示，工业围网船和拖网船的装机功率高度集中，约半数拖网船和五分之一围网船超出特定渔具的功率-吨位参考范围；2023年燃油约占总收入五分之一，净利率29.5%。模拟表明，将主动渔具功率限制在441 kW并淘汰35年以上船龄船舶，可在实际运营基线366.98 kt CO2 yr-1上减排29.3%，但仅淘汰老旧船舶对存活船队盈利能力影响有限，除非船队拥挤度下降提升捕捞率。

papers.title: Scientometric Analysis of Fisheries Cooperatives’ Research Landscape in India vis-a-vis the World (1941-2023)
papers.authors: Samatha, Beemalla; Argade, Shivaji; Ananthan, P. S.; Debnath, Sourav
papers.journal: Journal of Scientific Research and Reports
papers.abstract: Fisheries cooperatives are considered one of the most effective means of developing the fisheries sector and improving the living standards of poor fishermen. The current study maps research output on fisheries cooperatives during 1941–2023 using data retrieved from the Dimensions AI database, Google Scholar, and ResearchGate. A total of 310 publications were used for this investigation to evaluate the scientific productivity in the selected subject area. Thematic analysis was also used to review the global research landscape in fisheries cooperatives. Global publication shares, rankings and developments in research and bibliometric indices such as overall citations and average citation per paper were also analysed. In continent-specific publications, Asia ranked first (73.87%); in country-specific publications, Japan ranked first (26.13%), and within India, Kerala (20.59%) has the highest number. The journal Marine Policy (4.19%) carried the highest number of research papers. However, important gaps remain, particularly the under-representation of geographical regions. The thematic analysis revealed that studies predominantly focused on marine societies. Among all the studies, the principal areas of focus included the role of cooperatives and challenges (30.38%), socio-economic and financial analysis (29.75%), governance and management (26.58%), sustainability and conservation (7.59%), gender/women empowerment (3.48%), and technology integration (2.22%). Overall, this study highlights the importance of growth dynamics in fisheries cooperatives and identifies future research areas. These findings provide valuable insights for enhancing research efforts in this area, which may help improve the performance of these societies and support their development.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究基于Dimensions AI、Google Scholar和ResearchGate数据，对1941–2023年全球渔业合作社研究文献（310篇）进行科学计量分析，考察科研产出、引用指标与主题分布。结果显示亚洲占全球发文量73.87%居首，日本（26.13%）与印度喀拉拉邦（20.59%）分别为国家和区域最高，Marine Policy（4.19%）为载文最多期刊。主题分析表明研究集中于合作社作用与挑战（30.38%）、社会经济与财务分析（29.75%）、治理与管理（26.58%），而可持续性与保护、性别赋权和技术整合研究明显不足，地理区域代表性亦存在缺口。

papers.title: From Manual to Smart Fish Sorting: A Design Innovation Framework for Sustainable Aquaculture
papers.authors: Nik Sin, Nik Nurhusna; Tarmizu, Mohd Afiq Ridhwan; Wan Ahmad Nasir, Wan Isma Aiman; Rosli Sham, Muhammad Aiman Hanif; Zakaria, Muhammad Khairulanam
papers.journal: Journal of Art, Design and Creative Media
papers.abstract: Fish sorting is an important aquaculture management practice for controlling size variation, feeding competition, and production efficiency. Conventional mechanical grading methods remain relevant because of their operational simplicity and relatively low technological requirements. However, labor demands, repeated fish handling, and variations in grading performance highlight opportunities for design improvement. This conceptual study critically synthesizes eight purposively selected publications published between 2016 and 2026 to examine developments in mechanical grading, electronic sensing, automation, machine vision, artificial intelligence, and digital connectivity. A focused narrative review was conducted using five analytical dimensions: functionality, usability, affordability, adaptability, and sustainability. Based on the literature synthesis, the Mechanical–Sensing–Automation–Intelligence–Connectivity (MSAIC) framework is proposed as a modular, problem-oriented approach to fish sorting equipment innovation. Catfish Sorter Pro, an existing manually operated mechanical grading prototype, is used to illustrate the potential application of the framework and opportunities for selective technological integration. The synthesis suggests that technological sophistication should not be considered independently of operational requirements, implementation costs, maintenance accessibility, and fish welfare. The proposed framework provides a conceptual basis for selecting technological capabilities according to specific design problems and resource constraints. However, neither the framework's practical effectiveness nor the performance of the proposed technological upgrades has been empirically established. Future research should validate the framework through comparative prototype testing, user-centered evaluation, economic assessment, and fish welfare monitoring.
papers.summary_cn: 该概念研究通过聚焦式叙述性综述，从功能性、可用性、可负担性、适应性和可持续性五个维度综合分析了2016—2026年间8篇有关鱼类分级的研究文献，涵盖机械分级、电子传感、自动化、机器视觉、人工智能及数字互联等技术进展。基于此提出模块化、问题导向的 Mechanical–Sensing–Automation–Intelligence–Connectivity (MSAIC) 框架，用于指导鱼类分选设备创新，并以现有手动机械分级原型 Catfish Sorter Pro 示例说明选择性技术集成的应用潜力。研究强调技术先进性应与操作需求、实施成本、维护可及性及鱼类福利协同考量，但框架实效与所提技术升级的性能尚待实证验证，未来需通过原型对比测试、以用户为中心的评估、经济分析和鱼类福利监测加以检验。

papers.title: Fish Community Differences Revealed by Water and Sediment eDNA in Thermal-Discharge-Impacted Waters of the Hongyanhe Nuclear Power Plant
papers.authors: Zhao, Siyu; Wu, Nan; Yu, Jinghua; Liu, Sihan; Cui, Xiaoyu; Zheng, Nan; Yang, Jun; Zhang, Jinyong
papers.abstract: Thermal discharge from coastal nuclear power plants forms persistent temperature gradients in waters adjacent to outfalls, and is one of the typical anthropogenic disturbances in nearshore waters. However, whether fish community patterns under thermal discharge are consistent between water and sediment, and whether the two media provide complementary information, remain poorly understood. In October 2024, we collected water (n = 16) and sediment (n = 15) samples near the Hongyanhe Nuclear Power Plant, Liaodong Bay, and applied environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding to compare fish community composition and spatial patterns across media in near- and far-field zones. A total of 32 fish taxa were identified: 2 only in water, 6 only in sediment, and 24 in both media. α-Diversity calculated from OTU abundance data did not differ significantly among the four medium-zone groups, mean Shannon index was numerically higher in far-field water (1.64) than in near-field water (1.07), and Simpson index showed a similar non-significant trend. Water community similarity declined with both geographic and environmental distances (distance–decay pattern), and indicator taxon analysis identified Acanthopagrus schlegelii and Lateolabrax maculatus as near-field water indicators and Sardinella zunasi and Thryssa kammalensis as far-field water indicators. Sediment communities showed high within-group dispersion and no distance–decay pattern. PERMANOVA revealed a significant medium × zone interaction, indicating that near–far-field differences in fish community composition depended on sample medium. Water community structure was associated with seawater temperature, nitrate concentration, and salinity, whereas sediment community structure showed no significant associations with the measured environmental variables. Overall, water and sediment eDNA provided partially complementary information on fish detection; combined water–sediment sampling is recommended to broaden monitoring coverage. This single-survey study provides baseline data for multi-medium fish eDNA monitoring to support future management of thermal-discharge impacts.
papers.summary_cn: 以红沿河核电站温排水影响海域为对象，于2024年10月采集水体（n=16）和沉积物（n=15）样品，利用eDNA宏条形码比较近场与远场鱼类群落组成及空间格局。共鉴定32个鱼类分类单元，其中24个为水体和沉积物共有，α多样性与距离衰减格局主要体现在水体群落，沉积物群落组内离散度高且无距离衰减。PERMANOVA显示介质×区域交互作用显著，水体群落结构与水温、硝酸盐和盐度相关，沉积物群落与所测环境因子无显著关联。水体与沉积物eDNA提供部分互补信息，建议联合采样以拓展监测覆盖范围。

papers.title: Physiological, Reproductive, and Molecular Responses of Perna viridis to Aquaculture Wastewater Bioremediation
papers.authors: Noor, Zohaib; Tang, Yuchuan; Huang, Wei; Shi, Yaohua; Gu, Zhifeng
papers.abstract: Mussels are considered active biofilters that filter suspended and dissolved components of water and can be used in aquaculture. We studied the role of green mussels (Perna viridis) in filtering aquaculture effluent and its effects on gametogenesis and physiological processes. We established four experimental groups: G1, G2, G3, and G4. Groups G1 and G2 received fish-cultured wastewater and shrimp-cultured wastewater, respectively. Group G3 received low-nutrient seawater, whereas G4 served as a mussel-free control and received low-nutrient seawater under otherwise identical experimental conditions. The impact of biofiltration was evaluated by analyzing gonad morphology, gene expression, and physiological energetics. The results show a significant change in the gonadal structure, with low spermatozoa and spermatid content characterizing G1, and adipogranular cells becoming more prominent. G2 showed a comparatively high number of sperm cells, with spermatozoa becoming more prominent in the gonads. G3 is characterized by elevated sperm volume. CASA semen analysis showed low sperm counts and reduced motility and other kinematic parameters in G1 and G2. The Gonadosomatic Index (GSI) and Condition Index (CI) indicated better physiological condition in G2 and G3, with the highest survival rate in G2. Quantitative real-time PCR results revealed the expression of genes in the hepatopancreas, with high expression (p < 0.05) of Glutathione S-transferases (gst-o1), Heat shock protein 60 (hsp60), Heat shock protein 70 (hsp70), Nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NRF2), superoxide dismutase (SOD1), and a key sensor of oxidative and electrophilic stress-1 (KEAP1). Ammonia excretion was high in the G1 and G2 groups, and oxygen consumption was initially high in G1 and G2, later declining until the 21st day, while in G3 a stable trend was observed. Despite P. viridis’s positive role in bioremediation, aquaculture effluents negatively impact reproductive functions; moreover, P. viridis filtration augmented the decrease in nutrient content along with other abiotic components in the recirculating aquaculture in the G1 and G2 groups, confirming its role as a biofilter and helping with the reuse of aquaculture effluents.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨绿贻贝（Perna viridis）过滤养殖废水对配子发生及生理过程的影响，设置鱼类养殖废水、虾类养殖废水、低营养海水及无贻贝对照四组，通过性腺形态、基因表达和生理能量学评估生物过滤效果。结果显示，鱼废水组性腺结构显著改变、精子细胞减少，虾废水组精子细胞较多且生理状况与存活率最佳，但两处理组精子计数与活力均下降。qRT-PCR揭示肝胰腺中gst-o1、hsp60、hsp70、NRF2、SOD1和KEAP1显著高表达，氨排泄在养殖废水组升高。尽管P. viridis具有生物过滤与促进养殖废水回用的积极作用，养殖废水仍对其生殖功能产生负面影响。

papers.title: Premeiotic endoreplication as a meiotic rescue mechanism in hybrid teleosts: candidate molecular switches, polyploid engineering, and aquaculture applications
papers.authors: Sornchai, Karnjanapond; Saensong, Danurut; Panthum, Thitipong; Muangmai, Narongrit; Duengkae, Prateep; Cao, Xiaojuan; Gao, Jian; Singchat, Worapong; Srikulnath, Kornsorn
papers.journal: Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology
papers.abstract: Endoreplication is a conserved cell-cycle modification in which cells undergo repeated rounds of DNA replication without mitosis or cytokinesis, generating cellular polyploidy. This process contributes to cell growth, metabolic expansion, and developmental specialization across plants, invertebrates, and mammals. In teleost fish, whose genomes have been shaped by ancestral whole-genome duplications, endoreplication may have particular evolutionary significance. In hybrid fish systems characterized by genomic incompatibility, premeiotic endoreplication may serve as a meiotic rescue mechanism in some hybrid lineages that enables homologous chromosome pairing and circumvents hybrid sterility, as suggested by cytological evidence in female hybrid Clarias catfish ( Clarias macrocephalus × Clarias gariepinus ), where endoreplicated oocytes were observed in 12 of 372 pachytene cells (3.2%) and 45 of 142 diplotene cells (31.7%) from different females. This review synthesizes current knowledge on the molecular regulation of the endo-switch, for which suppression of Cyclin B/CDK1 and oscillatory Cyclin E/CDK2 activity are discussed as candidate regulatory features rather than an established Clarias mechanism, and discusses regulatory differences between pure endocycles and abortive endomitosis. We further evaluate approaches used to manipulate polyploidy in aquaculture, including physical shocks and chemical treatments used to induce polyploidy, while considering CRISPR/Cas9-based manipulation of CDK1 as an experimental functional approach rather than an established production method. Finally, we outline emerging multi-omics and artificial intelligence-based frameworks for predicting hybrid endoreplication potential and mitigating genomic instability, thereby bridging cell cycle regulation with precision aquaculture strategies. Collectively, these findings provide a mechanistic and applied framework that connects fundamental cell cycle mechanisms with the next-generation of polyploid-based aquaculture innovation.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述聚焦于杂交硬骨鱼中前减数分裂内复制（premeiotic endoreplication）作为减数分裂拯救机制的作用，以雌性杂交鲶鱼（Clarias macrocephalus × C. gariepinus）的细胞学证据为例（3.2%的粗线期细胞和31.7%的双线期细胞出现内复制卵母细胞），探讨了Cyclin B/CDK1抑制与Cyclin E/CDK2振荡活性作为内复制开关的候选调控特征。文章还评估了水产养殖中物理休克和化学处理诱导多倍体的方法，并将基于CRISPR/Cas9的CDK1操控定位为实验性功能研究手段。最后提出多组学与人工智能框架用于预测杂交内复制潜力及降低基因组不稳定性，为多倍体水产养殖创新提供机制与应用框架。

papers.title: Managing local legitimacy in aquaculture: an in-depth study from Arctic Norway
papers.authors: Bjørnå, Hilde
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以挪威北极地区水产养殖为案例，探讨地方合法性（local legitimacy）的管理问题，属于水产养殖社会治理范畴，与渔业管理及沿海社区发展相关。

papers.title: A Confounder-Aware Pre-Training Quality Control Workflow for Mechanically Scanned Sonar Echoes in Offshore Aquaculture Cages
papers.authors: Wan, Shujie; Song, Haopeng; Li, Guodong; Cheng, Jing; Yang, Hang; Wang, Zhijun; Zhang, Yutao
papers.journal: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
papers.abstract: Mechanically scanned sonar can support offshore aquaculture sensing, but acoustic candidate quality and biological identifiability must be evaluated before species modeling. We analyzed 70,421 frames from 22 records and 336 complete rotations acquired on one day in two cages, one per species. A historical top-20-per-rotation detector yielded 6647 candidates, of which 4801 passed morphology rules; an uncapped rerun yielded 27,980 candidates and 14,402 passes. The 5 m between-cage pass-fraction gap fell from 26.9 to 0.4 percentage points after uncapping, revealing selection amplification. A separate probability sample of 128 passes, failures, and lower-ranked candidates yielded 83.6% agreement (κ = 0.627) between two blinded reviewers. Rater-specific, sampling-weighted proportions of automatic passes judged visually isolated were 39.2% and 55.3%; these labels do not establish single-fish identity. In the historical capped 142-case matched cohort, the mixed acoustic/detector set showed a record-level domain association (balanced accuracy 0.919; six-test Holm-adjusted p = 0.0030), conditional on ranking and selection. Species effects cannot be separated from cage effects in this one-cage-per-species design. This case study audits design eligibility, candidate selection, and reviewer dependence before biological classifier development.
papers.summary_cn: 针对海上养殖网箱机械扫描声呐回波，研究在物种建模前评估声学候选质量与生物可辨识性。分析两个网箱（每箱一个物种）单日22条记录、336个完整旋转的70,421帧，比较历史top-20检测器与无上限重跑下的候选筛选差异，并用盲审概率抽样评估标注一致性。无上限重跑后网箱间通过率差距由26.9个百分点降至0.4个百分点，揭示选择放大效应；双评审一致率83.6%（κ=0.627），但视觉孤立标签不足以确认单鱼身份，且物种效应与网箱效应无法分离。该案例研究强调生物分类器开发前需审计设计合格性、候选选择与评审者依赖性。

papers.title: Physicochemical Characteristics, Fatty Acids Composition and Antioxidant Activity of Gabus (Channa striata) Fish Oil Cultivated in Konda, Southeast Sulawesi
papers.authors: Irnawati, Irnawati; Pascayantri, Asniar; Zubaydah, Wa Ode Sitti; Malik, Fadhliyah; Syamsinar, Asni; Aulia, Safira Nur; Jumiarni, Jumiarni; Windarsih, Anjar; Rohman, Abdul
papers.abstract: Channa striata fish, commonly known as the “striped snakehead”, is a freshwater fish species widely distributed in Southeast Asia, particularly in Indonesia. The aims of this study were to evaluate the physicochemical characteristics, fatty acids composition and antioxidant activity of Channa striata fish oil from Konda, Southeast Sulawesi affected of purification adsorbent. The Soxhlet method was used for fish oil extraction. The result was found that the purification of fish oil using bentonite and activated charcoal adsorbents resulted in a reduction of acid value, peroxide value, and refractive index, while no significant differences were observed in iodine value and saponification value across treatments. Purification of the oil using activated charcoal resulted in an increased relative percentage of saturated fatty acids, specifically heptadecanoic acid (5.76%) and arachidic acid (11.07%), accompanied by a decrease in monounsaturated fatty acids such as palmitoleic acid (23.33%) and the absence of polyunsaturated fatty acids, notably gamma-linolenic acid, which was not detected. The chelating agent activity of fish oil increased following purification with both bentonite and activated charcoal. However, an enhancement in DPPH radical scavenging activity was observed only in the samples purified with bentonite. In contrast, purification with activated charcoal led to a reduction in ABTS radical scavenging activity. The sPLS-DA technique, using FTIR spectral absorbance data as variables, effectively discriminated between crude fish oil and fish oil purified with bentonite and activated charcoal. In conclusion, oil purification enhances the physicochemical properties of snakehead (Channa striata) fish oil.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了印尼东南苏拉威西Konda地区养殖的条纹蛇头鱼（Channa striata）鱼油的理化特性、脂肪酸组成及抗氧化活性，采用Soxhlet法提取鱼油并比较膨润土与活性炭吸附纯化效果。纯化后酸值、过氧化值和折射率降低，碘值与皂化值无显著变化；活性炭纯化使饱和脂肪酸（十七烷酸5.76%、花生酸11.07%）相对含量升高，单不饱和脂肪酸（棕榈油酸23.33%）下降，多不饱和脂肪酸（γ-亚麻酸）未检出。膨润土与活性炭纯化均提高螯合活性，但DPPH清除活性仅在膨润土组增强，活性炭组ABTS清除活性下降；基于FTIR光谱的sPLS-DA可有效区分粗油与两种纯化油。结论：纯化可改善蛇头鱼鱼油的理化品质。

papers.title: Biomimetic analysis of escape gliding patterns: the role of ventral fin posture in flying fish-inspired robots
papers.authors: Wang, Junhao; Geng, Zijian; Liu, Kexian; Du, Chuansheng; Wang, Yang; Yue, Wen; Huang, Zhong
papers.abstract: Abstract Flying fish evade predatory threats through cross-medium gliding manoeuvres, in which the ventral fins play a pivotal regulatory role. Although previous studies have examined the influence of ventral fin configuration on gliding stability, the dynamic characteristics of escape trajectories and the regulatory effects of ventral fin posture on gliding attitude remain poorly understood. Here, we employ a biomimetic approach to elucidate the gliding patterns exhibited by flying fish during escape manoeuvres. We systematically investigate how ventral fin posture regulates gliding attitude and identify an optimal ventral fin mounting configuration. Combining full-factor experimental testing with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations, we propose that flying fish adopt distinct gliding trajectories to evade predators in different media, with dynamic ventral fin adjustments acting as a key regulatory mechanism. Furthermore, by extending the parameter space beyond that accessible through biological observation, this study provides new theoretical guidance for the aerodynamic design and optimisation of multi-fin biomimetic robots.
papers.summary_cn: 研究采用仿生学方法，结合全因子实验测试与CFD模拟，探讨飞鱼逃逸滑翔过程中腹鳍姿态对滑翔姿态的调控作用，并识别出最优腹鳍安装构型。研究发现飞鱼在不同介质中采用不同的滑翔轨迹以躲避捕食者，腹鳍的动态调整是关键调控机制。该研究将参数空间拓展至生物观测范围之外，为多鳍仿生机器人的气动设计与优化提供了理论指导。

papers.title: On the Eastern Shores of Mare Nostrum: Sea, Fishing, Fish and Marine Iconography in the Mosaics of Antiocheia ad Orontem, Daphne, Seleucia Pieria, Alexandretta
papers.authors: Özdilek, Banu; Tıbıkoğlu, H. Onur
papers.abstract: Representations associated with the sea are especially prominent in the Roman period villas of Antiocheia ad Orontem, Daphne, the port citys of Seleucia Pieria and Myriandros-Alexandretta. A total of 33 mosaics featuring marine and freshwater themes have been identified in Antiocheia ad Orontem. These include depictions of fishing Erotes, Tethys, Oceanus and Tethys, Thalassa, the marine thiasus, Nereids, Tritons, Nymphe, fishing scenes, the Birth of Aphrodite, Arethusa, the Abduction of Europa, and the Navigium Isidis, as well as other mythological themes. In addition, depictions of fish in banquet scenes and various marine creatures are also represented. Alongside the personification of Thalassa, the mosaics depict gods, goddesses and mythological figures associated with the sea, including Tethys, Oceanus, Psyche-Eros and Aphrodite. The presence of various species of fish, marine creatures, crustaceans and mollusks accompanying these figures demonstrates the richness of the marine-fauna repertoire represented in the mosaics of Antioch. Fishing scenes constitute another important component of this repertoire. Particularly noteworthy are scenes depicting fishing Erotes and putti using different fishing techniques. The earliest examples of maritime mythological narratives in the mosaics of Antioch date back to the 2nd C. CE. The marine fauna and mythological representations particularly evident in Roman period mosaics continued, in different forms, into the 5th and 6th C. CE., appearing in personifications and in representations of Paradise associated with Christian structures. During this period, fish also acquired an important symbolic meaning within Christian iconography. Thus, the mosaics of Antioch reveal an iconographic continuity extending from the sea gods and goddesses and mythological narratives of the pagan period to the symbolism of water and fish in the Christian period.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以安条克（Antiocheia ad Orontem）、达芙妮、塞琉西亚·皮埃里亚和亚历山德雷塔的罗马时期马赛克为对象，系统梳理了其中33幅海洋与淡水主题作品，涵盖捕鱼Erotes、Tethys、Oceanus、Thalassa、海洋thiasus、Nereids及各类鱼类、甲壳类和软体动物形象。研究识别出多种捕鱼技法场景及海洋神话叙事，指出最早实例可追溯至公元2世纪。海洋动物区系与神话表现以不同形式延续至5–6世纪基督教建筑中的天堂场景，鱼在此期获得重要宗教象征意义，体现了从异教海神神话到基督教水与鱼象征体系的图像学连续性。

papers.title: Muscle-Associated Lipid Deposition in Fish: Biological Foundations, Genetic Architecture, and Emerging Frontiers for Precision Improvement
papers.authors: Li, Siping; Chen, Yihao; Sui, Yanming; Li, Lei; Jiang, Zhongquan; Ren, Yuanhao; Qin, Bo; Lin, Tingting; Zheng, Hanfeng
papers.abstract: Muscle-associated lipids influence fish flesh composition, nutritional value, and sensory quality, but inconsistent definitions obscure comparisons among studies. This review distinguishes adipose tissue between anatomically distinct muscles, adipocytes within muscle connective tissue, lipid droplets within myofibers, and chemically measured muscle lipid content. In salmonids, myoseptal adipose tissue occupies the partitions between adjacent myomeres, whereas perimysial adipocytes lie within myomeres. We examine how these compartments develop, how their lipid storage is regulated, and how genetic and nutritional approaches can improve flesh quality. Salmonid precursor cultures support adipogenic differentiation involving PPARγ and C/EBPs, while evidence for depot-specific progenitor lineages remains limited. Genetic studies identify heritable variation and associated genomic regions for muscle lipid traits, but association, expression, and functional evidence frequently address different phenotypes or tissues. Translating these findings requires standardized sampling, spatially resolved measurements, and functional testing of candidate mechanisms. Research priorities include distinguishing adipocyte recruitment from lipid loading, separating cell-composition changes from intracellular regulation, and connecting causal variants with depot-specific phenotypes. Breeding objectives should integrate lipid distribution and fatty acid composition with processing quality, growth, feed efficiency, and environmental robustness. Imaging and multi-omics can support this integration when calibrated against defined biological traits and validated across populations and production environments.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述旨在厘清鱼类肌肉相关脂质沉积的定义分歧，区分肌间脂肪组织、肌内结缔组织脂肪细胞、肌纤维内脂滴与化学测定的肌肉脂质含量，并梳理其发育调控、遗传基础及营养改良途径。鲑科鱼类中，肌隔脂肪组织位于相邻肌节之间，而肌周膜脂肪细胞位于肌节内部；前体细胞培养支持涉及PPARγ和C/EBPs的成脂分化，但 depot-specific 祖细胞谱系的证据仍有限。遗传研究已鉴定肌肉脂质性状的可遗传变异及相关基因组区域，但关联、表达与功能证据常针对不同表型或组织。作者建议通过标准化采样、空间分辨测量和候选机制的功能验证来推动精准改良，并将脂质分布与脂肪酸组成同加工品质、生长、饲料效率和环境适应性共同纳入育种目标。

papers.title: Short-term responses of fish and macroinvertebrate population trajectories to experimental flow reduction in temperate streams
papers.authors: Nakagawa, Hikaru; Minamoto, Toshifumi; Mori, Terutaka
papers.summary_cn: 该研究通过实验性减流处理，观测温带溪流中鱼类和大型无脊椎动物种群轨迹的短期响应，以评估流量减少对溪流生物群落的影响。

papers.title: Saccostrea glomerata in subtidal shellfish reefs in South‐East Queensland. Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence
papers.authors: Diggles, B. K.
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Richardson et al. contest the identity of oyster species that historically constructed subtidal shellfish reefs in South‐East Queensland, Australia, suggesting that “ historical drift/dredge oysters may have been misidentified as S. glomerata .” Objectives To provide historic scientific evidence pertaining to subtidal shellfish reefs along Australia's east coast, to help inform the conservation status of Saccostrea glomerata . Methods Evidence provided by Richardson et al. is reviewed and compared to historical evidence. Results Evidence provided by Richardson et al. remains consistent with historic evidence that S. glomerata is capable of recruiting to both intertidal and subtidal habitats. Increased historical survival of S. glomerata spat in subtidal areas prior to 1893 was probably due to what observers at the time described as “astronomical recruitment,” facilitated by a lack of sedimentation and eutrophication. In contrast, subtidal spat settlement today is severely constrained by sedimentation and algal turfs, Queensland Unknown disease, and possibly also by relatively increased predation due to a potential Allee Effect. Conclusions The misidentification hypothesis appears to be built on a logical fallacy arising from shifting baseline syndrome.
papers.summary_cn: 针对Richardson等对澳大利亚昆士兰东南部潮下带贝礁历史建造牡蛎物种鉴定的质疑，本文通过梳理和比较历史科学证据，评估 *Saccostrea glomerata* 的保育地位。历史证据表明该物种能够附着于潮间带和潮下带生境，1893年前潮下带spat存活率高可能与当时观察者所述的“天文数字级补充”有关，而现今潮下带spat附着受沉积物、藻席、昆士兰未知疾病及潜在Allee效应导致的捕食压力增加严重制约。作者认为误鉴定假说源于基线漂移综合征所致的逻辑谬误。

papers.title: Biomass, Taxonomic and Morpho-Functional Structure and Annual Dynamics of Stranded Macroalgae in a Shellfish Estuarine Bank of NW Iberia
papers.authors: García-Cardesín, Érika; Abella, Emilio; Casais, Eduardo; Cremades, Javier
papers.abstract: This study provides a comprehensive assessment of the biomass and taxonomic and morpho-functional composition of stranded macroalgae and seagrasses on a highly productive shellfish bank in NW Iberia (Galicia), frequently affected by green tides, based on a year-long monitoring program and multivariate analyses. Macroalgal biomass showed marked seasonal and spatial variability, with the highest values recorded in spring. Chlorophyta dominated stranded biomass, particularly Ulva lacinulata, which accounted for over 63% of the total. Thin foliose morphotypes also made a major contribution to biomass across seasons and sampling locations. Linear mixed-effects modelling revealed a significant interaction between transect and intertidal level, indicating that spatial biomass patterns varied across the intertidal gradient. An interaction between season and intertidal level was also detected, although its statistical support was less consistent in sensitivity analyses. The absence of a consistent vertical zonation pattern suggests that stranded biomass distribution may be influenced by detachment, transport and deposition processes, rather than solely reflecting local macroalgal production. These findings highlight the importance of considering taxonomic and morpho-functional groups composition, spatial variability and hydrodynamic context when monitoring and managing valuable estuarine environments affected by green tides.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于为期一年的监测与多变量分析，评估了伊比利亚西北部（Galicia）一个受绿潮频繁影响的高产贝类滩涂上漂流大型藻类和海草的生物量及分类与形态功能组成。大型藻类生物量呈现明显的季节和空间变异，春季最高；Chlorophyta主导漂流生物量，其中Ulva lacinulata占总量的63%以上，薄叶状形态型在各季节和采样点均贡献较大。线性混合效应模型检测到断面与潮间带水平的显著交互作用，表明生物量空间格局随潮间带梯度变化，但未发现一致的垂直分带模式，提示漂流生物量分布可能受脱附、输运和沉积过程影响，而非仅反映本地大型藻类生产。

papers.title: Multi-Biomarker Assessment of Crayfish Health and Habitat Quality in Lake Sevan (Armenia)
papers.authors: Melkonyan, Hranush; Chuiko, Grigorii; Gabrielyan, Bardukh; Ghukasyan, Evelina; Khorozyan, Igor; Kobelyan, Hripsime
papers.abstract: High-altitude freshwater ecosystems are particularly vulnerable to anthropogenic impacts, yet spatial and seasonal variations in biological responses remain poorly understood. This study assessed the health status of narrow-clawed crayfish (Pontastacus leptodactylus) and habitat condition in two hydrologically and environmentally distinct bays of Lake Sevan, Armenia, using an integrated hydrochemical and multibiomarker approach. Water quality and crayfish populations were measured in Lichk and Lchashen Bays in May, July, and October 2024 and 2025. In total, 120 crayfish specimens were examined, and oxidative stress responses were assessed in the hepatopancreas, gills, and muscle using MDA, GSH, GST, KAT, and SOD. Lchashen Bay experienced more adverse environmental conditions, characterized by pronounced hypoxia in the summer (3.4–3.9 mg O2 L−1), higher biochemical oxygen demand and permanganate oxidation, and elevated K, Na, and Mg concentrations. Biomarker responses showed significant seasonal variation, typically with highest values in July. Crayfish from Lchashen Bay consistently demonstrated higher biomarker responses than crayfish from Lichk Bay across all tissues and sampling periods. Integrated biomarker response (IBR) values confirmed this spatial pattern, indicating greater physiological stress in Lchashen Bay. The combined hydrochemical and biomarker approach demonstrates the suitability of P. leptodactylus as an indicator species for assessing sublethal environmental stress in Lake Sevan.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以塞万湖（亚美尼亚）两个水文与环境条件不同的海湾为对象，采用水化学与多生物标志物相结合的方法，评估窄爪螯虾（Pontastacus leptodactylus）健康状况及栖息地质量。2024与2025年5、7、10月共检测120尾螯虾，测定肝胰腺、鳃和肌肉中MDA、GSH、GST、KAT、SOD等氧化应激指标。Lchashen湾环境条件更差（夏季明显缺氧，3.4–3.9 mg O2 L−1，BOD及高锰酸盐指数更高，K、Na、Mg浓度升高），其螯虾各组织、各时期的生物标志物响应及integrated biomarker response（IBR）值均持续高于Lichk湾，表明生理胁迫更强。结果表明P. leptodactylus可作为评估塞万湖亚致死环境胁迫的指示物种。

papers.title: Bycatch, Capture Mortality, and Release Condition in the Cypriot Pelagic Longline Fishery: A Multi-Year Observer-Based Assessment from the Levantine Sea
papers.authors: Papageorgiou, Marios; Damalas, Dimitrios; Kousteni, Vasiliki; Moutopoulos, Dimitrios K.
papers.abstract: This study assessed bycatch composition, nominal catch rates, capture mortality and release condition in the Cypriot pelagic longline fishery targeting swordfish and albacore tuna. Observations covered 142 fishing days across 16 vessels during 2018–2024 and 335,340 hooks, recording 643 bycatch individuals from 23 species. Bycatch comprised 10.7% of the total catch biomass, with pooled rates of 1.92 individuals and 14.20 kg per 1000 hooks. Elasmobranchs accounted for 63.5% of bycatch individuals, and pelagic stingray alone accounted for 60.0%. Mean fishing-day bycatch biomass, expressed per 1000 hooks and 12 h, was 2.75 times as high in swordfish fishing as in albacore fishing (95% vessel-bootstrap confidence interval [CI] 1.53–3.68). Overall capture mortality was 26.4% (95% CI 23.2–30.0%), including 2.7% in elasmobranchs, 69.1% in teleost fishes and 60.7% in sea turtles. The low pooled elasmobranch mortality masked substantial taxonomic variation: 11 out of 22 sharks were dead at haulback (50.0%), whereas no deaths were observed among the 386 pelagic stingrays. Of the 406 individuals released alive, 396 (97.5%) were classified as Good for vitality, nine as Fair and one as Poor; all were coded as having Minor injury. Release condition remains a descriptive, uncalibrated indicator, and post-release survival was not measured. Sampling was partly opportunistic, and target fishery was partly confounded with year; results therefore describe the observed sample rather than the whole fleet. However, these findings establish a baseline for fishery-specific monitoring and mitigation and highlight the importance of distinguishing shark and stingray capture mortality.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2018–2024年塞浦路斯远洋延绳钓渔业（目标鱼种为剑鱼和长鳍金枪鱼）16艘渔船142个作业日、335,340枚钓钩的观察员数据，评估了兼捕组成、单位努力兼捕率、捕获死亡率及放生状态。兼捕占总捕获生物量的10.7%，合计每千钩1.92尾、14.20 kg，其中板鳃类占兼捕个体数的63.5%，仅远洋魟即占60.0%；剑鱼作业的日兼捕生物量（每千钩、12 h）为长鳍金枪鱼作业的2.75倍。总体捕获死亡率为26.4%，但类群差异显著：板鳃类仅2.7%，而硬骨鱼类达69.1%、海龟达60.7%；板鳃类低死亡率掩盖了种间差异，22尾鲨鱼中11尾起网时死亡（50.0%），而386尾远洋魟无一死亡。放生个体中97.5%活力评级为Good，但放生状态为未校准的描述性指标，未测定放生后存活率，采样部分为机会性且目标渔业与年份存在部分混杂，结果仅代表所观测样本。

papers.title: Life-cycle plasticity enables conditional asexual reproduction in a kelp
papers.authors: Liesner, Daniel; Luthringer, Rémy; Kandjengo, Lineekela; Bolton, John J.; Rothman, Mark D.; Valero, Myriam; Haas, Fabian B.; Coelho, Susana M.
papers.abstract: Many organisms alternate between distinct life stages and can reproduce either sexually or asexually, yet the mechanisms coordinating these developmental and reproductive transitions remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate the molecular basis of life stage identity and reproductive mode in the kelp Laminaria pallida , a multicellular organism with a complex life cycle. By combining gene expression analyses with developmental experiments and natural population-level approaches, we characterize the transcriptional signatures associated with developmental state transitions in both sexual and asexual contexts. We show that asexual reproduction is associated with endoreduplication and reduced fitness, while it is retained but rarely expressed in two natural populations. Moreover, we find that the presence of potential mating partners reduces asexual development, revealing that reproductive mode is adjusted in response to reproductive opportunities. Together, these findings suggest that asexual reproduction functions as a conditional alternative to sex, promoting persistence when sexual reproduction is constrained while preserving the long-term benefits of sexual reproduction when mates are available. More broadly, our results reveal how organisms integrate developmental, environmental, and reproductive cues to balance alternative reproductive strategies across complex life cycles.
papers.summary_cn: 以海带 *Laminaria pallida* 为对象，结合基因表达分析、发育实验与自然种群调查，解析其生活史阶段身份与繁殖方式的分子基础。研究发现，无性繁殖伴随 endoreduplication 且适合度降低，在两个自然种群中虽保留但极少表达；潜在交配伙伴的存在会抑制无性发育，表明繁殖方式可随繁殖机会调整。无性繁殖作为条件性替代策略，在 sex 受限时维持种群存续，而在有配偶时保留有性繁殖的长期收益。

papers.title: Occurrence and radiological risk assessment of 11 target γ-emitting radionuclides in seafood from the Ningbo coastal area, China during 2022–2025
papers.authors: Zhao, Xuefei; Zhang, Qun; Wang, Yong; Zou, Yuanjie; Wang, Li; Lu, Mincong; Lu, Yuyang; Yu, Shunfei; Zhang, Dandan
papers.abstract: Background Dietary ingestion is a major exposure pathway for environmental radionuclides, and the radiological safety of seafood, an important component of the global diet, has attracted increasing public concern. As a Chinese coastal city where seafood is a traditional part of local residents’ daily diet, Ningbo lacks systematic baseline data on radionuclide levels in locally common edible seafood and associated dietary radiological risks for local residents. Methods Five categories of locally common edible seafood (fish, shrimp, crabs, mollusks and algae) were collected from the southern coastal area of Ningbo during 2022–2025. Specific activities of 11 target γ-emitting radionuclides were quantified via high-purity germanium γ spectrometry in accordance with GB/T 16145–2022, and annual effective ingestion dose (AED) was estimated using local per capita seafood consumption data and ingestion dose conversion coefficients recommended in ICRP Publication 119. Results Natural radionuclides dominated across all five seafood categories, with 40 K detected in 100% of samples. Algae had the highest detection rates of 238 U (77.8%) and 210 Pb (55.6%), crabs had the highest 228 Ra detection rate (100%), and 226 Ra was detected at the highest rate in both crabs and algae (77.8%). For specific activities, algae exhibited the highest specific activities of 238 U (median 0.78, maximum 12.80 Bq/kg), 40 K (284.10, 931.00 Bq/kg) and 210 Pb (0.41, 7.96 Bq/kg); crabs had the highest 226 Ra (0.54, 13.09 Bq/kg); shrimp had the highest median 228 Ra activity (1.26 Bq/kg) while algae had the highest maximum activity (7.90 Bq/kg). Mollusks had the lowest median specific activities overall, but a higher 238 U detection rate than fish, shrimp and crabs. Only trace 137 Cs was detected in one fish (0.05 Bq/kg) and one mollusk (0.02 Bq/kg) sample from 2025. The median total AED was 30.43 μSv/y, with a conservative constructed upper-bound maximum of 133.64 μSv/y. Conclusion For the measured γ-emitting radionuclides only, natural radionuclides dominate in seafood from the study area, and all regulated radionuclides meeting China’s food radiological safety requirements. Artificial radionuclides were negligible with no significant anthropogenic perturbation, and the dietary dose for local adults in the study area remains below the ICRP-recommended public dose limit.
papers.summary_cn: 2022–2025年在宁波南部沿海采集鱼、虾、蟹、软体动物和藻类五类常见海产品，采用高纯锗γ能谱法测定11种γ放射性核素比活度，并结合当地人均消费量估算年有效摄入剂量（AED）。天然放射性核素占主导，40K检出率100%，藻类238U、40K和210Pb比活度最高，蟹类226Ra最高，仅2025年两份样品检出痕量137Cs。AED中位数为30.43 μSv/y，保守上限为133.64 μSv/y，所有受管控核素均符合中国食品放射性安全要求，当地成人膳食剂量低于ICRP公众剂量限值。

papers.title: Molecular characterization of virulence-associated factors and antimicrobial resistance determinants in Arcobacter butzleri isolated from seafood of the Mumbai coast, India
papers.authors: Vasanthi, Kalli; Firdous, Aimen; Kumar, Sanath H; Manjusha, Lekshmi; Karunasagar, Indrani; Nayak, Binaya Bhusan
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对印度孟买沿海海产品中分离的 Arcobacter butzleri，拟从分子层面鉴定其毒力相关因子及抗菌药物耐药决定因子。摘要缺失，具体方法与结果无法概述。

papers.title: An autonomous imaging system for reef fish monitoring in the southern Gulf of Mexico
papers.authors: Guerra-Castro, Edlin José; Plata-Díaz, Miguel Ángel; Gómez-Bretón, Víctor Eduardo; Cedillo-Reyna, Damián Alejandro; Contreras-Chávez, Rodrigo; Sanchez-Porras, Arturo; Ruiz-Mercado, Ilse; Papiol, Vanesa; Pérez-Meza, Ximena Isabel; Hernández-Díaz, Yoalli Quetzalli
papers.abstract: Introduction Reef fish assemblages are widely used as indicators of coral reef condition. Yet, diver-based surveys provide limited temporal resolution and are constrained by logistical demands. We evaluated an autonomous underwater imaging system based on cameras programmed for unattended image acquisition to monitor reef fish assemblages in the southern Gulf of Mexico. Methods Five terrestrial trail cameras adapted for underwater deployment were operated at Bajo de Diez reef during two seasonal deployments in 2024 and 2025, yielding 191,758 valid underwater images at a nominal 3-min interval. Image quality, camera view, species diversity, and daily assemblage dynamics were evaluated using expert annotations of 27,471 images, iNEXT-4steps, multivariate analyses, and an RF-DETR Medium object-detection model applied to the complete valid underwater record. Results Across the expert-sampled record, the mean daily proportion of images containing at least one fish was 17%, and 65 species were recorded. Laplacian variance distinguished lower- from higher-quality images. Assemblage composition differed clearly between the two deployment contexts and showed smaller but statistically detectable heterogeneity among fixed camera views within each deployment, while daily observations revealed structured temporal variation. On the held-out image-level test set, RF-DETR Medium achieved mAP@50 = 0.741, mAP@50:95 = 0.545, precision = 0.794, and recall = 0.650. Across 68 dates shared by the expert and CV analyses, expert- and CV-derived Bray–Curtis temporal structure was positively correlated (ρ = 0.63; Mantel permutation test, p ≤ 0.0001), with similar concordance for daily richness and the image-based relative abundance index. Applied to nearly seven times the number of manually annotated images, RF-DETR expanded temporal support from 68 to 110 dates. Discussion Autonomous imaging can extend reef fish monitoring beyond discrete surveys through repeated acquisition, while computer vision can reduce manual processing within a human-supervised workflow. Within the site and deployment periods evaluated, combining sustained fixed imaging, expert annotation, and computer vision made fuller use of the image archive and provided daily information on reef fish assemblage structure and its variation through time.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了基于水下部署相机（trail cameras）的自主成像系统在墨西哥湾南部Bajo de Diez珊瑚礁监测礁鱼群落的可行性，两次季节性部署共获取191,758张有效图像。通过专家标注27,471张图像并结合iNEXT-4steps、多变量分析及RF-DETR Medium目标检测模型，记录了65种鱼类，日均含鱼图像比例为17%，且群落组成在两次部署间差异明显、相机视角间存在较小但可检测的异质性。RF-DETR模型在测试集上mAP@50达0.741，计算机视觉与专家分析所得的Bray–Curtis时间结构显著正相关（ρ=0.63），并将时间覆盖从68天扩展至110天。研究表明，自主成像结合专家标注与计算机视觉可在人工监督框架下扩展礁鱼监测的时间分辨率并减少人工处理量。

papers.title: A decade of acoustic telemetry in a Marine Protected Area reveals multispecies connectivity throughout the Northwest Atlantic
papers.authors: Pettitt-Wade, Harri; Jeffery, Nicholas W.; Zisserson, Ben; Hartery, Cassandra; Stanley, Ryan R.E.
papers.abstract: In the Northwest Atlantic, acoustic telemetry is widely used to assess aquatic species movements and habitat use within and among conservation areas. We examined the contribution of acoustic telemetry to research and monitoring in St. Anns Bank Marine Protected Area (MPA) off Cape Breton Island (Mi’kmaq: Unama’ki), Nova Scotia. Acoustic telemetry receivers have been deployed within the MPA since 2015 (26 to 46 receivers per year), with tagging of Atlantic cod, Atlantic halibut, and Atlantic striped wolffish. Through integration with the Ocean Tracking Network (OTN), a dataset was assembled that included animals tagged within the MPA and animals tagged by other projects that subsequently passed through the area. This dataset directly informs biodiversity conservation objectives by documenting distinct spatial and temporal fluxes of migratory and seasonally resident species (15 species, 504 individuals). Findings demonstrated far reaching connectivity, strong affinity for a predominant shallow bathymetric feature (Scatarie Bank), and relationships with recorded bottom temperature and depth. This study demonstrates the utility of acoustic telemetry for long-term baseline monitoring of species occurrence, movement, and ecological change.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究总结了St. Anns Bank MPA（新斯科舍省Cape Breton岛外）近十年声学遥测的应用，自2015年起每年布设26–46个接收器，标记Atlantic cod、Atlantic halibut和Atlantic striped wolffish，并经Ocean Tracking Network整合形成包含区内标记与外部项目标记个体的数据集。数据集记录了15种、504尾个体的时空分布动态，揭示了跨西北大西洋的广泛connectivity、对Scatarie Bank浅水地貌的强烈亲和性及与底层温度和深度的关系。研究表明acoustic telemetry可用于物种出现、移动及生态变化的长期基线监测，直接服务于生物多样性保护目标。

papers.title: Responses of tissue insulin-like growth factor (IGF)-1 and IGF-binding protein-1 mRNAs to fasting and refeeding in juvenile and larval shishamo smelt Spirinchus lanceolatus
papers.authors: Hasegawa, Ryuya; Shimizu, Munetaka
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以幼鱼和仔鱼阶段的西太公鱼（Spirinchus lanceolatus）为对象，探讨禁食与再投喂对组织胰岛素样生长因子（IGF）-1及IGF结合蛋白-1 mRNA表达的影响，旨在揭示其生长调控对摄食状态的响应机制。

papers.title: Towards Sustainable Shrimp Fisheries in a West Africa Lagoon: Gear Efficiency in the Nokoué Lagoon With Its Inlet
papers.authors: Sintondji, Sèlomè Wilfried; Sohou, Zacharie; Vodounnou, Juste Vital; Zounon, Yaovi; Liady, Mouhamadou Nourou Dine; Lacroix, Geneviève
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The continued use of prohibited fishing gear in inland waters around the world poses a direct threat to the sound management of global fish stocks. This is also the case in Benin, where there has been a drastic decline in shrimp production since 2002, particularly in the Nokoué lagoon. This study aimed to compare the capture capacity (in space and time) of two types of fishing gear (traps and nets) that are less destructive on shrimp catches in the Nokoué lagoon and its inlet complex (North, South, Centre, East and West), as part of a sustainable exploitation strategy. In total, two genera of shrimp were sampled: Macrobrachium Spence Bate, 1868 and Penaeus Fabricius, 1798. Analysis of variance (ANOVA) analyses and Tukey's post hoc tests revealed a pronounced seasonal pattern in catches, particularly for Macrobrachium , with a peak in September and a low‐catch period from March to June. Nets showed a prolonged period of low catches, whereas traps revealed four seasonal catch levels. For Penaeus , five seasonal catch levels were identified, corresponding to prolonged peaks in catches between January and June, followed by a gradual decline to the annual minimum in October and November. The spatial distribution of catches reflects significant heterogeneity between stations. For Macrobrachium , traps caught mainly at Western station, characterized by a high density of ‘Acadja’, whereas nets showed a peak at Eastern station. For Penaeus , Western station had the highest catches for both types of gear, whereas the other stations had intermediate or low yields, highlighting the importance of spatial configuration and artificial habitats in the distribution of populations. Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests confirmed that there were no significant differences between the seasonal effectiveness of traps and nets for both genera, indicating comparable overall performance. However, the chi‐square test revealed a moderate but significant difference in the size frequencies of Penaeus , with nets capturing proportionally larger individuals 150–180 mm, whereas traps favoured intermediate sizes 90–120 mm. For Macrobrachium , no significant difference was observed, reflecting a population dominated by juveniles and adults. Chi‐square residual analysis corroborated these observations, showing an overrepresentation of large Penaeus sizes in nets and intermediate sizes in traps. For Macrobrachium , differences in catch according to size class remain limited to individuals measuring 90–120 mm, mainly caught by traps. These results highlight the complex interaction between gear selectivity, seasonal dynamics, and spatial heterogeneity, underscoring the importance of these factors for the sustainable management of shrimp populations in the Nokoué lagoon.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了贝宁Nokoué潟湖及其入海口复合体（北、南、中、东、西五区）中陷阱网具与刺网对虾类（Macrobrachium和Penaeus两属）的捕捞效率，以支撑可持续开发策略。方差分析与Tukey事后检验显示，Macrobrachium渔获呈明显季节格局（9月高峰、3—6月低谷），陷阱网具可识别四个季节渔获水平，刺网则呈长时间低渔获期；Penaeus有五个季节渔获水平，1—6月持续高峰后至10—11月降至年最低。空间分布异质性显著：Macrobrachium以西部站点陷阱网具渔获为主（该区Acadja人工栖息地密度高），刺网则在东部站点出现峰值；Penaeus两型网具均以西部站点渔获最高。Kolmogorov–Smirnov检验表明两型网具季节有效性无显著差异，但卡方检验显示刺网捕获的Penaeus个体偏大（150—180 mm），陷阱网具偏向中间规格（90—120 mm），Macrobrachium规格组成无显著差异。结果表明网具选择性、季节动态与空间异质性共同影响虾类种群管理。

papers.authors: Macate, Isadola Eusebio; Muhala, Valdemiro; Vilanculos, Renaldo Artur; Zambrano, Jorge; Braga, Luis Gustavo Tavares
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The expansion of aquaculture has intensified the search for sustainable alternatives to fishmeal. The mopane worm, Gonimbrasia belina (syn. Imbrasia belina ), is a traditionally consumed southern African insect whose protein, lipid and micronutrient contents have prompted interest in its use as an aquafeed ingredient. This semi‐systematic review evaluates the nutritional value and digestibility of mopane worm meal and its effects on growth, feed utilisation and physiological responses in fish. Several experimental studies on mopane worm meal in fish diets, reviews and related insect‐meal research used to examine its nutritional potential were identified. The available evidence suggests species‐specific and inclusion‐dependent responses. Mozambique tilapia ( Oreochromis mossambicus ) tolerated partial fishmeal replacement and exhibited increased activity of some digestive enzymes, although the fishmeal‐based control achieved the highest growth. By contrast, increasing replacement levels reduced growth, protein utilisation and digestibility in African catfish ( Clarias gariepinus ) and were associated with greater hepatic alteration. Dusky kob ( Argyrosomus japonicus ) showed favourable growth and feed‐utilisation responses at moderate inclusion levels without major changes in digestive enzymes or haematological variables. Overall, the evidence supports mopane worm meal as a potentially valuable supplementary protein, particularly in locally formulated diets and when replaced in moderate proportions (18% for Dusky kob). Although there are studies suggesting replacements up to 60% for Mozambique tilapia, there is no scientific evidence regarding the optimal range. However, the small number of short‐term feeding trials, variability in ingredient composition and processing, incomplete digestibility data and uncertain sustainability of wild harvesting prevent broad commercial recommendations. Standardised, long‐term and independently replicated studies are required to establish species‐specific inclusion thresholds and evaluate physiological, economic and ecological outcomes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过半系统综述评估了莫帕尼虫（Gonimbrasia belina）粉作为鱼粉替代蛋白源的营养价值、消化率及其对鱼类生长和生理响应的影响。现有证据表明替代效果具有物种特异性和添加比例依赖性：莫桑比克罗非鱼可耐受部分替代并表现出消化酶活性升高，但鱼粉对照组生长最佳；非洲鲶鱼随替代比例升高生长、蛋白利用率和消化率下降，并伴随肝脏改变；Dusky kob在中等添加水平（18%）下生长和饲料利用表现良好。综述认为莫帕尼虫粉是有潜力的补充蛋白源，但短期试验数量少、原料组成与加工变异大、消化率数据不完整及野生采集可持续性不确定，尚不足以支持广泛商业推荐，需标准化长期独立重复研究确定物种特异性添加阈值。

papers.title: Biological parameters of the common eel (Ophichthus remiger) in the tropical Eastern Pacific: Implications for fisheries management and sustainable conservation
papers.authors: Chicaiza, David; Flores, Héctor; Avendaño, Ulises; Montúfar-Romero, Milton; Gozzer-Wuest, Renato
papers.journal: Latin American Journal of Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: Ophichthus remiger, commonly known as the common eel, is commercially important in Ecuador because Asian markets have high demand. Since industrial fishing began in 2004, no systematic population monitoring has been conducted, limiting understanding of the species' population dynamics and challenging sustainable management efforts. This study provides essential biological parameters of O. remiger in the Gulf of Guayaquil, Ecuador, including size structure, sex ratio, length-weight relationship, and size at first sexual maturity (SFSM), estimated as the median length at sexual maturity (L50). Between August 2013 and December 2014, 17,186 specimens were sampled monthly using bottom longlines and traps. The results indicate a captured length range of 24 to 138 cm, with females comprising 61% of the population among sexed specimens (n = 5,876). Reproductive activity occurs year-round, with peak the gonadosomatic index in October and April. The condition index (K) is not different between females and males, there are no differences in the length-weight relationship; the specimens exhibit allometric growth. The SFSM, expressed as L50, was 56.7 cm for females (95% CI: 56.2-57.2 cm; n = 1,847) and 63.2 cm for males (95% CI: 62.6-63.8 cm; n = 1,109). Based on the estimated size at 50% sexual maturity (L50), minimum capture sizes of approximately 57 cm total length (TL) for females and 63 cm TL for males are recommended as a management reference for O. remiger in the Gulf of Guayaquil. These data provide a robust basis for sustainable management measures, crucial to conserving this high-demand species in international markets.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2013–2014年厄瓜多尔瓜亚基尔湾底延绳钓和陷阱渔获的17,186尾样本，首次系统报道了Ophichthus remiger的体长结构、性比、体长-体重关系及首次性成熟体长（L50）。雌性占可鉴定性别样本的61%，繁殖活动全年进行，性腺指数在10月和4月出现峰值，体长-体重关系呈异速生长。雌、雄L50分别为56.7 cm和63.2 cm TL，据此建议将约57 cm（雌）和63 cm（雄）TL作为该海域该种的最小捕捞规格参考，为stock assessment与可持续管理提供基础参数。

papers.title: From Sea to Serve: An Integrated Situation Analysis of Oman’s Fisheries Sector
papers.authors: Al Abri, Ibtisam; Al-Masroori, Hussein; Akintola, Abdallah; Yousuf, Jaynab B.
papers.abstract: This study provides a comprehensive situation analysis of Oman’s fisheries sector, which remains under-researched despite its strategic importance for economic diversification under Oman Vision 2040. Adopting an integrated PESTEL-SWOT framework, the research evaluates the political, economic, social, technological, environmental, and legal dimensions of the sector to identify systemic constraints and development opportunities. The methodology employs a mixed-methods approach, triangulating quantitative data from national and international repositories with qualitative insights from 382 semi-structured interviews conducted across all coastal governorates between 2023 and 2025. Findings reveal that while the sector contributed approximately OMR 521.6 million (1.1%) to the national GDP at constant prices in 2025, it remains characterized by significant inefficiencies. Internal weaknesses include low value addition, with less than 15% of landings undergoing domestic processing, and high post-harvest losses historically estimated at 20% of catch value, highlighting gaps in cold-chain infrastructure. Environmentally, while small pelagic stocks appear stable, high-value species such as kingfish and abalone face overexploitation, further complicated by climate-driven productivity shifts. The analysis highlights critical policy implications, emphasizing the need for a transition from wealth-maximization to welfare-maximization to protect the artisanal fleet, which accounts for approximately 90% of national fisheries production. Key recommendations include the adoption of risk-based food safety management to access high-value global markets, the integration of climate-resilient provisions into legal frameworks, and targeted programs to strengthen youth participation in artisanal fisheries. Ultimately, the study provides an evidence-based diagnostic baseline for an under-researched region, aligning Oman’s fisheries management with the global mandates of SDG 14 and the economic objectives of the “Blue Economy”.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用PESTEL-SWOT整合框架与混合方法（2023–2025年沿海各省382份半结构化访谈及国内外数据三角验证），对阿曼渔业部门进行系统情境分析，以识别其结构性制约与发展机遇。结果显示，该部门2025年按不变价贡献约5.216亿阿曼里亚尔（占GDP 1.1%），但附加值低（国内加工率不足15%）、采后损失高（历史估计达渔获价值的20%），冷链基础设施存在短板；小型中上层鱼类种群尚稳，而kingfish、鲍鱼等高值种类面临过度捕捞，并受气候驱动的生产力变动影响。研究强调政策需从财富最大化转向福利最大化以保护占全国产量约90%的artisanal fleet，建议引入基于风险的食品安全管理、将气候韧性条款纳入法律框架并促进青年参与，为SDG 14与“Blue Economy”目标下的渔业管理提供基线依据。

papers.title: From co-presence to integration: measuring twin innovation in European agriculture, forestry and fisheries
papers.authors: Pavesi, Rocco; Martínez-Cháfer, Luis; De Noni, Ivan; Orsi, Luigi
papers.summary_cn: 该研究聚焦欧洲农业、林业与渔业领域的“双重创新”（twin innovation，即数字与绿色创新协同），旨在构建从共现到整合的测度框架。摘要缺失，仅据标题可知其关注创新整合程度的量化评估，与渔业创新政策相关。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Applications in True Crabs (Brachyura) Across Aquaculture, Fisheries, Ecology, and Processing: A Scoping Review
papers.authors: Bual, Cyrus Lawrence C.; Bual, Rachel C.; Vicerra, Ryan Rhay P.
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly applied to crab research, yet no prior review has mapped this work or its progress toward real-world use. This scoping review maps artificial intelligence applications in true crabs (Brachyura) across aquaculture, fisheries, ecology, and processing. Following the PRISMA extension for Scoping Reviews, five databases were searched for records published from 2016 to 14 June 2026, yielding 11,172 records, most from databases whose broad field coverage returned papers mentioning crabs or artificial intelligence only in passing. Of these, 88 peer-reviewed English-language primary studies applying artificial intelligence to brachyuran data and reporting at least one quantitative performance metric were included. Each study was charted for species, task domain, model architecture, dataset, performance, and deployment maturity (Technology Readiness Level). The literature is young and expanding rapidly, with nearly half published since 2025, and heavily concentrated, with China contributing most affiliations and three species accounting for more than two-thirds of studies. Twelve task domains were identified, dominated by quality assessment and sex classification. The field has converged on object detectors with attention modules, but accuracy is rarely comparable because datasets and protocols are proprietary. Most systems remain at laboratory validation. Reported accuracy has therefore advanced faster than demonstrated deployment.
papers.summary_cn: 该scoping review旨在系统梳理人工智能在真蟹（Brachyura）水产养殖、渔业、生态及加工领域的应用现状与部署成熟度。遵循PRISMA-ScR指南检索5个数据库（2016—2026年），从11,172条记录中纳入88项报告定量性能指标的英文原始研究，按物种、任务域、模型架构、数据集、性能及Technology Readiness Level进行图表化分析。研究发现该领域年轻且快速扩张（近半数发表于2025年后），研究高度集中（中国贡献最多机构署名，3个物种占逾三分之二研究），共识别12类任务域，以品质评估和性别分类为主；模型趋于采用带注意力模块的目标检测器，但因数据集与协议多为专有，准确率难以横向比较，多数系统仍停留于实验室验证阶段，报告准确率的提升快于实际部署的验证。

papers.title: Species composition and population structure of devil rays (Mobula spp.) in artisanal fisheries of Guatemala's Pacific coast
papers.authors: Hacohen-Domené, Ana; Polanco-Vásquez, Francisco; Moreira Ramírez, José F.; Ortíz Aldana, José; Avalos-Castillo, Cristopher G.; Castillo Villeda, Miriam
papers.journal: Latin American Journal of Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: Incidental capture of devil rays (Mobula spp.) occurs in several artisanal fisheries worldwide, yet biological information from many regions remains limited. This study examines species composition, morphometrics, sex ratio, and sexual maturity of devil rays incidentally captured in artisanal fisheries along Guatemala's Pacific coast. Fishing operations were monitored from February 2019 to February 2020 and from October 2022 to February 2024, including 246 fishing trips, 143 of which recorded mobulids. Data on species identification, disc width, total length, sex, and maturity stage were collected from landed individuals. A total of 453 devil rays were recorded. Of these, 447 were identified to species level: Mobula munkiana (n = 238), M. thurstoni (n = 205), M. mobular (n = 3), and M. birostris (n = 1); the remaining six individuals could only be identified to genus level (Mobula spp.). Of the total captures, 40.4% occurred in small-scale fisheries targeting Caranx caballus, 32.6% in fisheries targeting large pelagic species, and 27.0% could not be assigned to a specific fishery. In M. thurstoni, males exhibited a significantly larger mean disc width (131.78 ± 32.28 cm) than females (105.14 ± 26.46 cm; P < 0.05), with a male-biased M:F sex ratio of 2.01:1 (χ² = 22.56; P < 0.05). Similarly, in M. munkiana, males were significantly larger (89.27 ± 10.28 cm) than females (82.12 ± 10.52 cm; P < 0.05), and the sex ratio was also male-biased (1.64:1; χ² = 13.65; P < 0.05). These findings provide baseline information on species composition and morphometrics relevant to fisheries management and devil ray conservation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究监测了危地马拉太平洋沿岸手工渔业2019—2024年间246次作业，共记录453尾兼捕的蝠鲼（Mobula spp.），其中以M. munkiana（n=238）和M. thurstoni（n=205）为优势种，兼捕主要发生于针对Caranx caballus的小型渔业（40.4%）及大型中上层鱼类渔业（32.6%）。M. thurstoni和M. munkiana均表现为雄性平均盘宽显著大于雌性且性比偏雄（分别为2.01:1和1.64:1）。研究为该区域蝠鲼的种类组成与形态特征提供了基线资料，可服务于渔业管理与保护。

papers.title: Evaluating the impacts of stock enhancement on the abundance and distribution of Rhopilema esculentum in the southern Bohai Sea

papers.title: Preaching to the Fish and Learning from the Deer: St. Hubert of Liège, St. Anthony of Padua, and Human–Animal Communication
papers.authors: Grén, Roni
papers.abstract: This article discusses paintings of the stories of two Catholic saints from the early modern period to late 19th- and early 20th-century art: St. Hubert of Liège (c. 656–727) and St. Anthony of Padua (1195–1231). The text first compares the 16th- and 17th-century works to more modern ones and then proceeds to discuss the developments to produce an analysis of the changes in human–animal relations that the works reflect. In the article, I determine (1) the type of human–animal communication represented in paintings of the stories of St. Hubert and St. Anthony, (2) the ideologies and relations to nature behind them, (3) the differences in representations between the two periods and the reasons for these differences, and (4) the possible reasons behind such a revival and changes. The article maintains that the changes in the representations of the two themes were deeply entangled with philosophical and economic developments that are behind our modern views of nature.
