papers.title:
Fish and macrobenthic diversity and community assembly patterns in the
                    <scp>Jiuduansha Wetland</scp>
                    based on
                    <scp>eDNA</scp>
                    metabarcoding
papers.authors: Zhang, Qiuhao; Wang, Hui; Zhang, Wei; Tian, Yuan; Li, Chenhong
papers.abstract: Abstract Estuarine wetlands are critical zones of land–sea interaction that play vital roles in maintaining biodiversity and ecosystem functioning. As the only remaining natural estuarine wetland in the Yangtze River Estuary, Jiuduansha's fish and macrobenthic diversity and community assembly mechanisms remain poorly understood due to limitations of traditional survey methods in protected areas. We conducted eDNA metabarcoding surveys at 11 sampling sites (6 intertidal zone and 5 riverine sites) in the Jiuduansha Wetland Nature Reserve during May and July of 2023–2024, combined with measurement of environmental variables, to systematically analyse the mechanisms of species composition, diversity patterns and community assembly of the Jiuduansha Wetland. A total of 64 fish species and 35 macrobenthos were detected. The eDNA approach identified approximately 40% more species than historical traditional surveys. Spatially, fish diversity was higher in riverine sites (average 18.6 ± 2.7 species/site), while macrobenthos were more concentrated in the intertidal zone (average 14.2 ± 2.5 species/site). Seasonal patterns differed: fish species richness was higher in May, whereas macrobenthos peaked in July. Generalized linear models (GLMs) indicated that total nitrogen (TN) and chemical oxygen demand (COD) were key environmental factors that have negative influence on both communities' richness. Beta diversity decomposition showed that species turnover was the dominant component of community variation within the study scale (70.7%–70.9% for fish, 60.0%–69.3% for macrobenthos). Neutral community model (NCM) fitting revealed increased migration rates, with Nm values increased from 4 in 2023 to 17 in 2024 for fish and from 9 to 18 for macrobenthos, based on samples collected in May and July of each year. This indicates enhanced dispersal between communities. Both βNTI analysis (|βNTI| < 2) and the RCbray index (with >90% contribution of ecological drift) demonstrated that stochastic processes, particularly ecological drift, dominated community assembly.
papers.summary_cn: 基于eDNA宏条形码技术，对长江口九段沙湿地11个采样点（6个潮间带、5个河道站点）开展鱼类和大型底栖动物多样性及群落构建机制研究。共检出64种鱼类和35种大型底栖动物，eDNA方法较历史传统调查多识别约40%的物种；鱼类多样性在河道站点较高，大型底栖动物集中于潮间带，鱼类物种丰富度5月较高而大型底栖动物7月达峰。GLM分析表明总氮（TN）和化学需氧量（COD）是抑制两类群落丰富度的关键环境因子；beta多样性分解显示物种周转为主导组分（鱼类70.7%–70.9%，大型底栖动物60.0%–69.3%），NCM拟合显示迁移率上升（鱼类Nm由4增至17，大型底栖动物由9增至18），βNTI（|βNTI|<2）和RCbray（生态漂变贡献>90%）共同表明随机过程尤其是生态漂变主导群落构建。

papers.title: Communication Strategies of the Malabero Coastal Fishermen’s Group in Responding to the Decline in Fish Catch
papers.authors: Zurahman, Aziz; Octaviani, Vethy; Risdiyanto, Bayu
papers.abstract: This study aims to identify and explain the communication strategies employed by the Malabero Beach Fishermen’s Group in Bengkulu City in dealing with the decline in fish catches. This study employed a qualitative method with a case study approach. The research informants were selected using purposive sampling and consisted of the group leader, senior members, and active fishermen. Data were collected through observation, interviews, and documentation, while data analysis employed the interactive model of Miles and Huberman, which includes data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing and verification. The study was analyzed using Hafied Cangara’s (2016) communication strategy theory, which encompasses five elements: communicator, message, media, receiver, and effect. The findings show that the communication strategies employed by the Malabero Beach The findings show that the communication strategies employed by the Malabero Beach Fishermen’s Group involved open communication, deliberation, and a family-oriented approach. The group leader and senior members acted as communicators in directing the members, while the messages conveyed included information about fishing locations, weather conditions, wind direction, sea conditions, and appeals to maintain group solidarity. The communication media used included face-to-face communication at the fishing base and mobile phones while at sea. Although mobile phone network connectivity posed a challenge, group members were able to adapt through direct communication. These communication strategies helped maintain coordination, strengthen cooperation, increase participation, and preserve group solidarity in dealing with the decline in fish catches.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在识别并解释明古鲁市Malabero海滩渔民群体在应对渔获量下降时采用的沟通策略，采用定性案例研究方法，通过目的性抽样选取组长、资深成员和活跃渔民进行观察、访谈与文献收集，并基于Hafied Cangara的沟通策略理论（涵盖沟通者、信息、媒介、接收者与效果五要素）进行分析。研究发现该群体采用开放式沟通、协商和家庭式取向的策略，由组长和资深成员担任沟通者，传递渔场位置、天气状况、风向、海况等信息并呼吁维护群体团结，媒介包括渔业基地的面对面交流和海上手机通讯。尽管手机网络连通性存在挑战，成员通过直接沟通加以适应，这些策略有助于维持协调、加强合作、提高参与度并在应对渔获量下降中保持群体团结。

papers.title: Ammonia excretion dynamics of the silverside (Basilichthys microlepidotus) during the juvenile-to-adult grow-out phase, under different body sizes and stocking densities in a recirculating aquaculture system (RAS)
papers.authors: Méndez, Carlos Andrés; Galleguillos, Carla; Nava, María Luisa; Harris-Toro, Cristian; Morales, María Cristina
papers.journal: Latin American Journal of Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: The Chilean silverside (Basilichthys microlepidotus) is an endemic freshwater species with emerging potential for aquaculture and conservation-oriented production. However, key bioengineering parameters required for system design and biomass management remain poorly defined. This study evaluated how body size and stocking density affect total ammonia nitrogen (TAN) excretion rates in a recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) under controlled conditions. Two stocking densities (1.1 and 1.8 kg m-3) and two size ranges (7.8-77.8 g and 80-297 g), as well as their interaction, were tested using a factorial design with triplicate tanks per treatment. Mean TAN excretion rates ranged from 24.5 to 30.6 mg TAN kg-1 fish h-1. A clear diurnal excretion pattern was observed, with peak TAN release occurring 2-4 h after feeding, followed by a gradual decline. Neither body size nor stocking density significantly affected TAN excretion within the evaluated ranges, indicating that these results provide bioengineering parameters for RAS design and scaling.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了智利银汉鱼（Basilichthys microlepidotus）在RAS中不同体规格（7.8–77.8 g与80–297 g）和养殖密度（1.1与1.8 kg m⁻³）下的总氨氮（TAN）排泄动态。采用析因设计，TAN排泄率为24.5–30.6 mg TAN kg⁻¹ fish h⁻¹，摄食后2–4 h出现排泄峰值，随后逐渐下降。体规格和养殖密度在测试范围内均未显著影响TAN排泄率，结果为RAS设计与规模化提供了生物工程参数。

papers.title: Chemical Characteristics of Synthetic LWTX4 and Paralytic Shellfish Toxins Under Standard Post–Column Oxidation (PCOX) and HILIC–MS/MS Conditions
papers.authors: Shin, A-Young; Byun, Eunjung; Kim, Jihun; Kim, Ye Jin; Lee, Jihoon
papers.abstract: The analytical characteristics of Lyngbya wollei toxin 4 (LWTX4), a rare derivative of saxitoxin (STX), remain insufficiently documented due to its limited availability. In the present study, therefore, LWTX4 was synthesized using the previously reported synthetic route developed by Looper to elucidate its fundamental chromatographic behavior. Additionally, three other paralytic shellfish toxin analogues, STX, decarbamoyl saxitoxin (dcSTX), and 12-epi-LWTX4, were prepared from a common intermediate. Analysis of synthetic LWTX4 using the AOAC OMA 2011.02 HPLC–PCOX–FLD method yielded a retention time of 19.8 min, which overlapped with that of STX, and revealed that its FLD response was one-fourteenth that of STX. Meanwhile, under the AOAC 2021 HILIC–MS/MS conditions, LWTX4 eluted at 7.29 min, producing major product ions at m/z 205.1204, 182.0926, 164.0822, and 110.0720. These chromatographic and mass spectrometric characteristics provide useful reference data for assessing the possible presence of LWTX4 during PST profiling of biological samples. The synthetic STX and dcSTX exhibited chromatographic behavior consistent with that of their corresponding certified reference materials (CRMs) under the standard HPLC–PCOX conditions, supporting the potential use of synthesis as a complementary approach to the isolation of PSTs from dinoflagellates for the preparation of CRMs.
papers.summary_cn: 研究合成了稀有麻痹性贝毒（PST）衍生物LWTX4及其类似物STX、dcSTX和12-epi-LWTX4，以弥补其分析特性数据不足。在AOAC HPLC–PCOX–FLD条件下LWTX4保留时间为19.8 min，与STX重叠，荧光响应仅为STX的1/14；在HILIC–MS/MS条件下于7.29 min洗脱，主要产物离子为m/z 205.1204、182.0926、164.0822和110.0720。这些色谱与质谱特征为生物样品PST谱分析中识别LWTX4提供了参考数据，且合成STX与dcSTX的色谱行为与认证参考物质（CRM）一致，提示化学合成可作为从甲藻中分离PST制备CRM的补充途径。

papers.title: Shuck it and see: Adaptive Restoration Engineering in community‐led shellfish reef restoration
papers.authors: Porter, Robert J.; Richardson, Marina A.; Copeland, Craig; Porter, Rebecca C.; DiBetta, Sophie; Gilchrist, Gary; Toms, Graham; Hastings, David; Gilby, Ben L.
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Shellfish reef restoration occurs across diverse ecological settings. Techniques that perform well in one habitat or species assemblage may perform poorly elsewhere. Objectives We examined how field observations, constraints, and unexpected outcomes shaped restoration structures and developed Adaptive Restoration Engineering (ARE), a framework for iterative refinement and diversification of restoration systems. Methods We assessed 1081 remnant shellfish reef bommies across five Queensland sites and reviewed five restoration structures developed from 2018 to 2026 as practice‐based design pathways: chicken‐wire baskets, mild steel Robust Oyster Baskets, Stainless Steel Robust Oyster Baskets (SS ROBs), Quilted Oyster Doonas, and Living Oyster Gardens (LOGs). Project records, field observations, design modifications, and deployment outcomes were reviewed to identify constraints, drivers, and design responses. Results Remnant reef morphology showed reefs commonly formed discrete bommies rather than continuous platforms, supporting modular design. Field observations drove shifts from galvanized and woven mesh to mild steel and welded stainless steel. Observed burial and subsidence led to seeding racks, shell foundations, and LOGs, while mussel‐dominated recruitment led to SS ROBs where cohesive reefs had not formed before mild‐steel degradation. Handling, transport, and decentralized manufacture shaped unit size and fabrication techniques. These observations formed the basis of ARE, which links observation, driver identification, design response, implementation, and monitoring. Conclusions Multiple designs can be refined for contrasting settings rather than relying on a standard unit. ARE provides a restoration‐specific application of adaptive management for translating field observations into context‐specific design responses.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于澳大利亚昆士兰5个站点1081处残存贝类礁bommies的形态调查，结合2018至2026年间五类修复结构（镀锌网篮、低碳钢ROB、不锈钢ROB、绗缝牡蛎被、Living Oyster Gardens）的实践记录，分析现场约束与意外结果如何驱动修复设计迭代。结果显示残存礁多呈离散bommies而非连续平台，支持模块化设计；现场观察推动了材料从镀锌编织网向低碳钢和焊接不锈钢转变，沉降与掩埋问题促生了苗架、贝壳基座和LOG设计，贻贝优势附着则推动了SS ROB的应用。据此提出Adaptive Restoration Engineering（ARE）框架，将观察、驱动因子识别、设计响应、实施与监测相链接，为修复实践提供情境化设计路径而非标准化单元。

papers.title: Updated occurrence, habitat associations, and genomic resources of syngnathids in the Sembilan Archipelago, Malaysia
papers.authors: Lim, Kah Kheng; He, Song; Collier, Keiler Arthur; Cauz-Santos, Luiz A.; Seah, Ying Giat; Berumen, Michael L.; Zhan, Peng
papers.abstract: Syngnathid fishes, including seahorses and pipefishes, are ecologically and economically important but remain vulnerable to overfishing, habitat degradation, and trade-driven exploitation. This study documents syngnathid occurrence, habitat associations, body-size observations, and genomic resources in the Sembilan Archipelago, Malaysia, using SCUBA-based visual surveys and high-resolution photographic analysis. Across 32 dives at seven reef sites, we recorded 54 occurrence records belonging to four species: Hippocampus kuda , H. comes , Doryrhamphus janssi , and Trachyrhamphus bicoarctatus . Species differed in their observed habitat associations, while size–depth relationships varied among species. A brooding male and two juvenile seahorses provided evidence of local reproductive activity during the survey period. To establish baseline genomic resources for Malaysian syngnathids, we generated high-quality PacBio HiFi genome assemblies for six individuals from three species, with genome sizes ranging from 0.45–0.61 Gbp and BUSCO completeness scores of 92.3–98.8%. The assemblies were characterized through repeat annotation, protein-coding gene prediction, orthology analysis, and phylogenomics. Complete mitochondrial genomes were generated for all six individuals. These genomic resources provide a foundation for future comparative and population genomic studies of genetic diversity, connectivity, and evolutionary relationships. Together, the ecological observations and genomic resources provide a baseline for future standardized monitoring and conservation research on Malaysian syngnathids.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过SCUBA目视调查与高分辨率照片分析，记录了马来西亚Sembilan群岛海龙科鱼类的分布、栖息地关联及体型特征，在7个礁区32次潜水中发现4个物种共54条记录，并观察到怀卵雄鱼和幼鱼，提示当地存在繁殖活动。同时，为3个物种6个个体构建了PacBio HiFi高质量基因组组装（0.45–0.61 Gbp，BUSCO完整度92.3–98.8%），完成重复序列注释、蛋白编码基因预测、直系同源与系统发育基因组学分析，并获得全部个体的线粒体全基因组。该生态与基因组基线数据为马来西亚海龙科鱼类的种群遗传学、连通性及保护监测研究奠定基础。

papers.title: Multiscale Evaluation of Quercetin Against Vibrio parahaemolyticus and Vibrio vulnificus in Seafood and Food-Contact Surfaces
papers.authors: Meghla, Nigar Sultana; Mizan, Md Furkanur Rahaman; Nesa, Syeda Roufun; Han, Sangha; Kang, Iksoon; Ha, Sang-Do
papers.abstract: Vibrio parahaemolyticus and Vibrio vulnificus biofilms pose a major challenge to seafood safety owing to their persistence on food-contact surfaces and increased tolerance to antimicrobial interventions. This study investigated the antibiofilm efficacy and mechanisms of quercetin using integrated structural, physiological, and molecular approaches. Quercetin exhibited concentration-dependent biofilm inhibition and reduced mature biofilms on abiotic surfaces, while its efficacy in inhibiting biofilm formation was evaluated on seafood. Quercetin suppressed early biofilm establishment by reducing cell surface hydrophobicity, bacterial adhesion, autoaggregation, motility, cellular respiration, and ATP production, thereby limiting bacterial attachment and microcolony formation. Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy revealed changes in the EPS-associated spectral profiles of both species, indicating alterations in the biochemical composition of the biofilm matrix. These spectral changes varied between V. vulnificus and V. parahaemolyticus. Gene expression analysis demonstrated coordinated downregulation of quorum sensing (QS), adhesion, and EPS biosynthesis genes, accompanied by increased membrane permeability, intracellular protein leakage, and metabolic dysfunction. In a 6 h screen, 1/2 MIC caused only minor changes in the color and texture of shrimp and oyster, whereas MIC caused larger changes; no cytotoxicity was detected under the tested conditions. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that quercetin disrupts Vibrio biofilms through coordinated mechanisms with limited short-term effects on seafood color and texture at 1/2 MIC, supporting further evaluation as a natural, industry-relevant strategy for controlling seafood-associated Vibrio biofilms and improving seafood safety.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估槲皮素（quercetin）对海产品及食品接触表面上副溶血性弧菌（Vibrio parahaemolyticus）和创伤弧菌（V. vulnificus）生物膜的抑制效果及机制。通过结构、生理和分子层面分析发现，槲皮素呈浓度依赖性抑制生物膜形成并削减成熟生物膜，其作用涉及降低细胞表面疏水性、黏附、自聚集、运动性及ATP产生，改变EPS生化组成，并协同下调quorum sensing、黏附和EPS合成相关基因。1/2 MIC处理6 h对虾和牡蛎色泽质地影响轻微且无细胞毒性，支持其作为天然控菌策略的进一步开发。

papers.title: Humans versus machines: artificial intelligence performs similarly to manual analysis in benthic reef monitoring
papers.authors: Mega, Marina; Barroso, Viviane R.; Ferreira, Carlos Eduardo L.; Cordeiro, Cesar A. M. M.
papers.abstract: Abstract Tropical reefs are among the most biodiverse and threatened marine ecosystems and face both local and global stressors. Understanding community dynamics and ecosystem functioning under these pressures requires long-term monitoring. Image-based surveys are increasingly used in reef ecology because they enable rapid data acquisition and storage. However, manual identification of benthic organisms is time-consuming and potentially subjective, creating a bottleneck between image collection and ecological analysis. Automated annotation tools represent promising solutions, but few studies have directly compared their performance with that of manual approaches, especially under varying image quality conditions. Here, we assess the usefulness of the CoralNet automated tool for classifying benthic cover in tropical reef images and evaluate how image quality influences both manual and automated annotations. Using expert-validated images, we trained and tested both approaches, measuring performance with Cohen’s Kappa coefficient and modeling the effects of image imperfections. We found that manual and automated annotators achieved similar performance across most taxonomic and morphofunctional groups, and both were similarly affected by image quality. Importantly, although the automated annotator showed a slightly lower performance than the manual annotator, image-quality imperfections had a stronger influence on annotation performance than annotator type itself. Our findings indicate that automated annotation can provide comparable performance to manual methods once appropriately trained, with strong potential to enhance large-scale monitoring, biodiversity assessments, and conservation strategies in reef ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 研究评估了CoralNet自动标注工具在热带珊瑚礁底栖覆盖分类中的表现，并与人工标注进行对比，同时考察图像质量对两种方法的影响。利用专家验证图像训练和测试两种方法，以Cohen's Kappa系数衡量表现并建模图像缺陷效应。结果显示，人工与自动标注在多数分类和形态功能类群上表现相近，且受图像质量影响程度相似；图像质量缺陷对标注表现的影响强于标注方式本身。表明经适当训练后自动标注可达到与人工方法相当的性能，有望支撑珊瑚礁生态系统的大尺度监测与生物多样性评估。

papers.title: Size‐structured monitoring and otolith chemistry reveal recurrent tidal‐freshwater use by juvenile Japanese grenadier anchovy Coilia nasus in the lower Yangtze River
papers.authors: Guo, Hongyi; Zhang, Xuguang; Tang, Wenqiao; Liu, Kai
papers.abstract: Abstract Tidal freshwater reaches may provide early‐life habitat for diadromous fishes, but long‐term evidence of their use remains limited. Size‐resolved records are needed as a reference for monitoring under the Yangtze fishing ban introduced in 2021. We analysed monitoring data from Jingjiang, 240 km upstream of the river mouth (2002–2017; 519 effective surveys; 10,560 measured individuals), combining size‐based catch indices, environmental‐window analyses and otolith Sr/Ca profiles from 115 Japanese grenadier anchovy Coilia nasus . Individuals <120 mm standard length were classified operationally as juveniles during August–October, when scale readings supported an age‐0 interpretation, whereas individuals ≥180 mm were treated as a descriptive large‐fish category throughout the year. Juveniles occurred in every survey year; annulus‐free individuals also occurred in winter and spring. The Juvenile Recruitment Index (JRI) showed negative associations with tidal range across the April–July spawning and larval‐transport period, although none of the 72 environmental‐window correlations remained significant after Benjamini–Hochberg correction at a 5% false‐discovery rate. Monthly models also showed a negative lagged association. None of the 40 autumn recruits sampled across four capture years had an accepted elevated Sr/Ca zone; such zones were more frequent in later developmental groups. Total catch obscured contrasting size structures: 2016 combined the series‐high JRI with few large fish, whereas 2010 combined the series‐high large‐fish catch rate with a mid‐range JRI. These findings document recurrent early‐life use of a tidal freshwater reach and provide a size‐resolved pre‐ban reference, without establishing a disproportionate contribution to adult production.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于长江靖江江段2002–2017年519次监测调查（共测量10,560尾）及115尾日本鳀（*Coilia nasus*）耳石Sr/Ca剖面，结合体长结构分析，评估潮汐淡水江段作为其早期生活史栖息地的长期利用情况。结果显示，体长<120 mm的幼鱼在每年调查中均有出现，冬季和春季亦有无年轮个体记录；幼鱼补充指数（JRI）在4–7月产卵与幼体输运期与潮差呈负相关，但经Benjamini–Hochberg校正后72个环境窗口相关性均不显著。四个捕捞年份采集的40尾秋季补充个体均未检出可接受的高Sr/Ca区，提示该江段幼鱼利用具有反复性，但尚不能证实其对成鱼生产的贡献比例；总渔获量掩盖了体长结构的年际差异，研究为2021年长江禁渔后的监测提供了体长分辨的禁渔前基线。

papers.title: Gastric and intestinal evacuation of a pelleted meal in rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) and Mozambique tilapia (Oreochromis mossambicus): a comparison
papers.authors: Foltz, Jeffrey W.; Windell, John T.
papers.abstract: Abstract Knowledge of gastric and intestinal food passage rates are useful to both the fish culture industry and for estimates of a species daily rations in the wild. This study compared gastric and intestinal food passage in two very different species, Mozambique tilapia Oreochromis mossambicus and rainbow trout Oncorhynchus mykiss . Both species were fed a common pelleted meal. The effects of meal size were investigated at temperatures at which each of the species is commonly cultured. Also, the two species were compared at a common water temperature. In addition, the use of chromic oxide as a measure of food passage through the intestine was evaluated. Meal size did not affect gastric emptying times in either species when expressed as a proportion of the meal consumed regressed on the natural log of time since fed. Gastric emptying in tilapia required 24 h at 25 °C and more than 45 h for trout at 13 °C. Chromic oxide was a good indicator for the progression of the meal through the intestinal tract in both species. Meal size did not affect intestinal emptying. Tilapia required 45 h compared with 65 h for trout. Gastric and intestinal emptying at 19 °C did not differ between the two species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了莫桑比克罗非鱼（Oreochromis mossambicus）与虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）对同一颗粒饲料的胃排空和肠道排空速率，并评估了饲料投喂量及水温的影响。结果表明，饲料量（以摄食比例对时间的自然对数回归表示）不影响两种鱼的胃排空时间；在各自常见养殖水温下，罗非鱼25 °C时胃排空需24 h，虹鳟13 °C时需超过45 h。氧化铬是指示饲料在两种鱼肠道中推进的良好标记，饲料量不影响肠道排空，罗非鱼肠道排空需45 h、虹鳟需65 h；但在共同温度19 °C下，两种鱼的胃和肠道排空无差异。

papers.title: Absence of males is associated with delayed progression of vitellogenesis in yellowtail Seriola quinqueradiata
papers.authors: Hasegawa, Yuya; Izumida, Daisuke; Yamamoto, Ikki; Adachi, Kenta; Shibata, Kiko; Shimahara, Yoshiko; Shimada, Yukinori; Oda, Kentaro; Sugaya, Takuma
papers.abstract: Abstract Stable hatchery production of yellowtail requires effective brood stock management, particularly control of vitellogenic progression. Although the absence of males impairs oocyte maturation and ovulation in several fish species, its influence on yellowtail reproduction remains unclear. This study compared female-only and mixed-sex groups over two reproductive seasons, referred to as year 1 and year 2, respectively. Oocyte diameter, ovarian histology, and gonadosomatic index were evaluated before human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) administration, and ovulation was assessed. In both years, maximum oocyte diameter before HCG administration was significantly lower in the female-only group than in the mixed-sex group. The female-only group exhibited individual variation, with some females progressing through vitellogenesis, whereas others showed arrested vitellogenic development. The proportion of ovulated HCG-treated females was significantly lower in the female-only group during year 1 and showed a similar numerical trend in year 2. However, some females with oocyte diameters > 600 μm ovulated under female-only conditions. These results indicate that the absence of males is associated primarily with delayed vitellogenic progression, whereas ovulation can be induced in females that complete vitellogenesis. Therefore, the absence of males should be considered a potential risk factor in brood stock management and may provide a foundation for future maturation control strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了仅雌性与雌雄混合两组黄尾鰤（Seriola quinqueradiata）在连续两个繁殖季的卵母细胞发育与排卵情况，评估HCG处理前的卵母细胞直径、卵巢组织学及性腺指数。结果显示，仅雌性组HCG处理前的最大卵母细胞直径显著低于混合组，且个体间差异明显，部分个体卵黄发生停滞；仅雌性组排卵比例在第一年显著降低，第二年呈类似趋势。结果表明，缺乏雄性与卵黄发生进程延迟相关，但完成卵黄发生的个体仍可诱导排卵，提示雄鱼缺失应作为 brood stock 管理的潜在风险因素。

papers.title:
Chemical energy dispatch and multi‐objective programming based on multi‐population optimization and
                    <scp>BAS</scp>
papers.authors: Yang, Tingting; Li, Xunlai
papers.journal: The Canadian Journal of Chemical Engineering
papers.abstract: Abstract Due to the highly continuous, complex energy coupling, and multi‐energy synergy characteristics of chemical production processes, traditional experience‐based or single‐objective energy scheduling methods struggle to simultaneously address energy consumption, fluctuations, and carbon emission constraints. Therefore, this paper constructs a multi‐objective energy scheduling model for chemical production, targeting operating costs, carbon emissions, and scheduling stability, and proposes an improved beetle foraging algorithm that integrates multiple swarming mechanisms. Experiments show that in a typical chemical energy system, the comprehensive energy utilization rate of this method was increased by 12.34% compared with the traditional method, the steam‐power supply and demand balance deviation was reduced by 27.81%, and the system energy efficiency stability coefficient was increased to 0.93. The results show that the proposed model not only realizes the economic and low‐carbon collaborative optimization of chemical energy dispatch, but also provides a generalizable technical path and engineering reference value for intelligent dispatch and green manufacturing of complex process systems.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对化工生产过程能量耦合复杂、多能协同困难的问题，构建了以运行成本、碳排放和调度稳定性为目标的多目标能源调度模型，并提出融合多种群机制的改进甲虫觅食算法（BAS）进行求解。典型化工能源系统实验表明，该方法综合能源利用率较传统方法提高12.34%，蒸汽-电力供需平衡偏差降低27.81%，系统能效稳定系数提升至0.93。研究实现了化工能源调度的经济与低碳协同优化，为复杂流程系统的智能调度与绿色制造提供了可推广的技术路径。

papers.title: Integrated Biological and Physicochemical Assessment of Ecological Condition in Two Oyster-producing Brackish Systems: Implications for Sustainable Fisheries Management
papers.authors: Atindana, Sandra Akugpoka
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: Background: Oyster-producing lagoons and estuaries are exposed to environmental pressures that may affect habitat condition and fishery sustainability. Aims: To assess and compare the ecological condition of the Densu estuary and Anyanui lagoon by integrating benthic macroinvertebrate assemblages with physicochemical characteristics and water-quality indices and to examine the implications of the findings for sustainable oyster fisheries management in Ghana. Study Design: Water and benthic macroinvertebrate samples were collected from four ecologically distinct zones selected to represent the major environmental gradients within the lagoon: (i) the upstream freshwater-influenced section, (ii) the central channel, (iii) the downstream section adjacent to the lagoon outlet, (iv) an area adjacent to agricultural lands/graveyards where diffuse runoff was expected to influence water quality (mapped using QGIS). These locations were selected to capture spatial variability in physicochemical conditions and benthic communities across the lagoon. The modified Delphi technique was adopted to identify priority water quality parameters affecting Crassostrea tulipa growth. Place and Duration of Study: The Densu Estuary and Anyanui Lagoon were studied from November 2023 to December 2024. Methodology: Physicochemical variables were analysed using the Canadian Council of Ministers of the Environment Water Quality Index (CCME-WQI), while benthic macroinvertebrate assemblages were used as biological indicators of ecological integrity. Expert consultation informed the selection and weighting of key physicochemical variables included in the index. Macroinvertebrate assemblages revealed greater taxonomic diversity and ecological integrity in the Anyanui Lagoon than in the Densu Estuary. Results: Macroinvertebrate assemblages revealed greater taxonomic diversity and ecological integrity in the Anyanui Lagoon than in the Densu Estuary. The occurrence of taxa such as Lithophaga lithophaga and Leptocerus sp. indicated relatively stable environmental conditions in Anyanui, whereas the higher Hilsenhoff Biotic Index in Densu (5.06), compared with Anyanui (3.82), suggested greater organic pollution pressure in the Densu Estuary. CCME-WQI scores classified the Anyanui lagoon as marginal (47.14) and the Densu estuary as poor (38.69), indicating environmental conditions that may limit oyster growth, recruitment and long-term fishery productivity. Although both approaches provided complementary information, benthic macroinvertebrates offered a more integrative assessment of ecological condition than physicochemical measurements alone. Conclusion: These findings demonstrate the value of integrating biological and physicochemical indicators for ecosystem assessment and provide a scientific basis for prioritising habitat restoration, long-term ecological monitoring and adaptive management to sustain Ghana's brackish-water oyster fisheries.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在通过整合底栖大型无脊椎动物群落、理化特征及水质指数，评估并比较加纳Densu河口与Anyanui潟湖的生态状况，进而探讨其对牡蛎渔业可持续管理的意义。研究于2023年11月至2024年12月在四个生态分区采样，采用CCME-WQI评价水质，并以底栖大型无脊椎动物作为生物指示物。结果显示Anyanui潟湖的分类多样性和生态完整性优于Densu河口，后者Hilsenhoff生物指数较高（5.06 vs 3.82），指示更强的有机污染压力；CCME-WQI将Anyanui评为边际（47.14）、Densu评为差（38.69），表明环境条件可能限制牡蛎生长、补充和长期渔业生产力。研究表明底栖大型无脊椎动物比单一理化指标更具整合性，为生境修复和适应性管理提供了科学依据。

papers.title: Community-Based Fisheries Downstreaming through the Development of Natural Fish Stock Powder: Evidence from Usaha Mandiri Consumer Cooperative, Belitung, Indonesia
papers.authors: Sufandi, Unggul Utan; Yusuf, Yusuf; Lokantara, I Gede Wyana
papers.journal: Journal of Universal Community Empowerment Provision
papers.abstract: Coastal fishing communities often depend on selling fresh catches, limiting opportunities to increase product value through processing. In Tanjung Binga, Belitung, this highlights the need to strengthen Koperasi Konsumen Usaha Mandiri (KUM) 's processing capacity. This community service programme aimed to develop skills in producing natural fish stock powder and support the cooperative’s product development capacity. Conducted from March to July 2026, it involved 20 women from fishing households and adopted a participatory technology-transfer approach. Activities included socialisation on fisheries downstreaming, processing training, product application, laboratory nutritional analysis, and assistance with packaging, labelling, branding, and business management. The resulting product, Formio, was made from laisi fish and vegetables without added MSG through grinding, cooking, dehydration, and dry milling. Laboratory analysis recorded 52.00% protein, 1,268 mg/100 g calcium, and 855 mg/100 g phosphorus. However, moisture content reached 21.00%, indicating the need to optimise drying and assess water activity, microbiological quality, and storage stability. Overall, the programme established a foundation for valorising local fish resources and strengthening cooperative-based enterprise capacity. The results demonstrate progress in product development and skills transfer, while identifying product standardisation and market assessment as priorities for subsequent development.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在通过开发天然鱼粉产品提升印尼勿里洞沿海渔业社区合作社（KUM）的加工能力，采用参与式技术转移方法，面向20名渔民家庭妇女开展渔业下游化培训、加工实训、营养分析及包装品牌与经营管理指导。以laisi鱼和蔬菜为原料、不添加MSG制成的Formio产品蛋白质含量达52.00%，钙1,268 mg/100 g、磷855 mg/100 g，但水分含量高达21.00%，提示需优化干燥工艺并评估水分活度、微生物质量及贮藏稳定性。该项目为本地鱼类资源增值和合作社企业能力建设奠定了基础，产品标准化与市场评估为后续开发重点。

papers.title: Estimating Water Quality Impacts in Marine Fisheries: The Case of Northern Shrimp in the Estuary and Gulf of St. Lawrence
papers.authors: Wilson, Michelan; Barbier, Edward B.; Archambault, Philippe; Carrier-Belleau, Charlotte
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以圣劳伦斯河口与湾北部北方长额虾（Northern shrimp）渔业为对象，旨在评估水质变化对海洋渔业的影响。由于摘要缺失，具体方法未知，推测采用水质参数与渔业数据的关联分析进行影响估算。

papers.title: The Combined Effects of River Flow and Water Quality on Freshwater Fish Population Dynamics
papers.authors: Guo, Shenghan
papers.abstract: The aquatic ecosystems of the rivers maintain aquatic biodiversity, and freshwater fish are important bioindicators for the ecological health of a river. Compound stress on fish populations all over the world has been caused by hydrological changes and water quality degradation due to intensive human activities such as dam regulation and pollutant discharge. This study focused on the lower reaches of the Yellow River, and investigated the independent and interactive impacts of river flow and water quality on the dynamics of freshwater fish populations based on multiple-year field monitoring data from 2014 to 2023. Flow variation accounted for 21% of the temporal variation in fish community and was found to have a significant influence on fish spawning cues, habitat availability, and physiological metabolism of the fish, while water quality accounted for 15% of the temporal variation in fish community and was the most limiting factor in the most heavily polluted river reach. Low flow conditions increased risk of pollutant accumulation, flood conditions increased both pollutant accumulations and introduced non-point source pollution risks; there were non-additive coupled interactions between flow and water quality. Benthic resident fish had higher tolerance to composite stress while pelagic and migratory fish had higher sensitivity to hydrological/water quality co-stress. Single factor regulation would hardly be enough to restore fish communities, coordinated regulation of flow regime and water environment was needed. This paper offers scientific evidence for watershed ecological controls and fish biodiversity conservation under various human disturbances.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于黄河下游2014–2023年多年野外监测数据，分析了河流流量与水质对淡水鱼类种群动态的独立及交互影响。流量变化解释鱼类群落时间变异的21%，显著影响产卵 cues、栖息地可用性及生理代谢；水质解释15%，在污染最重河段为最主要限制因子。低流量加剧污染物累积风险，洪水条件同时增加污染物累积与面源污染风险，流量与水质间存在非加性耦合交互作用。底栖定居性鱼类对复合胁迫耐受性较高，而中上层及洄游性鱼类对水文-水质协同胁迫更敏感，单一因子调控难以恢复鱼类群落，需流量情势与水环境协同调控。

papers.title: Effect of Digital Extension and E-Learning Intervention and  Adoption Among Cassava and Fish Farmers in Bayelsa State
papers.authors: Ugo, Panebi
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF AGRICULTURE AND EARTH SCIENCE
papers.abstract: This research investigated the effects of digital extension and e-learning intervention and adoption among cassava and fish farmers in Bayelsa State. A quasi-experimental design incorporating pre test and post-test assessments was employed, involving 240 active smallholder farmers selected from Yenagoa, Ogbia and Sagbama Local Government Areas. Agricultural advisory content was delivered through WhatsApp groups, Interactive Voice Response (IVR) and YouTube videos over a twelve-week period. The data obtained were subjected to descriptive and inferential statistical analyses. The results indicated that farmers’ technical knowledge improved after the interventions. Cassava and fish farmers acknowledged the positive contributions of the interventions, with fish farmers expressing greater perceived benefits. The interventions also shaped production decisions and farm management practices, particularly in fertiliser and feed application, input selection, disease control and weed management. Technology adoption emerged as a significant predictor of changes in farmers’ practices after the interventions. Nevertheless, inconsistent mobile network connectivity, expensive data subscriptions, unreliable electricity and inadequate digital literacy limited effective engagement. The research concluded that digital extension and e-learning interventions offer opportunities for enhancing agricultural knowledge dissemination and improving farming practices. It recommended the establishment of public–private partnerships to improve rural network infrastructure and provide subsidised data packages for farmers.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用准实验设计，在巴耶尔萨州三个地方政府区的240名木薯和养鱼小农中，通过WhatsApp群组、交互式语音应答（IVR）和YouTube视频开展为期12周的数字化推广与e-learning干预，评估其对农户技术知识和生产行为的影响。结果显示干预后农户技术知识显著提升，养鱼户感知收益高于木薯种植户，干预还影响了施肥与投饵、投入品选择、病害控制和杂草管理等生产决策。技术采纳是干预后农户实践变化的重要预测因子，但移动网络不稳定、数据资费高、电力不可靠和数字素养不足制约了有效参与。研究建议通过公私合作改善农村网络基础设施并提供补贴数据套餐。

papers.title: Effect of Foxtail Millet (Setaria italica) Cookies Fortified with Mackerel Fish Flour on the Nutritional Status of Pregnant Women with Chronic Energy Deficiency.
papers.authors: riskawati syamsul, dian; salam, abdul; Khuzaimah, Anna
papers.abstract: associated with poor maternal nutritional status, anemia, and adverse birth outcomes. Food-based supplementation using locally available nutrient-dense ingredients, such as foxtail millet (Setaria italica) and mackerel fish, may provide a sustainable strategy to improve maternal nutrition. To evaluate the effectiveness of foxtail millet flour cookies fortified with mackerel fish flour in improving body weight, mid-upper arm circumference (MUAC), and hemoglobin levels among pregnant women with CED. A quasi-experimental study using a non-randomized pretest–posttest control group design was conducted among 40 pregnant women with CED selected through purposive sampling. Participants were allocated to an intervention group (n = 20), which received foxtail millet flour cookies fortified with mackerel fish flour, or a control group (n = 20), which received foxtail millet flour cookies without mackerel fish flour, for 90 days. Body weight, MUAC, and hemoglobin levels were measured at baseline and after the intervention. Between-group differences in changes from baseline were analyzed using the Mann–Whitney U test. After 90 days, participants in the intervention group experienced significantly greater increases in body weight (7.95 vs. 5.00 kg, p = 0.001), MUAC (2.09 vs. 2.02 cm, p = 0.035), and hemoglobin concentration (1.64 vs. 1.24 g/dL, p = 0.003) compared with the control group. Foxtail millet cookies fortified with mackerel fish flour were more effective than non-fortified foxtail millet cookies in improving maternal nutritional status, as reflected by greater increases in body weight, MUAC, and hemoglobin levels among pregnant women with CED. These findings support the use of locally sourced, nutrient-rich supplementary foods as a practical strategy to address maternal undernutrition in resource-limited settings
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了强化鲭鱼鱼粉的谷子（Setaria italica）饼干对慢性能量缺乏（CED）孕妇营养状况的改善效果。采用非随机前后测对照组准实验设计，40名CED孕妇分为干预组（强化鱼粉饼干）和对照组（未强化饼干），干预90天。结果显示，干预组体重增加（7.95 vs. 5.00 kg）、上臂围（MUAC）增长（2.09 vs. 2.02 cm）及血红蛋白升高（1.64 vs. 1.24 g/dL）均显著优于对照组。表明强化鲭鱼鱼粉的谷子饼干可有效改善CED孕妇的营养状况，支持在资源有限地区推广本地营养强化补充食品。

papers.title: Fish oil enhances trans-endothelial fatty acids transport and lipid deposition in skeletal muscle by promoting muscular VEGF-B expression via GPR120-CaMKK2-AMPK pathway
papers.authors: Luo, Meiying; Liu, Jinhao; Wang, Junfeng; Cai, Lilin; Fu, Yiming; Liang, Shuyi; Liu, Shuai; Pan, Zhe; Liu, Shilong; Yu, Xiaolei
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨鱼油通过GPR120-CaMKK2-AMPK通路促进骨骼肌VEGF-B表达，从而增强脂肪酸跨内皮转运及肌肉脂质沉积的机制。

papers.title: In silico Acute Toxicity Prediction of Dimethyl Phthalate on Fish as Per Simulated Molecular Descriptors
papers.authors: Banerjee, Rituparna; Kanti Roy, Pranab; Nath Talapatra, Soumendra
papers.journal: International Journal of Science and Research (IJSR)
