papers.title: Temporal Turnover Outweighs Spatial Differences in The Fish  Assemblage of a Peri-Urban Tidal River During the Early Rainy  Season: The Egbelu Reach of The New Calabar River, Niger  Delta, Nigeria
papers.authors: Chimela, Wala
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF AGRICULTURE AND EARTH SCIENCE
papers.abstract: Tidal rivers that pass through growing Niger Delta towns sustain artisanal fisheries, but surveys rarely collect fish and water quality data at the same places and times. We sampled three stations on the Egbelu reach of the New Calabar River, Rivers State, Nigeria, each month from May to July 2026. On every visit we measured eleven physico-chemical variables and caught fish with gill nets, cast nets and hooks. Salinity, conductivity and total dissolved solids differed among stations (p < 0.001), while only temperature and pH changed from month to month. Dissolved oxygen (6.50–6.80 mg L−1) and BOD5 (2.50–2.80 mg L−1) pointed to well oxygenated water with modest organic loading. We caught 1,533 fish belonging to 20 species and 11 families. Cichlidae made up 28.6% of individuals, Clupeidae 16.0% and Alestidae 11.4%, and Sarotherodon melanotheron was the most abundant species (12.5%). Every species turned up at every station, diversity was almost the same everywhere (H′ = 2.91–2.93; J′ = 0.97–0.98), and Bray–Curtis similarity was above 92%. Sampling month, on the other hand, explained 81% of the variation in assemblage composition (PERMANOVA, pseudo-F = 11.04, p = 0.028), against only 4% for station (p = 0.861). Mugil cephalus, Neochelon falcipinnis, Elops lacerta and other marine-associated species declined from May to July, as Brycinus spp., Hemichromis fasciatus and Chrysichthys nigrodigitatus became more common. In the early rainy season, then, the assemblage changed far more over time than across space, and monitoring of the reach should follow the seasonal cycle rather than add stations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究于2026年5–7月在尼日利亚新卡拉巴尔河Egbelu河段设三个站点，同步采集鱼类与水质数据，以解析城市近郊潮汐河流鱼类群落的时空动态。共记录20种11科1533尾鱼，各站点物种组成高度相似（Bray–Curtis相似性>92%），多样性指数几乎无空间差异。采样月份解释了群落组成变异的81%（PERMANOVA，p=0.028），而站点仅解释4%（p=0.861），表明时间更替远大于空间差异；海洋关联种（Mugil cephalus、Neochelon falcipinnis、Elops lacerta）随雨季推进而减少。作者建议该河段的监测应遵循季节周期而非增设站点。

papers.title: Determinants of Technical Efficiency in Nigerian Catfish Aquaculture: Stochastic Frontier Evidence and Policy Implications
papers.authors: Adewale, Caleb I.; Deb, Uttam
papers.abstract: Abstract Aquaculture has become an essential sector in Nigeria’s agriculture, significantly contributing to food security, rural employment, and economic diversification. Despite the sector’s rapid growth, Nigeria’s aquaculture industry operates below its potential, with technical efficiency levels far from optimal. This study assesses the determinants of technical efficiency among catfish farmers in Nigeria, using secondary data from a survey of 604 farmers. The result indicate that, despite significant growth in Nigeria’s aquaculture sector, technical efficiency remains suboptimal, with farmers operating at about 67% of their potential output. Using a stochastic frontier production function, we identify key factors affecting productivity and efficiency, including fish stock, household size, culture type, management system, and membership in farmers’ associations. The study highlights the need for targeted policies to enhance resource utilization, promote diversified farming practices, and support farmer associations to optimize technical efficiency in Nigeria’s catfish farming sector. These findings have important implications for improving productivity and ensuring food security in the country.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于604户尼日利亚鲶鱼养殖户的调查数据，采用 stochastic frontier production function 评估其技术效率的决定因素。结果显示养殖户仅发挥约67%的潜在产出，技术效率欠佳；鱼种存量、家庭规模、养殖类型、管理系统及养殖者协会 membership 是影响生产率与效率的关键因素。研究建议通过针对性政策优化资源配置、推广多元化养殖模式并支持养殖者协会，以提升尼日利亚鲶鱼养殖的技术效率与粮食安全保障水平。

papers.title: Water Quality Regulation and Stocking-Ratio Assessment in a Black Seabream–Mussel–Seaweed Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture System
papers.authors: Gao, Linxi; Zhang, Jianlin; Zhang, Jun; Wang, Jiaying; Qian, Sihao; He, Peimin; Wu, Meiqin
papers.abstract: Integrated multi-trophic aquaculture (IMTA) combines fed and extractive species, yet appropriate biomass allocation among trophic groups remains poorly defined. This study investigated water quality regulation and stocking biomass ratios in a black seabream (Acanthopagrus schlegelii)–mussel (Mytilus coruscus)–seaweed (Ulva lactuca) IMTA system. Sequential monoculture, two-species, and three-species experiments were conducted in 300 L aquaria over 15 days, with three replicates per treatment. Black seabream monoculture increased NH4+-N and PO43−-P accumulation relative to controls, whereas U. lactuca reduced dissolved nutrient concentrations. Fish–mussel co-culture did not prevent nutrient accumulation, while increasing fish biomass in fish–seaweed co-culture was associated with greater nutrient accumulation and lower seaweed RGR, which may have also been influenced by direct grazing by black seabream. Conversely, seaweed relative growth rate (RGR) increased with mussel biomass in mussel–seaweed co-culture. Among three-species treatments, FMU1 (80 g fish, 600 g mussels, and 150 g seaweed; initial biomass ratio 1:7.5:1.875) showed the best overall balance among the three tested fish biomass levels under the experimental conditions. After 15 days, NH4+-N decreased by 41.18% in FMU1 but increased by 15.91% and 61.65% in FMU2 and FMU3, respectively. These findings highlight the importance of balancing fish loading with extractive biomass to improve water quality regulation and sustain seaweed growth in coastal IMTA systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过15天300 L水族箱实验，探讨黑鲷（Acanthopagrus schlegelii）–贻贝（Mytilus coruscus）–石莼（Ulva lactuca）IMTA系统的水质调控与放养生物量配比。结果表明，黑鲷单养增加NH4+-N和PO43−-P积累，石莼可降低溶解态营养盐浓度；鱼–贻贝共养未能阻止营养盐积累，而鱼–藻共养中鱼生物量增加伴随营养盐积累加剧和藻类RGR下降。三物种处理中FMU1（鱼80 g、贻贝600 g、石莼150 g，初始生物量比1:7.5:1.875）综合平衡最佳，15天后NH4+-N下降41.18%，而FMU2和FMU3分别上升15.91%和61.65%。研究强调沿海IMTA系统中需平衡鱼类负载与提取性生物量以改善水质调控并维持藻类生长。

papers.title: Drone-Based IoT System for Spatial Monitoring of Pond Water Quality for Precision Aquaculture
papers.authors: V. B. C. Sekararao, Kurada; Palacherla, Venkatrao
papers.abstract: Aquaculture is an important source of food, employment and economic development, but maintaining appropriate water quality remains a major challenge for farmers. Parameters like temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen (DO), turbidity and salinity have significant effects on the growth, health, feeding efficiency and survival of aquatic organisms. Traditional monitoring relies mainly on manual sampling and periodic measurements, which is time-consuming and may not provide sufficient spatial and temporal information for precision aquaculture. This paper proposes an IoT-based mobile water-quality monitoring architecture with an unmanned aerial vehicle UAV (drone) integrated with an autonomous autopilot system. The system receives the registered GPS coordinates of an aquaculture pond and automatically navigates the UAV to the pond for measurement. When the UAV arrives at the pond, it visits several preselected sites and submerges a detachable multi-parameter sensing module to collect the water-quality parameters. An embedded controller processes the sensor data and transmits the measurements, GPS coordinates and time stamps to a cloud database via wireless communication. One mobile sensing unit can monitor multiple ponds and form a spatially indexed historical database of water quality. The architecture lays a foundation for AI-based anomaly detection, water-quality prediction, disease-risk assessment, and intelligent decision support for precision aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 针对传统池塘水质监测依赖人工采样、时空信息不足的问题，提出一种基于IoT的移动水质监测架构，将无人机（UAV）与自主飞控系统集成，可按预设GPS坐标自动巡航至池塘并下放可拆卸多参数传感模块，采集温度、pH、溶解氧（DO）、浊度及盐度等指标，经嵌入式控制器处理后通过无线通信将测量值、GPS坐标与时间戳上传至云数据库。单套移动传感单元可服务多个池塘，形成空间索引的水质历史数据库，为基于AI的异常检测、水质预测、疾病风险评估及精准水产养殖智能决策支持奠定基础。

papers.title: Effects of commercial scale bivalve aquaculture on the microbial carbon pump: implications for climate change mitigation
papers.authors: Tan, Karsoon; Wu, Zhou; Li, Zexin
papers.abstract: The ocean, the world's largest carbon pool, plays a critical role in regulating the global climate. Within this system, the microbial carbon pump (MCP) is a key mechanism for long-term carbon sequestration, converting organic carbon into diverse and structurally complex dissolved molecules that persist in the environment. Despite the dramatic expansion of bivalve aquaculture in recent decades, its contribution to carbon sequestration through the MCP remains poorly understood and understudied. This article critically assesses the impact of bivalve aquaculture on the carbon cycle, particularly its role in enhancing the MCP. Bivalve aquaculture influences the carbon cycle in several ways. First, it increases dissolved organic carbon (DOC) in surrounding waters through direct excretion by bivalves and enhances primary productivity, particularly in oligotrophic waters. These changes boost microbial biomass and may potentially accelerate the production of recalcitrant dissolved organic carbon (RDOC), a key component of long-term carbon storage; however, increased DOC release and microbial activity do not by themselves demonstrate RDOC production, and direct evidence from bivalve aquaculture is currently lacking. Second, intensive bivalve aquaculture alters phytoplankton community structure, shifting dominance from diatoms to cyanobacteria and picophytoplankton. These smaller phytoplankton groups tend to release more RDOC into the environment compared to diatoms and microphytoplankton, further contributing to carbon sequestration. By elucidating the mechanisms through which bivalve aquaculture enhances carbon sequestration via the MCP, this article provides valuable insights for developing sustainable bivalve fisheries and aquaculture management strategies. Such strategies can harness the potential of bivalve aquaculture to mitigate climate change impacts while supporting global food security.
papers.summary_cn: 本文评估商业规模双壳类养殖对微生物碳泵（MCP）的影响及其在气候变化缓解中的潜在作用。双壳类养殖通过直接排泄增加水体溶解有机碳（DOC）并提升初级生产力，可能促进惰性溶解有机碳（RDOC）生成，但目前缺乏直接证据。养殖还改变浮游植物群落结构，由硅藻向蓝细菌和超微型浮游植物转变，后者倾向于释放更多RDOC，从而增强碳封存。研究为可持续双壳类渔业与养殖管理策略提供了理论依据。

papers.title: Temporal dynamics of coral bleaching and live coral cover at the Cayman Crown Reef, Gulf of Honduras (2016–2025)
papers.authors: Giró Petersen, Ana; Mojica, Ángela María; Muñiz-Castillo, Aarón Israel; McField, Melanie
papers.abstract: Located in the Gulf of Honduras between Guatemala and southern Belize, Cayman Crown (Corona Caimán) is a recently documented offshore coral reef system of high geomorphological complexity lying at the terminus of the deep Cayman Trench. The reef is characterized by extensive spur-and-groove formations and steep vertical walls descending from 10–30 m to depths exceeding 300 m. Despite its offshore location, Cayman Crown has historically supported among the highest live coral cover recorded across the Mesoamerican Reef (24-50%), consistently corresponding to good (≥20%) to very good (≥40%) live coral cover, under the Reef Health Index. However, the reef has been exposed to intensifying thermal stress across three successive bleaching events. It remains unknown whether this offshore reef can retain its capacity to recover under repeated thermal stress, as multi-event, site-level records of bleaching and recovery are lacking for this reef system. Here, we assess bleaching severity, mortality, and recovery across four sites spanning three bleaching events from 2016 to 2025. The highest Bleaching Severity Index (BSI) values were recorded during the 3.5 Regional Coral Bleaching Event (RCBE), 2019–2021; with a BSI of 54–59% and peak DHW ~10 °C-weeks, followed by the Fourth Global Coral Bleaching Event (GCBE), 2023–2025; with a BSI: 25–41% and peak DHW ~19 °C-weeks, and moderate values during the Third GCBE, 2014–2017; with a BSI: 25–30% and peak DHW ~8 °C-weeks. Following the 2019 bleaching, corals recovered nearly completely, demonstrating strong short-term post-disturbance resilience. In contrast, consecutive bleaching during the Fourth GCBE resulted in approximately 29% overall coral mortality and persistent residual bleaching extending into the February 2025 post-disturbance survey (BSI: 4–10%). The 2023–24 bleaching caused pronounced live coral cover losses, particularly at Corona Caimán Valle de Aga CC01 (50.3% to 34.1%) and Corona Caimán Bajón GT008 (35.7% to 22.5%), while Corona Caimán 2 CC02 showed a slight increase (24.7% to 28.3%), indicating variability in site-level responses. These findings are consistent with projections of increasing marine heatwave frequency, under which reefs would experience repeated bleaching with shorter recovery windows. The transition from near-complete recovery following a single acute bleaching disturbance to measurable colony mortality under consecutive bleaching events suggests that repeated heat stress may erode the resilience of even offshore reefs.
papers.summary_cn: 洪都拉斯湾Cayman Crown珊瑚礁2016–2025年间经历三次白化事件，研究评估了四个站点的白化严重程度、死亡率和恢复情况。2019–2021年第三次区域珊瑚白化事件期间Bleaching Severity Index（BSI）最高（54–59%，峰值DHW约10 °C-weeks），白化后珊瑚近乎完全恢复，显示较强的短期恢复力；而2023–2025年第四次全球珊瑚白化事件连续白化导致约29%的珊瑚死亡及持续残留白化，活珊瑚覆盖率显著下降（如CC01站点从50.3%降至34.1%），但站点间响应存在差异。结果表明，重复热胁迫下恢复窗口缩短，可能侵蚀即使离岸珊瑚礁的resilience。

papers.title: Integrating TPB and NAM to explain organic aquaculture transition intentions: evidence from Thanh Hoa, Vietnam
papers.authors: Ngo, Thi My Thuy; Do, Man Thi
papers.journal: Journal of Agribusiness in Developing and Emerging Economies
papers.abstract: Purpose This study examines aquaculture households' intentions to transition to organic aquaculture in Thanh Hoa, Vietnam. Building on the theory of planned behavior (TPB) and the norm activation model (NAM), the study distinguishes perceived benefits into economic and non-economic dimensions, incorporates moral norm as an internal moral consideration and examines the moderating role of subjective norm in the relationship between moral norm and transition intention. Design/methodology/approach A quantitative research design was employed using survey data collected from 323 aquaculture households in Thanh Hoa, Vietnam. The proposed model was tested using partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) to examine the hypothesized direct, indirect and moderating relationships. Findings Perceived economic benefits, perceived non-economic benefits, subjective norm, perceived behavioral control and moral norm are positively associated with transition intention, with moral norm showing the strongest association. Moral norm is positively associated with perceived non-economic benefits but not with perceived economic benefits, indicating a distinction between the two dimensions of perceived benefits. In addition, the interaction between subjective norm and moral norm is positive and statistically significant, indicating that the positive relationship between moral norm and transition intention becomes stronger as subjective norm increases. Research limitations/implications This study is limited by its cross-sectional design and its focus on transition intention rather than actual behavior. The model also does not fully account for socio-demographic, structural and institutional factors that may affect the intention–behavior gap. Future research should use longitudinal data, incorporate these external constraints, examine mechanisms that may bridge the intention–behavior gap and test the model across different geographical contexts. Originality/value This study extends behavioral research on organic aquaculture in three respects. First, it distinguishes perceived economic and non-economic benefits to provide a more differentiated understanding of benefit-related considerations associated with transition intention. Second, building on TPB and NAM, it examines subjective norm not only as a direct predictor of intention but also as a moderator of the relationship between moral norm and transition intention. Third, by applying this framework to aquaculture households in Thanh Hoa, Vietnam, the study provides context-specific insights for policymakers, extension agencies and other stakeholders in designing policies and support programs for organic aquaculture transition.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于计划行为理论（TPB）与规范激活模型（NAM），以越南清化省323个水产养殖户为样本，采用PLS-SEM检验其向有机水产养殖转型的意愿。结果表明，感知经济效益、感知非经济效益、主观规范、感知行为控制与道德规范均正向影响转型意愿，其中道德规范关联最强；道德规范仅与感知非经济效益正相关，且主观规范正向调节道德规范与转型意愿的关系。研究为有机水产养殖转型政策设计提供了差异化效益认知与道德-社会规范交互作用的实证依据。

papers.title: Sub-ice thermal gradients strongly influence winter depth use of an iconic cold-water fish
papers.authors: Shi, Lidi; Wells, Mathew G.; Ridgway, Mark S.; Dunlop, Erin S.; McMeans, Bailey C.; Fisk, Aaron T.; Blanchfield, Paul J.; Cooke, Steven J.; Rennie, Michael D.; Young, Joelle D.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: In a thermally stratified lake, freshwater fish select habitats that align with their thermal preferences. While most studies of dimictic lakes have focused on habitat selection during summer stratification, less attention has been given to winter when inverse thermal stratification occurs with water temperatures between 0 to 4 °C. Our results show that winter thermal stratifications vary considerably among lakes. Much of the variation in winter depth use by the cold-water predator, Lake Trout ( Salvelinus namaycush ), can be explained by the depth of the 2 °C isotherm. Selection ratios further support preferential use of this thermal boundary after accounting for habitat availability. Larger, shallower, and windier lakes tend to exhibit colder mean temperatures near 0 °C and deeper isotherms, typically within the 1 to 2 °C range. In contrast, deeper or more sheltered lakes maintained warmer temperatures close to 4 °C and a shallower 2 °C isotherm. Using multiyear acoustic telemetry of Lake Trout from 11 different lakes, we found that in warmer lakes with depth-averaged temperatures above 2 °C, Lake Trout used thermal habitat averaging 2.6 ± 0.6 °C, which occurred in relatively shallow depths (0.1 to 11.3 m). In contrast, in the one large, shallow lake studied, where maximum water temperatures were below 2 °C, Lake Trout occupied the deepest waters during winter (16.8 to 26.4 m) and experienced average temperatures of 1.5 ± 0.4 °C. Applying our model to 877,927 Canadian and Alaskan lakes predicted a roughly even split between warm and cold winter conditions; however, 73% of the 66,500 known Lake Trout lakes exhibited warmer winter conditions, where Lake Trout would occupy the upper water column during winter.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于11个湖泊的多年声学遥测数据，探讨冬季逆温分层下湖鳟（Lake Trout）深度利用与热梯度的关系。结果表明，2 °C等温线深度可解释湖鳟冬季深度利用的大部分变异，且其偏好利用该热边界。较大、较浅、风浪较强的湖泊近表层温度接近0 °C且等温线较深，而较深或遮蔽良好的湖泊温度接近4 °C且2 °C等温线较浅；在平均温度高于2 °C的湖泊中湖鳟利用约2.6 °C的浅层热栖息地，而在最大水温低于2 °C的浅湖中则占据最深水域。模型预测加拿大和阿拉斯加湖泊冷暖冬季条件大致各半，但73%的已知湖鳟湖泊为暖冬季条件。

papers.title: Two snapshots of fish diversity and body size in an Amazonian market
papers.authors: Bartolotta, Lilia R.; Fasulo, Nicholas J.; Kapusinsky, Collin J.; Madigosky, Stephen R.; Swierk, Lindsey
papers.abstract: Tropical freshwater fisheries support both biodiversity and human livelihoods, yet long-term fishery characteristics data remain scarce across much of the Amazon Basin. Fish markets offer an opportunity to assess patterns in fish diversity and body sizes from exploited aquatic communities. Fish diversity and body sizes (standard length; SL) of common, locally harvested fish sold in Mercado Belén, Iquitos (Peruvian Amazon), were measured using photographic surveys conducted 11 years apart, in 2008 and 2019. Mean SL of the 10 most abundant species or genera differed significantly between these two years for seven taxa, increasing in five taxa (including Prochilodus nigricans and Plagioscion squamosissimus ) and decreasing in two, notably in a large, predatory Cichla sp. Taxonomic richness and diversity showed small declines between these two years. Minor differences in community composition were observed between years, but the dominant taxa were similar. These two time points serve as a baseline for future comparisons and by themselves do not demonstrate temporal or regional trends. Market surveys provide a useful, low-cost complement to field-based ecological studies in tropical freshwater ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用相隔11年（2008年和2019年）的摄影调查，评估秘鲁亚马逊Iquitos的Belén市场中常见捕捞鱼类的多样性和体长（SL）。10个最丰富物种或属中有7个类群的平均SL在两年间差异显著，5个类群体长增加（包括Prochilodus nigricans和Plagioscion squamosissimus），2个类群体长减小，尤其是大型捕食性Cichla sp.。分类丰富度和多样性略有下降，群落组成年际差异较小但优势类群相似。该研究为未来比较提供基线，并表明市场调查是热带淡水生态系统野外生态学研究的低成本补充手段。

papers.title: Dopaminergic stimulation of intestinal maltase activity in the freshwater fish Oligosarcus jenynsii
papers.authors: Albanesi, Camila; Domanski, Dardo; Michiels, Maria Soledad
papers.abstract: Intestinal disaccharidases are key determinants of carbohydrate assimilation in fish. Here, we characterized maltase and sucrase activity in juveniles of Oligosarcus jenynsii (Günther, 1864) and evaluated the modulation of maltase activity by dopamine. Maltase activity was detected across a broad pH (6.0–8.0) and temperature (4–45 °C) range and followed Michaelis–Menten kinetics (Km :1.22 mM), whereas sucrase activity was not detected. In vitro assays showed that dopamine significantly stimulated maltase activity in a concentration-dependent manner, with increases at 10-4 and 10-3 M. This stimulatory effect was not observed in the presence of the D1 receptor antagonist SCH-23390 or the D2 receptor antagonist chlorpromazine. These results demonstrate that intestinal maltase activity is responsive to dopaminergic stimulation under in vitro conditions and suggest the participation of dopaminergic pathways in this response. The physiological significance of this modulation in vivo remains to be established. These findings contribute to the understanding of the biochemical regulation of intestinal disaccharidases in a freshwater fish species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究表征了淡水鱼Oligosarcus jenynsii幼鱼的肠道二糖酶活性，并评估多巴胺对maltase活性的调控作用。结果显示maltase在pH 6.0–8.0和4–45 °C范围内均有活性，符合Michaelis–Menten动力学（Km 1.22 mM），而未检测到sucrase活性。体外实验表明多巴胺以浓度依赖方式显著刺激maltase活性（10⁻⁴和10⁻³ M），该效应可被D1受体拮抗剂SCH-23390和D2受体拮抗剂氯丙嗪阻断，提示多巴胺能通路参与该调控，但其体内生理意义尚待阐明。

papers.title: Strengthening the Mandiri Consumer Cooperative through Grade C Fish Valorization: A Community Empowerment Program for Fermented Feed Production in Belitung, Indonesia
papers.authors: Mayasari, Dessy; Lokantara, I Gede Wyana
papers.journal: Journal of Universal Community Empowerment Provision
papers.abstract: The Consumer Cooperative Usaha Mandiri in Tanjung Binga Village, Belitung Regency, encounters challenges in valorizing underutilized grade C fish catches, while local livestock farmers remain reliant on relatively expensive commercial feed sourced externally. This community engagement initiative sought to enhance cooperative capacity by converting low-value fish resources into fermented feed ingredients within a circular economy framework. Conducted over eight months, the program utilized a participatory approach that included needs assessment, community engagement, technical training, technology transfer, production trials, and ongoing institutional mentoring. The initiative's unique contribution is the integration of fish boiling, rice bran addition, brown sugar and EM4 supplementation, anaerobic fermentation, and product development into a cooperative-based fish valorization model. The intervention enabled the transformation of underutilized fish resources into value-added feed products and strengthened members' technical skills and business management practices, particularly in financial record-keeping, production planning, and market development. Laboratory analysis indicated an energy content of 392 kcal, protein content of 73.97 g, fat content of 8.97 g, and carbohydrate content of 3.93 g per 100 g. This initiative provides a foundation for reinforcing local value chains that connect fisheries, cooperatives, and livestock production. Future initiatives should focus on formulation standardization, nutritional validation, feed safety assessment, economic feasibility, and regulatory compliance to ensure product quality and long-term business sustainability.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在通过将低值C级渔获转化为发酵饲料原料，提升印尼勿里洞Tanjung Binga村Usaha Mandiri消费合作社的能力，缓解当地养殖户对高价外购商业饲料的依赖。项目历时八个月，采用参与式方法开展需求评估、技术培训、技术转移、生产试验和机构辅导，将煮鱼、米糠、红糖及EM4添加与厌氧发酵相结合，构建合作社为基础的鱼类增值模式。实验室分析显示产品含能量392 kcal、蛋白质73.97 g、脂肪8.97 g、碳水化合物3.93 g（每100 g），并提升了成员在财务记录、生产计划和市场开发方面的能力。后续需聚焦配方标准化、营养验证、饲料安全评估、经济可行性及法规合规，以保障产品质量与业务可持续性。

papers.authors: Yao, Yuefei; Li, Fei; Zhu, Chao; Jiang, Wenping; Chi, Meili; Liu, Shili; Cheng, Shun; Luo, Junzhi; Zheng, Jianbo; Zhang, Haiqi
papers.abstract: Mandarin fish ( Siniperca chuatsi ) is an economically important freshwater aquaculture species in China, yet the maternal genetic composition of cultured stocks from different regions remains insufficiently characterized. To assess maternal genetic diversity and population structure, 120 individuals were sampled from one wild-origin population from Huzhou, Zhejiang Province (ZJHZ), and three cultured populations from Chizhou, Anhui Province (AHCZ), Wuhan, Hubei Province (HBWH), and Jiangmen, Guangdong Province (GDJM). Mitochondrial D-loop sequencing generated 118 high-quality sequences and identified 22 haplotypes. Haplotype diversity ranged from 0.543 to 0.805, and nucleotide diversity from 0.00604 to 0.01095. Three common haplotypes were shared by all four populations and represented 94 of the 118 individuals, whereas most remaining haplotypes were population-specific and occurred at low frequencies. AMOVA attributed 94.17% of the mitochondrial variation to within-population differences and 5.83% to among-population differences, with the among-population component being statistically significant (FST = 0.05831, P = 0.00196). Pairwise FST tests detected significant maternal differentiation between GDJM and each of the other three populations, whereas differentiation among AHCZ, ZJHZ, and HBWH was generally low. Overall, the four populations shared a broad maternal genetic background while retaining low-frequency variation within individual stocks. These findings provide population-specific baseline information for maternal-lineage identification and female broodstock management in S. chuatsi . However, mitochondrial D-loop data do not capture paternal contributions or genome-wide diversity. Broader geographic sampling combined with genome-wide nuclear markers and pedigree information will therefore be required for a comprehensive assessment of broodstock genetic structure.
papers.summary_cn: 研究对鳜（Siniperca chuatsi）1个野生群体（浙江湖州）和3个养殖群体（安徽池州、湖北武汉、广东江门）共120个个体进行线粒体D-loop测序，获得118条高质量序列和22个单倍型，单倍型多样性为0.543~0.805，核苷酸多样性为0.00604~0.01095。3个共同单倍型为4个群体共享，涵盖118个个体中的94个，其余多为群体特异低频单倍型。AMOVA显示94.17%的变异来自群体内，群体间分化显著（FST=0.05831，P=0.00196），其中GDJM与其他3个群体间存在显著母系分化，而AHCZ、ZJHZ与HBWH间分化较低。研究为鳜母系溯源和雌性亲本管理提供了群体特异性基线资料，但作者指出线粒体D-loop数据无法反映父系贡献和全基因组多样性，需结合核基因组标记和系谱信息进一步评估。

papers.title: Material-dependent effects of fish-scale-derived nano-hydroxyapatite on the mechanical, physicochemical, and optical properties of conventional glass ionomer cements
papers.authors: Abozaid, Dina; El-Aal, Mohamed Abd; Ahmed, Mohammed H.; Azab, Amr; Alhotan, Abdulaziz; Mohamed, Pansai A.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究评估鱼鳞来源纳米羟基磷灰石（nano-hydroxyapatite）对传统玻璃离子水门汀（glass ionomer cement）力学、理化及光学性能的材料依赖性影响，属牙科修复材料领域，与渔业科学无关。

papers.title: Socio-Economic Characteristics and Constraints of Fish Farmers in Three Agricultural Zones of Imo State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Agbabiaka, C. N.
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF AGRICULTURE AND EARTH SCIENCE
papers.abstract: This study assessed the socioeconomic characteristics and constraints confronting fish farmers in three agricultural zones (Owerri, Orlu and Okigwe), of Imo State, Nigeria. Targeted population were fish farmers whose sources of livelihood were from fish farming using earthen and concrete ponds fish culture system. A structured close-ended questionnaires were administered, in a random sampling procedure to a total of one hundred and twenty (120) fish farmers who were selected for the study, with forty (40) each from the three agricultural zones in Imo State. Items on the questionnaires were organized, categorized and coded correctly. Data were analyzed using Statistical Package for Social Sciences (IBM/SPSS) software version 22.0. The results obtained indicated that majority of the fish farmers were male (75%) across the three zones indicating gender disparities which may be due to land tenure system. The active workforce is within the age bracket of 40-49 years (35%). Majority of the farmers are married and has large family size. In terms of tenancy, it was observed that most of the farmers are tenants in Owerri unlike the other zones. It was also observed that (38%) of the fish farmers possess tertiary education certificate. In the study area, 13% of the respondents identified lack of storage facilities for fish products as a constraint, In addition, 73% of the respondents attributed poor power supply as a challenge confronting them in the aquaculture operations in the study area. Similarly, 67%) of the respondents ascribed inability to access loans or credit facilities as one of the challenges facing aquaculture. Besides, 83% and 92% of the respondents ascribed high cost of feed and inadequate capital respectively as major challenges confronting aquaculture activities in these area. While 13%, 20% and 23% of the respondents believed that poaching, high cost of land and high cost of fingerlings respectively were the challenges confronting them in fish farming. Moreover, poor pricing of harvested fish (30%), poor water supply (13%) and lack of technical skills (87%) were some of other significant (p < 0.05) constraints faced by fish farmers in the studied areas in Imo State. Therefore to enhance the development of aquaculture in the state, measures should be taken to reduce the cost of fish production through subsidizing cost of inputs, giving grants, organizing workshops, trainings, seminars, field days, radio programs and the use of Extension Agents (EAs). The state government through the Imo State Ministry of Agriculture can establish Fish Demonstration Farms in the three agricultural zones to serve as fish skill acquisition farms, for regular training of fish farmers in the state. All these will definitely assist in the development of aquaculture in Imo State
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了尼日利亚伊莫州三个农业区（Owerri、Orlu、Okigwe）养殖渔民的社会经济特征与制约因素，采用结构化问卷对120名以池塘养殖为生的渔民进行随机抽样分析。结果显示，渔民以男性为主（75%），主力劳动力年龄为40~49岁，38%具有高等教育学历；主要制约因素包括饲料成本高（83%）、资金不足（92%）、缺乏技术技能（87%）、电力供应差（73%）及贷款渠道不畅（67%）。研究建议通过投入品补贴、培训推广及建立鱼类示范农场等措施促进该州水产养殖发展。

papers.title: Potentially Toxic Elements (PTEs) Bioaccumulation in Fish from the Aries River, Romania: Screening-Level Human Health Risk Assessment
papers.authors: Voica, Cezara; Marincas, Olivian; Gati, Gabriel; Feher, Ioana
papers.abstract: Background: The Arieș River basin in Romania is historically mining-impacted, and data on metal accumulation in its fish and the associated risk to consumers are scarce. Aims: This study investigated elemental accumulation in fish from the Arieș River and evaluated the potential health risks associated with fish consumption. Methods: A total of 40 fish representing five species were collected by angling between June and September 2025, after the legal fishing prohibition period. Eight tissues per fish (muscle, gills, liver, skin, bones, scales, eyes, and caudal fin) were analyzed by inductively coupled plasma–mass spectrometry (ICP-MS). Contamination and exposure were evaluated using the pollution index (PI), metal contamination index (MCI), estimated daily intake (EDI), target hazard quotient (THQ), and hazard index (HI) for non-carcinogenic risk, and carcinogenic risk and total carcinogenic risk (TCR) for carcinogenic risk. Species and tissue patterns were examined by multivariate analysis, including linear discriminant analysis (LDA). Results: Multivariate statistical analysis revealed distinct species- and tissue-related patterns in elemental composition. LDA differentiated species with an initial classification accuracy of 82.5% and a leave-one-out cross-validated accuracy of 72.5%, with Cr, Mn, Pb, Sr, and Ni having the highest contribution. Tissue discrimination was lower (approximately 60%), with Sr, Zn, and Cu as main discrimination variable. THQ values for individual elements and HI were below 1, indicating no appreciable non-carcinogenic risk under the assumed exposure conditions. The highest CR values were associated with Ni (nase muscle, 2.26 × 10−6) and As (nase skin, 6.28 × 10−7). TCR ranged from 3.16 × 10−7 to 3.37 × 10−6 and remained below 1 × 10−4, within the acceptable range. Conclusions: Elemental contamination in fish from the Arieș River was generally low, and species and tissue type influenced elemental composition and dietary relevance. Continued monitoring is advised, with seasonal sampling, inorganic arsenic speciation, and attention to species such as nase when assessing consumption risk.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析了罗马尼亚Arieș河5种40尾鱼8种组织中的8种潜在毒性元素（PTEs），采用ICP-MS测定并结合PI、MCI、EDI、THQ、HI及致癌风险指标进行健康风险评估。多元统计（含LDA）显示元素组成呈明显的物种和组织特异性，物种判别准确率82.5%（交叉验证72.5%），Cr、Mn、Pb、Sr、Ni贡献最大。THQ与HI均小于1，TCR为3.16×10⁻⁷~3.37×10⁻⁶，表明假定暴露条件下无显著非致癌风险，致癌风险在可接受范围内。作者建议继续开展季节性监测、无机砷形态分析，并重点关注nase等物种的消费风险。

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of the Economic Feasibility of Using Extruded Pellets and Raw Fish-Based Moist Pellets as Aquafeed in Olive Flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus) Aquaculture in South Korea
papers.authors: Kim, Nam-Lee; Hur, Sang Woo; Park, Kyoung-Il; Jeong, Seong-Mok; Choi, Ji Yong; Kim, Kang-Woong; Kim, Do-Hoon
papers.abstract: South Korea’s olive flounder aquaculture industry predominantly relies on raw fish-based moist pellets (MP), raising concerns regarding marine resource use and environmental sustainability. This study compared the growth performance and economic feasibility of extruded pellets (EP) and MP through a 12-month feeding trial conducted at two commercial olive flounder farms in Wando, South Korea. At each farm, three replicate tanks were assigned to each dietary treatment. Economic feasibility was assessed using net present value (NPV), internal rate of return (IRR), and sensitivity analyses of key production and cost variables. Final body weight and survival rate were significantly higher in the MP groups than in the EP groups at both farms. In the baseline analysis without government subsidies, Farm A recorded an NPV of USD 793,446 and an IRR of 14.1% for EP, compared with USD 2,244,588 and 28.8% for MP. At Farm B, the corresponding values were USD 705,580 and 13.1% for EP, compared with USD 2,836,482 and 34.3% for MP. Although both feeding systems were economically feasible, MP demonstrated greater economic returns, primarily due to higher growth performance and lower feed costs. These findings highlight the need to improve EP performance and cost-effectiveness while considering the long-term sustainability of aquaculture feeding strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过在南韩莞岛两个商业养殖场开展为期12个月的投喂试验，比较了挤压颗粒饲料（EP）与生鱼基湿性颗粒饲料（MP）在牙鲆（Paralichthys olivaceus）养殖中的生长性能与经济可行性，并采用净现值（NPV）、内部收益率（IRR）及敏感性分析进行评估。结果显示，两养殖场MP组的终末体重与存活率均显著高于EP组；无补贴基准情形下，养殖场A的EP与MP的NPV分别为793,446与2,244,588美元（IRR 14.1% vs 28.8%），养殖场B分别为705,580与2,836,482美元（IRR 13.1% vs 34.3%）。两种投喂方式均经济可行，但MP因生长性能更优、饲料成本更低而经济回报更高，提示需提升EP的性能与成本效益，并兼顾养殖投喂策略的长期可持续性。

papers.title: Compositional Features and Biomedical Applications of Fish-derived Decellularized Extracellular Matrix as a Sustainable Biomaterial Platform
papers.authors: Kim, Bosong; Kim, Jinu; Yang, Yun Jung
papers.summary_cn: 该研究聚焦鱼源脱细胞细胞外基质（dECM）的组成特征及其生物医学应用，探讨其作为可持续生物材料平台的潜力。由于摘要缺失，具体方法与发现无法概述，仅从标题可知其涉及鱼源dECM的组分分析与生物医学转化方向。

papers.title: Evidence of Natural Nervous Necrosis Virus Infection in Juvenile Greenfin Horse-Faced Filefish (Thamnaconus septentrionalis) During an Aquaculture Mortality Event
papers.authors: Wang, Yu; Chen, Xiao-Ling; Qiu, Liang; Huang, Jie
papers.abstract: Viral nervous necrosis (VNN), caused by nervous necrosis virus (NNV), is a devastating viral disease affecting marine fish aquaculture worldwide, particularly during larval and juvenile stages. Although NNV has a broad and expanding host range, the susceptibility of greenfin horse-faced filefish (Thamnaconus septentrionalis) has not been established. To determine whether T. septentrionalis is susceptible to NNV, we investigated an outbreak of abnormal mortality in juveniles from a marine aquaculture farm in Rizhao, Shandong Province, China. A comprehensive etiological investigation combined bacterial isolation and identification, real-time quantitative RT-PCR (RT-qPCR), tissue-distribution analysis, histopathology, transmission electron microscopy (TEM), and RNA2-based phylogenetic analysis. Diseased fish exhibited characteristic VNN-like neurological signs, including spiral swimming, loss of equilibrium, anorexia, and body darkening. Several bacterial taxa, including Vibrio- and Tenacibaculum-related isolates, were recovered from diseased fish, indicating the possibility of bacterial involvement. However, the concurrent detection of abundant NNV RNA in neural tissues, together with characteristic neurological signs, compatible histopathological lesions, and NNV-like particles, provided convergent evidence supporting natural NNV infection. NNV RNA was detected in all ten diseased fish, whereas the other screened viral pathogens were not detected. Pooled brain–eye samples contained 4.62 × 108 to 1.33 × 109 NNV RNA copies/μg total RNA, and abundant NNV RNA was also detected in brain, spleen, kidney, and trunk tissues. Histological examination showed vacuolar and degenerative lesions in the brain and retina, and TEM revealed numerous non-enveloped, spherical virus-like particles approximately 25 nm in diameter in neural tissues, consistent with NNV morphology. Phylogenetic analysis of the RNA2 capsid protein gene placed the detected virus within the RGNNV RNA2 lineage. Together, the neurological signs, NNV RNA detection, compatible histopathological lesions, NNV-like particles in neural tissues, and RNA2 phylogenetic evidence provide evidence of natural NNV infection in T. septentrionalis. These findings document evidence of natural NNV infection in T. septentrionalis under aquaculture conditions, highlight the need for further investigations into pathogenicity and transmission, and provide a basis for VNN surveillance and biosecurity management in filefish aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 为确认绿鳍马面鲀（Thamnaconus septentrionalis）是否对 nervous necrosis virus（NNV）易感，本研究对山东日照某海水养殖场幼鱼异常死亡事件开展了病原学调查，综合采用细菌分离鉴定、RT-qPCR、组织分布分析、组织病理学、透射电镜及基于 RNA2 的系统发育分析。病鱼表现螺旋游动、失衡、厌食和体色发暗等 VNN 样神经症状，虽分离到弧菌和黄杆菌类细菌，但脑眼组织 NNV RNA 载量高达 4.62×10⁸–1.33×10⁹ copies/μg total RNA，并伴有脑和视网膜空泡变性及约 25 nm 的无囊膜球形病毒样颗粒，RNA2 系统发育分析归入 RGNNV 谱系。多项证据共同支持绿鳍马面鲀自然感染 NNV，提示需进一步研究其致病性与传播途径，并为该鱼种养殖的 VNN 监测和生物安全管理提供依据。

papers.title: Phytobiotics from the Lamiaceae, Asteraceae, and Fabaceae families: Mechanisms, efficacy, and emerging nanotechnological applications in sustainable aquaculture
papers.authors: Ashouri, Ghasem; Imperatore, Roberta; Paolucci, Marina; Hoseinifar, Seyed Hossein; Nekouei Fard, Ali; Bagherzadeh Lakani, Forouzan; Torfi Mozanzadeh, Mansour; Rezaeishoorijeh, Reyhaneh; Hoseini, Marziyeh; Ghafarifarsani, Hamed
papers.summary_cn: 该文综述唇形科、菊科和豆科植物源植物素（phytobiotics）在水产养殖中的作用机制、应用效果及纳米技术应用前景，因无摘要仅据标题简介。

papers.title: Growth Performance of Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) Cultured in a Rainwater-Harvesting Aquaculture Pond
papers.authors: Nathaniel, K. Geethanjali; Sudhakar, S.
papers.abstract: Rainwater-harvesting ponds offer opportunities for freshwater aquaculture by enabling the additional productive use of existing water-storage structures. Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) is widely cultured because of its adaptability to different freshwater environments. However, evaluating its growth under site-specific pond conditions is essential for understanding its performance and the potential suitability of rainwater-harvesting ponds for fish culture. This study described the weekly growth of Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) cultured in a rainwater-harvesting aquaculture pond at H.H. The Rajah’s College, Pudukkottai, from September 2023 to February 2024. Fish received commercial feed daily, and average body weight and body length were recorded at weekly intervals over a 24-week culture period. The initial recorded mean weight and length in Week 1 were 3.0 g and 1.5 cm, respectively. By Week 12, mean weight had increased to 110.0 g and mean length to 16.9 cm. At Week 24, the corresponding values reached 550.0 g and 30.2 cm. Across the recorded observations, average body weight increased by 547.0 g and average body length by 28.7 cm. Both measurements increased in every successive weekly record. Weight gains were smaller during the initial weeks and larger in absolute terms during the later stages, whereas increases in length followed a steadier pattern. These results document a continuous rise in mean fish size during one culture cycle in the study pond. However, the absence of a comparison pond, water-quality measurements, fish counts, variability estimates and feed-utilisation data prevents attribution of the growth pattern to the rainwater-harvesting system or assessment of production efficiency. The observations indicate that this pond supported tilapia growth during the monitored period, while further measurements would be required to evaluate broader culture performance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究记录了印度Pudukkottai地区雨水收集养殖塘中尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）24周（2023年9月至2024年2月）的周生长表现，鱼体每日投喂商业饲料并每周测定体重与体长。初始均重3.0 g、体长1.5 cm，第12周增至110.0 g和16.9 cm，第24周达550.0 g和30.2 cm，整个养殖周期体重净增547.0 g、体长净增28.7 cm，体重呈前期增长较慢、后期绝对增量较大的趋势，体长增长则较为平稳。结果表明该雨水收集塘在监测期内可支持罗非鱼持续生长，但缺乏对照塘、水质数据、放养数量、变异估计及饲料利用数据，尚无法将生长表现归因于雨水收集系统本身或评估其生产效率。

papers.title: Macrobenthic fauna associated with maërl beds near aquaculture installations in the north-eastern Corinthian Gulf, Greece, with remarks on two taxa
papers.authors: Chatzigeorgiou, Georgios; Lampa, Maria; Rallis, Ioannis; Maidanou, Maria; Naletaki, Maria; Plaitis, Wanda
papers.abstract: Maërl beds, also known as rhodolith beds, are biogenic benthic habitats formed by unattached coralline algae and support diverse macrobenthic assemblages. In the Mediterranean, especially its eastern basin, information on their distribution, ecological condition and associated fauna remains limited. Maërl beds are sensitive to physical disturbance, sedimentation and organic enrichment, including pressures associated with aquaculture activities. This data paper describes the macrobenthic fauna associated with maërl beds located near and further from finfish farms in the Traxilos area of the north-eastern Corinthian Gulf, Greece. The dataset comprises eight sampling events and 328 abundance-based occurrence records representing 6,410 individuals. The paper also provides morphological notes on two polychaete taxa, Syllis nigricirris and the Neanthioides acuminata species complex, documenting variation in diagnostically relevant characters.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究记录了希腊科林斯湾东北部Traxilos海域鱼类养殖场附近及远离养殖场的maërl beds（rhodolith beds）大型底栖动物群落，填补了东地中海该生境分布与生态状况数据不足的空白。数据集包含8次采样、328条基于丰度的出现记录，共6,410个个体。文中还对两种多毛类分类群（Syllis nigricirris和Neanthioides acuminata种复合体）的形态鉴别特征变异进行了描述。

papers.title: The Wearing Layer Influences Long-Term Material Loss from Composite Floats for Oyster Aquaculture: An Accelerated-Weathering Comparison of Eight Candidate Materials
papers.authors: Mun, So Youn; Jang, Pilseong; Jang, Jun Hwan
papers.abstract: Expanded polystyrene floats have been identified as a significant source of marine microplastic in oyster aquaculture, yet no certification criterion assesses the material that the certified alternatives shed. Gravimetric mass loss, normalised to a common exposed area of 7200 mm2, is reported under accredited accelerated weathering to KS F 2274 for eight float materials: expanded polystyrene at three densities, expanded polypropylene, three injection-moulded polymers, and a continuous-fibre basalt-reinforced thermoplastic composite. Specimens were dried to constant mass before weighing, so the quantity measured is a net change: an upper bound on particulate release, not a measure of it. Mass exceeded the initial value in all three stabilised expanded polypropylene specimens. At 3000 h the loss spanned a factor of 54, and every foamed material exceeded every non-foamed one, while tripling the density of expanded polystyrene reduced loss by only 25% (n = 3; p < 0.0001 across the foamed groups). For ten injection-moulded grades the accelerated ranking reproduced that of 2.5 years outdoors (Spearman ρ = 0.89), though the ratio varied from 0.4 to 6.3. A wear model indicates that the pure-polymer barrier providing water tightness contains 905–1180 g L−1 of polymer against 578 g L−1 for the laminate beneath, so the wearing layer, not the bulk material, may govern release in service.
papers.summary_cn: 研究比较了8种牡蛎养殖浮球材料在KS F 2274加速风化条件下的质量损失，以评估认证替代材料的颗粒释放潜力。结果显示发泡材料损失普遍高于非发泡材料，3000 h时组间差异达54倍，而发泡聚苯乙烯密度增至三倍仅使损失降低25%。10种注塑材料的加速老化排序与2.5年户外暴露一致（Spearman ρ = 0.89）。磨损模型表明，提供水密性的纯聚合物耐磨层聚合物含量（905–1180 g L⁻¹）远高于下层 laminate（578 g L⁻¹），提示实际使用中释放可能由耐磨层而非主体材料决定。

papers.title: Evaluation of Semen Quality Indices in Cultured and Wild Broodstock of  Clarias gariepinus: Implications for Aquaculture Reproduction and  Broodstock Management
papers.authors: Uruku, Ndekimbe Mamndeyati; Abutu, Agnes; Uruku, Ndenyangtse Ndekimbe
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Research in Zoology
papers.abstract: African catfish (Clarias gariepinus) is an economically important aquaculture species in Nigeria, and sustainable hatchery production depends partly on the availability of suitable male broodstock and good-quality semen. This study compared selected semen quality parameters of cultured and wild male C. gariepinus to assess differences associated with broodstock source. Six sexually mature males, comprising three (3) cultured and three (3) wild individuals, were examined. Semen was obtained through testicular extraction following dissection. The evaluated parameters included gonad weight, gonadosomatic index (GSI), milt volume, sperm motility, sperm concentration, sperm viability, sperm morphology, and semen pH. Descriptive comparisons indicated that wild broodstock had higher mean gonad weight (5.33 ± 1.20 g), milt volume (2.72 ± 0.10 mL), and sperm concentration (5.82 ± 0.23 × 10¹⁰ sperm cells mL⁻¹) than cultured broodstock, which recorded 3.50 ± 0.76 g, 2.58 ± 0.17 mL, and 5.56 ± 0.11 × 10¹⁰ sperm cells mL⁻¹, respectively. The percentage of active spermatozoa was also numerically higher in wild fish (69.17 ± 7.77%) than in cultured fish (63.33 ± 14.00%). Semen pH was 7.00 in both groups. Wild broodstock recorded a higher mean proportion of morphologically normal spermatozoa (88.00 ± 2.16%) than cultured broodstock (76.80 ± 12.95%). The reported statistical analysis, however, indicated no significant differences between the groups (P > 0.05). Qualitative characteristics, including semen colour, viscosity, and liquefaction time, varied between the two sources. These findings indicate that both cultured and wild broodstock produced measurable quantities of testicular semen with broadly comparable characteristics under the conditions investigated. Further studies involving larger numbers of broodstock and controlled fertilisation trials are necessary to determine whether the observed differences influence fertilisation success, hatchability, and larval performance. This study provides preliminary information that may contribute to broodstock evaluation and management in African catfish aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了养殖与野生非洲鲶（Clarias gariepinus）雄鱼亲鱼的精液质量指标，以评估亲鱼来源对繁殖性能的潜在影响。通过解剖取精，测定了性腺重、GSI、精液量、精子活力、精子浓度、精子存活率、精子形态及精液pH等参数。野生亲鱼在性腺重、精液量、精子浓度及形态正常精子比例上均值较高，但统计分析显示组间无显著差异（P > 0.05）。作者建议扩大样本并结合可控受精试验，以明确这些差异是否影响受精率、孵化率及仔鱼表现。

papers.title: Determining the Aquaculture Potential of Campus Ponds Based on Water Quality Parameters for Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) Farming
papers.authors: Khairunnisa, Eka Nurriza; Wahyu, Ilham; Horisanto, Abraham; Yadi, Aril; Ridwansyah, Ahmad
papers.journal: AJARCDE (Asian Journal of Applied Research for Community Development and Empowerment)
papers.abstract: Water quality largely determines the success of Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) cultivation. This study assessed whether two campus ponds at Politeknik Negeri Sriwijaya Banyuasin, Indonesia, are suitable for tilapia culture, using physical and chemical water-quality parameters and a descriptive quantitative design. Water was sampled at three stations per pond (inlet, center, outlet) on two occasions, with duplicate measurements. We reported temperature, total dissolved solids (TDS), dissolved oxygen (DO), pH, ammonia, phosphate, biochemical oxygen demand (BOD), and chemical oxygen demand (COD). Mean temperature was 32.00 ± 0.43 °C in Pond 1 and 32.42 ± 0.51 °C in Pond 2, and DO was relatively high (6.53 ± 0.19 and 6.55 ± 0.20 mg/L). TDS was low (26.42 ± 2.07 and 30.50 ± 1.68 mg/L). Mean pH was slightly acidic (6.09 ± 0.14 and 6.15 ± 0.14): below the 6.5–8.5 range used for tilapia culture, but inside the 6–9 range of Class II in Government Regulation No. 22/2021. Ammonia (0.48 ± 0.06 and 0.41 ± 0.10 mg/L), phosphate (1.25 ± 0.08 and 1.36 ± 0.09 mg/L), BOD (8.84 ± 1.44 and 10.93 ± 2.79 mg/L), and COD (29.00 ± 6.64 and 35.67 ± 9.11 mg/L) exceeded the comparison values used. Both ponds therefore offer supportive oxygen conditions but are constrained by organic loading and nutrient enrichment. They should be regarded as usable only after water-quality management and confirmatory monitoring, including dawn-time DO, nitrite, alkalinity, and the analytical basis of ammonia and phosphate. Contribution to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):SDG 2 (Zero Hunger)SDG 4 (Quality Education)SDG 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation)SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production)
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估印度尼西亚两处校园池塘是否适合养殖尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus），采用描述性定量设计，在各池塘进水口、中心和出水口三个站点采样，测定温度、TDS、DO、pH、氨氮、磷酸盐、BOD和COD等理化指标。结果显示溶氧条件良好（约6.5 mg/L），但pH偏酸（约6.1），氨氮、磷酸盐、BOD和COD均超出参考限值，表明存在有机负荷和营养盐富集问题。两池塘须经水质管理和验证性监测后方可用于罗非鱼养殖。

papers.title: Environmental radioactivity in marine food webs of the Tamil Nadu coast: sources, transfer pathways and radiological implications
papers.authors: Singaravel, Vijayapoopathi; Moovendhan, Meivelu
papers.abstract: Seafood constitutes a major pathway for the transfer of naturally occurring and anthropogenic radionuclides from marine ecosystems to humans. The Tamil Nadu coast, spanning the Bay of Bengal, Palk Bay, Gulf of Mannar and the Indian Ocean, supports intensive fisheries, aquaculture and seafood consumption while encompassing nuclear installations, mineral-rich coastal sediments, major ports, estuaries, industrial zones and riverine inputs that collectively influence marine radioactivity. This review critically synthesises current knowledge of radionuclides in marine fish, crustaceans, molluscs, seaweeds and other edible organisms along the Tamil Nadu coast, with emphasis on their sources, environmental behaviour, bioaccumulation, trophic transfer and implications for seafood safety. Naturally occurring and cosmogenic radionuclides (^210Po, ^210Pb, ^226Ra, ^228Ra, ^238U, ^232Th, ^40K and ^14C), together with surveillance-relevant anthropogenic radionuclides (^137Cs, ^134Cs, ^90Sr, ^3H, ^99Tc and plutonium isotopes), are evaluated with respect to environmental sources, sediment interactions, tissue-specific accumulation, spatial variability and radiological significance. Under normal/background conditions, across Tamil Nadu studies that quantified radionuclide ingestion dose, ^210Po ^210Po frequently represented the largest contributor among the radionuclides assessed, although the magnitude of exposure varied substantially with seafood group, tissue selection, processing state and consumption assumptions. Anthropogenic radionuclides were less extensively characterised and generally contributed smaller reported doses in the available surveillance studies; however, their relative radiological importance may increase substantially following accidental or off-normal releases. Comparability among studies remains constrained by differences in sampling design, target species, tissue selection, analytical methods, reporting basis, detection limits, seafood-consumption data and dose-assessment assumptions. This review therefore emphasises the need for harmonised, long-term radioecological monitoring integrating seawater, sediments, plankton, representative marine biota and commercially important seafood, together with robust QA/QC, whole organism ecological dose assessment and category-specific probabilistic dietary exposure modelling. Establishing spatially and temporally resolved baseline datasets will strengthen seafood-safety assessments, improve source attribution, support rapid evaluation of accidental releases and provide a more robust basis for environmental protection and coastal management along the Tamil Nadu coast.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了泰米尔纳德邦海岸海洋食物网中天然与人为放射性核素的来源、环境行为、生物累积及营养级传递，重点评估了^210Po、^210Pb、^226Ra、^40K及^137Cs、^90Sr等核素在海产品中的辐射剂量意义。研究表明，本底条件下^210Po通常是海产品摄入剂量的最大贡献者，人为核素在常规监测中贡献较小，但在事故释放情景下其相对重要性可能显著上升。研究间因采样设计、组织选择、分析方法和消费假设差异而可比性受限，呼吁建立统一的长周期radioecological监测体系并整合海水、沉积物、浮游生物及代表性海产品，以支撑海产品安全评估与海岸带管理。

papers.title: eDNA metabarcoding and random forest identify super-connector fish species across mangrove–seagrass–coral reef continuums in the South China Sea
papers.authors: Liu, Chunchun; Wu, Gongguo; Zou, Chujun; Wu, Donghai; Xie, Pengfei; Wang, Sai; Wang, Ping
papers.abstract: Background Tropical coastal seascapes rely on ecological connectivity between mangrove, seagrass, and coral reef habitats to sustain fish biodiversity and fisheries productivity. However, identifying key fish species that facilitate cross-habitat energy flows remains challenging due to limitations of traditional survey methods in turbid, structurally complex environments. Methods We integrated environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding with Random Forest (RF) machine learning to map fish assemblages across a mangrove-seagrass-coral reef continuum in Hainan Island, South China Sea. Results We detected 234 fish species across 78 families - a 4.03-fold increase over conventional gillnet surveys (58 species, paired t-test, t = 11.34, p &lt; 0.001). Using RF classification, we identified 23 "connector species" with high cross-habitat fidelity, of which three super-connectors - Lutjanus russellii , Siganus fuscescens , and Gerres oyena - accounted for 47% of cross-habitat network flow. Simulated removal of these three species reduced overall network connectivity by 68%. The RF model achieved 90.7% accuracy (Kappa = 0.86) in predicting habitat occurrence from eDNA data. Variable importance analysis revealed a salinity threshold at 28 PSU and a distance-to-reef threshold at 2.5 km as primary drivers of community turnover. Our bipartite network analysis showed significant nestedness (NODF = 47.3, p &lt; 0.001), indicating that generalist species disproportionately maintain seascape connectivity. Discussion These findings demonstrate that integrating eDNA with machine learning provides a scalable, high-resolution toolkit for defining functional connectivity and prioritizing species for ecosystem-based fisheries management in the Anthropocene.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在识别红树林—海草床—珊瑚礁连续体中对跨生境能量流动起关键作用的鱼类。方法上整合eDNA metabarcoding与随机森林机器学习，在海南岛南海沿岸海景中解析鱼类群落。共检测到234种鱼类（78科），为传统刺网调查的4.03倍；随机森林模型以90.7%准确率识别出23种高跨生境保真度的“connector species”，其中Lutjanus russellii、Siganus fuscescens和Gerres oyena三种super-connectors贡献了47%的跨生境网络流量，模拟移除后网络连通性下降68%。盐度28 PSU和距礁距离2.5 km是群落更替的主要驱动因子，二分网络分析显示显著嵌套结构（NODF=47.3），表明广适种对维持海景连通性具有不成比例的作用。

papers.title: Rapid vaterite-mediated shell repair for acid-induced damage in a deep-sea mussel
papers.authors: Chen, Yu; Jia, Zice; Kiel, Steffen; Liu, Yali; Xu, Chenlu; Lu, Yang; Wang, Xudong; Li, Niu; Li, Jie; Zhang, Si
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: Mollusks are able to secrete and repair the most diverse and complex calcareous tissues in the animal kingdom, yet the detailed molecular mechanisms of these biomineralization processes, especially for the deep-sea calcifiers, remain to be elucidated. Here, using an in situ experiment, we report a repair mechanism for acid-induced shell damage via biologically mediated vaterite formation in the deep-sea cold-seep mussel Gigantidas haimaensis . Interestingly, the mussels secreted and recrystallized amorphous calcium carbonate into vaterite to seal the acid-induced dissolution porosities within 30 h. Calcium and nucleation substrates were potentially supplied by the mantle, including calcium-binding proteins and hydroxyapatite. Calcium then reacted with readily available carbonate in the extrapallial space, whose precipitation can be promoted by the nucleation substrates. This rapid repair mechanism is likely an advantage in the habitat of these mussels, which are characterized by pulsed acidification events from the seeping fluids. Furthermore, our finding expands our understanding of the diverse biomineralization mechanisms by which mollusks maintain their protective shells.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过原位实验探究深海冷泉贻贝 *Gigantidas haimaensis* 对酸诱导壳损伤的修复机制。研究发现，贻贝在30小时内将无定形碳酸钙分泌并重结晶为vaterite（球霰石），以封闭酸蚀孔隙；钙源与成核底物（含钙结合蛋白和羟基磷灰石）可能由外套膜供给，并在外套腔中与可用碳酸根反应沉淀。该快速修复机制可能是对渗流流体脉冲式酸化生境的适应，拓展了对软体动物生物矿化多样性的认识。

papers.title: Food Security in the Sultanate of Oman, 1975–2025: Fisheries, Falaj Agriculture and the Rise of Diversified Self-Sufficiency
papers.authors: Nosir, Walid
papers.abstract: Oman differs from its Gulf neighbours in several respects relevant to food security: a long Arabian Sea coastline with productive fisheries, a monsoon-influenced southern region (Dhofar), an ancient irrigation tradition based on the falaj system, and major ports at Sohar, Duqm and Salalah that lie outside, or at the mouth of, the Strait of Hormuz. Since the start of the modern state in 1970, its population has grown from well under one million to over five million, and food demand has risen accordingly. This review traces Oman's food-security trajectory over five decades, drawing on National Centre for Statistics and Information data, ministry production statistics reported in the national press, the Global Food Security Index and the scholarly literature. Over the period, coastal agriculture on the Al Batinah plain suffered severe groundwater salinisation, which undermined date and lime cultivation. Since about 2010, however, deliberate investment in fisheries, aquaculture, dairy, poultry, eggs and protected vegetables has raised overall food self-sufficiency to about 65.8% in 2024, with sector ratios of 144.5% for fish, 87.3% for animal production, 66.4% for food and beverage industries and 49.4% for agricultural crop products. At commodity level, the latest reported self-sufficiency is about 146–162% for fish, 97–99% for dates, 92–97% for milk and 92–95% for eggs, while poultry stood at 55–60% and red meat at 46% in 2023. Oman scored 71.2 in the 2022 GFSI (35th of 113), and its gain of 13.8 points since 2012 was the largest improvement of any country. The review concludes that Oman's combination of marine resources, targeted investment and port diversification offers a model for arid states, while water quality, climate risk and feed dependence remain the principal constraints.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述基于国家统计、部委产量数据、Global Food Security Index及学术文献，梳理阿曼1975–2025年粮食安全轨迹：人口从不足百万增至逾五百万，Al Batinah平原沿海农业因地下水盐渍化致椰枣与青柠种植受损。自2010年前后对渔业、水产养殖、乳业、禽蛋及保护地蔬菜的定向投资，使2024年整体粮食自给率升至约65.8%，其中鱼类144.5%、动物生产87.3%；鱼类自给率约146–162%，禽肉55–60%、红肉46%。2022年GFSI得分71.2（113国中第35位），2012年以来提升13.8分为各国最大增幅；水质、气候风险与饲料依赖仍为主要约束。

papers.title: Judicial review of bottom‐trawling restrictions in EU marine protected areas: Case T‐265/23 VDK v Commission
papers.authors: Bertram, Alice; Schatz, Valentin
papers.journal: Review of European, Comparative & International Environmental Law
papers.abstract: Abstract This case note analyses the EU General Court's judgment in VDK v Commission (Judgment of 21 May 2025, Case T‐265/23), which concerns the legality of spatial fisheries restrictions adopted to protect marine Natura 2000 sites in the German Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ). As the applicant did not appeal the judgment, it has become final. The applicant, a German fishers' association, challenged the Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/340, which closed four sites in Germany's North Sea EEZ (in addition to three Dutch sites) to bottom‐contacting gear and to gillnets and entangling nets. The applicant argued that the measure was, insofar as it concerned the German sites, disproportionate and that the European Commission exceeded its powers under the Common Fisheries Policy (CFP). The Court dismissed both pleas. First, it reaffirmed the broad discretion enjoyed by European Union (EU) institutions in the field of the CFP, applying a deferential standard of judicial review and endorsing a precautionary approach to bottom‐contacting fishing gear in marine protected areas. Second, it confirmed the Commission's competence to protect gravel beds under Article 11(2) CFP‐Regulation in conjunction with Article 13(4) MSFD. The judgment strengthens the legal resilience of spatial fisheries restrictions used to implement EU biodiversity law, such as the Birds and Habitats Directives. However, consistent with past judgments, this limited standard of judicial review will generally shield measures adopted under the CFP from challenge, specifically when they are challenged based on allegedly too high environmental protection ambition.
papers.summary_cn: 分析欧盟普通法院在VDK诉欧盟委员会案（T-265/23）中的判决，该案涉及为保护德国专属经济区Natura 2000海洋保护区而实施的底拖网限制措施合法性。德国渔民协会质疑欧盟委员会授权条例（EU）2023/340，主张该措施不成比例且委员会超越共同渔业政策（CFP）授权。法院驳回两项诉求，确认了欧盟机构在CFP领域的广泛自由裁量权，认可对海洋保护区内底接触渔具采取预防性方法，并确认委员会依据CFP条例第11(2)条结合MSFD第13(4)条保护砾石床的权限。该判决增强了空间渔业限制措施的法律韧性，但有限的司法审查标准通常会使CFP措施免受质疑，尤其是以环保目标过高为由的挑战。

papers.title: Physiological and histological study of the toxicity and biocompatibility of graphene oxide and GO–PVA nanocomposite hydrogels in the treatment of metal-contaminated water for Oreochromis niloticus aquaculture
papers.authors: Moustafa, Basma H.; Serag, Eman; Zeid, Salma M. S.
papers.abstract: Abstract Heavy metals in aquaculture water from industrial effluent, mining, and agricultural runoff pose risks to ecosystems and human health. Graphene oxide (GO) effectively adsorbs heavy metal ions but can be toxic to fish. A composite of PVA hydrogel with GO enhances water quality maintenance in aquaculture. While PVA-GO hydrogel's adsorption capacity has been studied, its environmental and toxicological impacts are unclear. This study examines the biocompatibility of low-concentration PVA-GO hydrogel composites for water treatment, comparing untreated, metal-contaminated, and treated water samples in Oreochromis niloticus aquaculture. The synthesis of GO and PVA-GO hydrogel was analyzed using X-ray diffraction (XRD), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and FTIR spectra. The results indicated that heavy metal-contaminated water caused significant anemia and altered plasma biochemistry, while the biomarkers in treated groups returned to levels similar to the control. Additionally, GO and PVA-GO hydrogels exhibited intestinal antibacterial activity. This research suggests that combining GO with PVA hydrogel reduces toxicity to fish, improves heavy metal removal, and enhances their health in aquaculture environments.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了氧化石墨烯（GO）及GO–PVA纳米复合水凝胶处理重金属污染水对尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）的毒性与生物相容性，通过XRD、SEM和FTIR对材料进行表征，并比较未处理、重金属污染及处理后水体养殖组的生理与组织学指标。结果显示，重金属污染水导致鱼类显著贫血及血浆生化改变，而处理组生物标志物恢复至接近对照组水平；GO与PVA-GO水凝胶还表现出肠道抗菌活性。研究表明，GO与PVA水凝胶复合可降低对鱼的毒性、提高重金属去除效果并改善养殖环境中的鱼体健康。

papers.title: Estimating divergence and migration times of sticklebacks (Gasterosteidae): a fossil-based analysis using the Adaptive Beta method
papers.authors: Frank, Tanner Matthew; Marshall, Charles R.; Bell, Michael A.
papers.abstract: The timing of major events in stickleback evolution is important for determining rates of molecular evolution within the group. Inferred substitution rates depend on fossil-calibrated divergence times, but in sticklebacks these currently rest on the single oldest fossil occurrence or calibrations largely from other fish taxa, leaving them vulnerable to the idiosyncrasies of the fossil record. We infer a chronology for major events in stickleback evolution using the Adaptive Beta method (ABM) on subsets of a record of 53 gasterosteid fossil occurrences. By incorporating multiple fossil ages in a Bayesian framework, this approach produces credible intervals that account for varying fossil recovery potential through time. Our analysis indicates that the Gasterosteidae originated approximately 32.9 Mya (95% CI: 24.5-54.3 Mya), with the divergence between Gasterosteus and other genera, including Pungitius, occurring at approximately 20.8 Mya (95% CI: 13.8-40.7 Mya). Furthermore, the results inform the timing of inter-oceanic dispersal: we find that Gasterosteus aculeatus Linnaeus, 1758 likely entered the Atlantic only 0.9 Mya (95% CI: 0.6-1.7 Mya). Inclusion of uncertain early Atlantic basin fossils pushes this invasion back to 6.4 Mya (95% CI: 4.8-10.4 Mya). These interval-based estimates provide a reliable chronological framework for calibrating rates of nucleotide substitution in sticklebacks.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用Adaptive Beta方法对53个刺鱼科（Gasterosteidae）化石记录进行贝叶斯分析，以估计该科主要演化事件的时间及分子进化速率校准框架。结果显示刺鱼科约起源于32.9 Mya，Gasterosteus与其他属（含Pungitius）的分歧约发生于20.8 Mya；Gasterosteus aculeatus进入大西洋约在0.9 Mya，若纳入不确定的早期大西洋盆地化石则推前至6.4 Mya。该基于区间估计的年代框架为刺鱼核苷酸替换率的校准提供了可靠依据。

papers.authors: Hasegawa, Yuha; Fukuda, Nobuto; Matsushige, Kazuki; Nanjo, Kusuto; Miki, Ryohei; Tanaka, Toshimitsu; Kawabata, Yuuki
papers.summary_cn: 本研究关注日本鳗鲡幼鳗在放流初期的被捕食风险，比较了不同发育阶段个体在日本两处上游河口放流后的捕食压力差异。由于缺乏摘要，具体方法与结果无法获知，建议结合放流点生境特征与捕食者群落评估放流时机与规格。

papers.title: Glutaraldehyde Efficacy Against Cryptocaryon irritans Tomonts, Inducing ROS Generation and DNA Damage and Controlling Cryptocaryoniasis in Larimichthys crocea Factory‐Style Aquaculture
papers.authors: Ullah, Kaleem; Siddique, Qaisra; Sun, Yue; Yu, Youbin; Yin, Fei
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Cryptocaryon irritans is a pathogenic ciliate that causes cryptocaryoniasis and substantial economic losses in the mariculture industry. This study evaluated antiparasitic effects of glutaraldehyde (GA) against C. irritans tomonts and its therapeutic potential during C. irritans infection in large yellow croaker ( Larimichthys crocea ). In vitro, screening demonstrated that GA aquatic disinfectant (GA‐ad) significantly inhibited tomont development, achieving half lethal concentration (LC50) at 10.23 μL/L for 8 h treatment. Toxicity test showed that three 8 h treatments with GA‐ad at 10 times concentration of LC50 (102.3 μL/L) were safe for the fish. Therapeutic application of GA‐ad (1 × LC50 = 10.23 μL/L, and 2 × LC50 = 20.46 μL/L) in the treated groups survived L. crocea till 63% and 100% on Day 21 (Relative tomont number, RTN = 0), while in the infected group (untreated) survival rate was 0% by day nine (RTN = 39.48). For the mechanistic study, GA chemical reagent (GA‐cr, 10.23 μL/L, Pure GA = 5.12 μL/L) was used which induced oxidative stress and lipid peroxidation in tomonts, as evidenced by increased ROS and MDA level, reduced GSH:GSSG and CAT activity, and increased T‐SOD activity. Additionally, the mRNA expression of P21 , P53 , Nqo1 and Gst were significantly upregulated in GA‐cr treated tomonts. Collectively, these findings indicate that GA‐cr disrupts redox homeostasis, induces oxidative and DNA damage that ultimately leads to cell cycle arrest in C. irritans . Overall, 20.46 μL/L of GA‐ad is highly effective for controlling cryptocaryoniasis in L. crocea aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了戊二醛（GA）对刺激隐核虫（Cryptocaryon irritans）tomonts的杀灭效果及其在大黄鱼（Larimichthys crocea）工厂化养殖中控制cryptocaryoniasis的治疗潜力。体外实验表明GA水产消毒剂（GA-ad）8 h处理的LC50为10.23 μL/L，10倍LC50浓度（102.3 μL/L）三次8 h处理对鱼安全；GA-ad（10.23和20.46 μL/L）治疗组第21天存活率分别为63%和100%（RTN=0），而未治疗感染组第9天存活率为0%（RTN=39.48）。机制研究发现GA化学试剂通过升高ROS和MDA水平、降低GSH:GSSG比值和CAT活性、上调P21、P53、Nqo1和Gst mRNA表达，破坏tomonts氧化还原稳态并诱导氧化损伤和DNA损伤，最终导致细胞周期阻滞。综上，20.46 μL/L GA-ad可高效控制大黄鱼养殖中的cryptocaryoniasis。

papers.title: Hovering in turbulent rock‐array microhabitats: Multidimensional kinematic responses of S chizothorax grahami
papers.authors: Wang, Biao; Li, Hongze; Wang, Xiaogang; Chen, Huijuan
papers.abstract: Abstract The interaction between flow and riverbed structures creates spatially heterogeneous turbulent microhabitats that influence fish station‐holding strategies and energy allocation. This study investigated the hovering behaviour of Schizothorax grahami in complex turbulent microhabitats formed by rock arrays of different scales using flume experiments. Video analysis and data storage tag (DST) tilt sensors were combined to quantify five multidimensional kinematic indicators: ground swimming speed (), angular velocity of swimming direction (), tail‐beat angular velocity (), pitch angular velocity () and roll angular velocity (). As rock‐element size increased, fish hovering positions shifted from dispersed distributions to regions with local velocity gradients around rock elements, with clear positional overlap observed under some large‐rock‐array conditions. Increasing discharge generally increased the mean values and standardized within‐condition variances of most kinematic indicators. Trial‐level Spearman correlation analysis showed that had the strongest positive correlation with . Generalized linear mixed models further revealed functional differentiation among kinematic responses: and were mainly driven by flow velocity () and turbulent kinetic energy, whereas , and showed weaker hydrodynamic responses. These findings suggest that fish hovering is an active multidimensional regulation process in which position maintenance, directional correction, propulsion and postural stabilization show partially differentiated response patterns. These findings provide new insights into the locomotor and postural strategies that enable benthic fish to maintain stability in heterogeneous turbulent environments and improve our understanding of fish behavioural adaptation to complex flows.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过水槽实验，结合视频分析与DST倾角传感器，量化了Schizothorax grahami在不同尺度岩石阵列形成的湍流微生境中的悬停运动学特征。随岩石尺寸增大，鱼类悬停位置由分散分布转向岩石周围局部速度梯度区域；流量增加普遍提高多数运动学指标的均值及组内标准化方差。广义线性混合模型表明，各运动学响应存在功能分化：部分指标主要受流速与湍动能驱动，而另一些指标的水动力响应较弱。结果表明鱼类悬停是位置维持、方向校正、推进与姿态稳定部分分化的多维主动调控过程。

papers.title: Assessing the adaptation between recreational fisheries development and aquaculture efficiency in multifunctional freshwater fisheries systems: Evidence from China
papers.authors: Hu, Xianglan; Liu, Jingzhou
papers.abstract: To examine the quality of synergy and potential mismatch risks between production and recreational functions during the multifunctional transformation of freshwater fisheries, this study constructs a composite index of recreational fisheries development using panel data from 29 Chinese provinces from 2008 to 2023. Freshwater aquaculture efficiency is measured using a benevolent cross-efficiency model incorporating both desirable and undesirable outputs. An integrated adaptation model is then employed to capture the spatiotemporal differentiation of the adaptation relationship between the two systems, while Random Forest and SHAP methods are applied to identify nonlinear effects and threshold characteristics of key drivers. The results indicate that: (1) both recreational fisheries development and aquaculture efficiency increased steadily over the study period, whereas the composite adaptation index remained at low-to-medium levels with limited stage-wise improvement, suggesting that efficiency gains have not been effectively translated into recreational advantages; (2) the adaptation pattern exhibits pronounced regional differentiation and path dependence, characterized by persistently higher levels in central China, gradual improvement in eastern China, increasing polarization in western China, and consistently low and weakening adaptation in northeastern China; and (3) the driving mechanisms are markedly nonlinear, with water environmental pressure and tourism reception intensity acting as key constraints. Specifically, water quality pressure exhibits an inverted U-shaped effect with clear thresholds, whereas tourism intensity exerts a sustained inhibitory effect. This study provides empirical evidence for incorporating adaptation relationships into fisheries transformation assessments and for region-specific optimization of industrial structure and spatial allocation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2008—2023年中国29个省份面板数据，构建休闲渔业发展综合指数，并采用包含期望与非期望产出的benevolent cross-efficiency模型测度淡水养殖效率，进而用适应性模型与Random Forest、SHAP方法识别两系统适配关系的时空分异及关键驱动因素的非线性阈值效应。结果表明，休闲渔业发展与养殖效率均稳步提升，但复合适配指数仅处中低水平，效率增益未能有效转化为休闲优势；适配格局呈显著区域分异与路径依赖，中部持续较高、东部渐升、西部极化加剧、东北持续偏低且弱化。水环境压力呈倒U型阈值效应，旅游接待强度则表现为持续抑制，二者构成主要约束。

papers.title: SIMULATION AND FINANCIAL FEASIBILITY OF SEINE NET FISHERIES AT BRONDONG FISHING PORT
papers.authors: Putrama, Abyan; Bangun, Tri Nanda Citra; Kurniawati, Vita Rumanti
papers.abstract: The transition from cantrang to seine net (Jaring Tarik Berkantong/JTB) has raised fishers’ concerns regarding potential declines in catch production and operational profitability. This study was conducted to analyze operational costs, cost-determining factors, and profit decline simulations as a basis for assessing the sustainability of fishing gear transition. The objectives of this study were to estimate fishing operational costs, identify factors influencing operational costs, and analyze the tolerance threshold of profit decline under seine net operations. This research employed a descriptive case study approach through observation and structured interviews involving 15 respondents, consisting of vessel owners and skippers selected using purposive sampling. Data were analyzed using Causal Loop Diagram (CLD), Revenue-Cost Ratio (R/C Ratio), Break Even Point (BEP), and catch decline simulation scenarios. The results showed that average operational costs reached IDR 46.1 million per trip, with fuel accounting for the largest proportion (54%). The R/C Ratio of 2.08 indicated that the business was financially feasible, with a production break-even point of 3,523.56 kg per trip. Simulation results revealed that the business remained viable under catch reductions of up to 40%, whereas declines exceeding 55% could potentially lead to financial losses. These findings indicate that the transition to seine net remains economically promising, provided that operational efficiency is strengthened as an adaptive strategy for fishers. Key words: cantrang, seine net, financial feasibility, operational-costs, profit-simulation
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在评估印尼Brondong渔港从cantrang（小型拖网）向seine net（JTB）作业转型的财务可行性，通过观察与结构化访谈获取15名船东及船长的数据，采用CLD、R/C Ratio、BEP及渔获下降情景模拟进行分析。结果显示单航次平均运营成本为4610万印尼盾，燃油占比最大（54%），R/C Ratio为2.08，单航次盈亏平衡产量为3523.56 kg。模拟表明渔获下降不超过40%时经营仍可行，超过55%则可能出现亏损，说明seine net转型在经济上仍具前景，但需提升运营效率作为渔民的适应策略。

papers.journal: Journal on Wireless Communications and Networking

papers.title: DNA barcoding of freshwater fish species from Upper Lake: A Ramsar site, Bhopal, India: Implications for species authentication and reference barcode database development
papers.authors: Uikey, N.; Yadav, S.; Garg, R. K.
papers.abstract: Upper Lake, Bhopal, a Ramsar designated wetland and one of the largest natural freshwater lakes in central India, supports rich fish diversity and provides important ecological, economic, and fisheries resources. Accurate identification is expected to make proper conservation of any animal species, yet traditional morphometric methods are challenging and time consuming. To address these limitations, this study employed DNA barcoding using the mitochondrial cytochrome-c oxidase subunit I (mtcox1) gene to generate DNA barcodes for 24 fish specimens representing 20 species from 7 orders collected from Upper Lake, Bhopal. We generated sequences ranging from 560 - 640 bp and deposited them in GenBank and the Barcode of Life Data System (BOLD Systems). The mean intraspecific divergence was extremely low (0.58%), exhibiting a significant separation as a clear barcode gap from the minimum interspecific divergence at the genus level (10.24%). Nearest-neighbor method supported species delimitation with a mean interspecific distance (14.7%) 122.5- fold greater than the mean intraspecific distance (0.12%). However, the Barcode Index Number (BIN) analysis revealed notable instances of taxonomic discordance with 24 sequences generating 18 BINs. Nucleotide composition analysis showed a mean GC content of 45.38% with a characteristic positional bias, highest at the first codon position (mean 56.25%) and lowest at the third (37.32%). This study established a novel genetic reference dataset for the fish fauna of this Ramsar designated wetland and demonstrated the utility of the mtcox1 gene for species identification, biodiversity monitoring, and conservation management of freshwater ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在为印度博帕尔上湖（Ramsar湿地）建立鱼类DNA条形码参考数据库，以弥补传统形态学鉴定耗时长、难度大的不足。采用线粒体cox1基因对7目20种24尾标本进行条形码测序，获得560–640 bp序列并提交至GenBank和BOLD系统。种内平均遗传距离极低（0.58%），与属级最小种间距离（10.24%）形成明显barcode gap，支持基于mtcox1的物种鉴定。BIN分析显示24条序列产生18个BIN，提示部分分类学不一致，该数据集可用于淡水生态系统物种认证、生物多样性监测与保护管理。

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of Fish Farming Information Needs among Fish Farmers in Lagos and Osun State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Akinboye, O. A
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF AGRICULTURE AND EARTH SCIENCE
papers.abstract: Despite government efforts to boot fish production, there still exist a wide gap between demand for fish and domestic supply in Nigeria. This study aims to analyse the fish farming information needs among fish farmers. This study was conducted in the Lagos and Osun States. The population of the study consists of all registered fish farmers both male and female, with functional fish farms and who are into table size fish farming in Lagos and Osun States, Nigeria. A multistage sampling procedure was employed for the selection of 300 respondents for this study. The data for this study was collected from the respondents using a wellstructured questionnaire and interview schedule while the data obtained was subjected to both descriptive and inferential statistical tools. Descriptive statistical tools employed include; frequency counts, percentages and means, while the inferential statistical tool used for testing the stated hypothesis was t-test. The study identified that the fish farmers in the different region have distinct and specific information needs while both groups are faced with common constraints such as high price of inputs, unavailability of credit facilities and limited market. The t-test result shows significant disparities in the information requirements between the two groups. It was recommended that customized information packages should be develop for the fish farmers based on their sociodemographic characteristics and specific needs.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在比较尼日利亚拉各斯州与奥孙州养殖户的鱼类养殖信息需求。采用多阶段抽样对300名注册养殖户进行问卷调查，运用描述性统计与t检验分析数据。结果显示两地区养殖户的信息需求存在显著差异，但均面临投入品价格高、信贷可得性差和市场有限等共同制约。建议根据养殖户社会人口特征和具体需求开发定制化信息包。
