papers.title: A Rock Ramp Fishway Improves Passage for Threatened and Small‐Bodied Fish in Southeastern Australia
papers.authors: Marsden, Timothy J.; Bretzel, Joachim B.
papers.journal: New Zealand Journal of Marine and Freshwater Research
papers.abstract: Restoring fish passage in fragmented rivers is critical for conserving migratory and endemic species. Rock ramp fishways, which are cost‐effective and provide both passage and fish habitat, offer a nature‐like solution. We evaluated a newly constructed rock ramp fishway on the sub‐alpine Buchan River, Australia. Pre‐ and post‐construction surveys using electrofishing and trapping revealed an overall shift in fish community composition, increased connectivity and higher fish abundance after construction. The fishway successfully facilitated passage for potamodromous and diadromous species, while several species were also recorded within the fishway itself. Upstream‐only assemblage changes showed a similar trend but were not statistically significant, highlighting that broader community responses to fishway construction may take longer to emerge. Although fish communities are shaped by multiple environmental factors, our findings demonstrate that rock ramp fishways are an effective tool for restoring fish movement and supporting fish species diversity in dynamic river systems.
papers.summary_cn: 评估澳大利亚Buchan河新建rock ramp fishway对鱼类通道的恢复效果，采用电捕和陷阱法进行建前与建后调查。结果显示鱼群群落组成整体改变、连通性提高、鱼类丰度增加，fishway成功促进了potamodromous和diadromous鱼类的通行，且多种鱼类在fishway内部被记录。仅上游区域的群落变化趋势相似但未达统计显著，表明群落层面对fishway建设的响应可能需要更长时间才能显现。

papers.authors: Machado, Irene; Rodríguez-Gallego, Lorena; Sousa, Magda; Calliari, Danilo; Ribeiro, Américo; Pinheiro, João; Conde, Daniel Nelson; Dias, João M.

papers.title: From Severity to Consequence: A Measurement Agenda for Securing AI Decisions in Seafood Safety
papers.authors: Yang, Lihong; Yang, Ran; Feng, Yiming
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI Symposium Series
papers.abstract: AI screening systems can influence which food products are released or held, yet technical vulnerability severity does not determine how their decisions change under perturbation. We argue that assurance should include a measured consequence transfer function relating perturbation magnitude to unsafe-release and false-recall rates, reported separately. We instantiate this proposal on a frozen, unpublished research model for short-wave infrared (SWIR) histamine screening. In this case, the fragility ordering of the 35 and 200 ppm operating points reverses between spectral tilt and gain drift, and a preprocessing-parameter edit produces the largest measured increase in unsafe releases. Criterion sensitivity analysis and conditional lot-bootstrap intervals characterize the evidence and its uncertainty. These results concern one model version and simulated interventions; they do not establish screening performance on new fish or a universal attack ranking. We position consequence measurement as an input to hazard analysis and risk assessment, alongside exposure, likelihood and control cost, and identify five open problems for extending it across food-safety systems.
papers.summary_cn: 研究提出AI筛查系统的保障评估应纳入“后果传递函数”，分别量化扰动幅度与不安全放行率、误召回率的关系，而非仅依据技术脆弱性严重程度。以短波红外（SWIR）组胺筛查的冻结研究模型为例，发现35与200 ppm操作点在光谱倾斜与增益漂移下的脆弱性排序发生反转，且预处理参数修改导致不安全放行增幅最大。通过准则敏感性分析与条件批次bootstrap区间刻画证据及其不确定性，作者将后果测量定位为危害分析与风险评估的输入要素，并提出五个待解问题以推广至食品安全系统。

papers.title: Eating with a grain of salt: Trade-offs between habitat use and individual foraging specialisation drive growth across ecotypes of a freshwater piscivore (pike, Esox lucius) inhabiting brackish habitats
papers.authors: Rittweg, Timo Dustin; Trueman, Clive; Goldhammer, Tobias; Braun, Marlon; Dhellemmes, Félicie; Winkler, Helmut; Arlinghaus, Robert
papers.abstract: Freshwater fishes living in brackish environments often diverge into ecotypes displaying different habitat use. Salinity levels common to brackish habitats incur osmoregulatory costs to freshwater fishes, but also offer opportunities in the form of access to marine prey, creating trade-offs. We investigated foraging specialisation of coastal northern pike (Esox lucius) ecotypes, ranging from migratory to brackish- or freshwater- residents, sampled from coastal lagoons and freshwater tributaries in the southern Baltic Sea. We combined resource use with individual growth as a fitness surrogate to identify mechanisms of coexistence. Individual foraging specialisation was highest in behavioural phenotypes with high trophic overlap in shared foraging grounds, brackish resident pike and cross-habitat pike. Larger brackish-adapted individuals specialised more on marine resources with positive effects on growth, but higher-than average salinities reduced growth. Trophic overlap of anadromous and freshwater pike phenotypes was low and differed from cross-habitat and brackish habitat phenotypes. Age-specific effects of marine resources and salinity on individual growth suggest coexistence of pike ecotypes is facilitated by dynamic trade-offs between foraging specialisation and habitat costs.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以波罗的海南部沿岸潟湖与淡水支流中的北方狗鱼（Esox lucius）为对象，结合资源利用与个体生长（适合度替代指标），探讨洄游型、半咸水定居型与淡水定居型等ecotypes的摄食特化与共存机制。结果显示，共享觅食地中营养重叠高的半咸水定居型和跨生境型行为表型个体摄食特化程度最高；体型较大的半咸水适应个体更倾向特化利用海洋资源并促进生长，但高于平均的盐度会抑制生长。溯河型与淡水型狗鱼的营养重叠较低，且与跨生境型及半咸水型存在差异；海洋资源与盐度对生长的年龄特异性效应表明，摄食特化与生境代价之间的动态权衡促进了各ecotypes的共存。

papers.title: Rethinking English Language Learning: A Needs Analysis in Fisheries and Marine Science Education
papers.authors: Mahendra, Diana; Wahyuningsih, Sri
papers.journal: International Journal of Science Education and Cultural Studies
papers.abstract: This study seeks to analyze the needs of Fisheries and Marine Science students in learning English to be a basis in developing a contextually relevant English for Specific Purposes (ESP) curriculum. The study used a descriptive qualitative design and included 23 participants: 20 undergraduate students in the third to fifth semesters, two English lecturers, and one Marine Science lecturer. Data were collected using semi-structured interviews, focus group discussions, classroom observations and document analysis and analysed thematically using the concepts of necessities, lacks and wants. The results identified five major themes: academic English proficiency, professional communication, technical vocabulary, speaking confidence, and contextualized learning activities. Students faced difficulties in understanding scientific articles in international journals, writing academic texts and understanding terminology specific to fisheries and marine science disciplines. They also lacked confidence in speaking English that influenced their participation in English communication activities. Students also said they would like to have lessons about words used in the marine industry, workshops on how to read scientific journals, practice making presentations and learning through simulations. The results of the study suggest the need for an ESP curriculum that incorporates academic literacy, subject specific vocabulary and practical communication activities. The study offers an empirical foundation for synchronizing English teaching to the academic requirements and anticipated professional communication skills of Fisheries and Marine Science students.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在分析渔业与海洋科学学生在英语学习方面的需求，为开发情境化ESP课程提供依据。采用描述性质性设计，通过半结构化访谈、焦点小组讨论、课堂观察和文档分析收集数据，并基于necessities、lacks和wants概念进行主题分析。结果识别出学术英语能力、专业沟通、技术词汇、口语自信和情境化学习活动五大主题，学生在外文期刊文献理解、学术写作及学科术语掌握方面存在困难，口语自信不足影响其英语交流参与。研究建议ESP课程应整合学术素养、学科词汇和实践性交流活动。

papers.title: Plastic Pollution in Aquatic Environments: Connecting Water and Wastewater, Hydrology, Groundwater and Its Impacts on Sustainable Aquaculture and Fisheries
papers.authors: Eunice, Akinbobola Taiwo; Oluwadamilola, Adebayo; Adamu, Tuhami Alhaji; Abubakar, Musa Ishaq; Ataragba, Abdulfatahi Abdulrahman; Yetunde, Adesaogun Aishat; Abdulmumini, Adamu
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: Plastic pollution is commonly investigated within separate compartments, although particles and plastic-associated materials move through wastewater infrastructure, stormwater networks, rivers, sediments, aquifers, aquaculture facilities and fishing grounds. This disciplinary separation impedes source attribution, comparison of exposure estimates and evaluation of controls. This critical narrative review integrates evidence published from 2008 to 31 August 2026, drawing on verified experimental, observational, modelling and synthesis studies. It examines how material properties, hydrological connectivity and treatment processes jointly shape plastic transport, retention and biological exposure, with particular attention to sustainable aquaculture and fisheries. Conventional wastewater treatment captures substantial fractions of the particles measured in plant influent, but retained material is frequently transferred to sludge, and residual discharge remains relevant where effluent volumes are large. River emissions are strongly influenced by episodic runoff, floodplain retention and remobilisation; consequently, instantaneous concentrations poorly approximate catchment-scale delivery. Groundwater contamination is documented in karst, shallow and other vulnerable aquifers, yet filtration, preferential flow, sampling artefacts and limited temporal coverage restrict the estimation of subsurface fluxes. Aquaculture systems receive plastics through source water, equipment, feed and atmospheric inputs, while fishing activity generates additional macroplastic hazards through lost gear. Laboratory studies demonstrate organism-level responses under some exposure conditions, including oxidative stress and reproductive effects, but these findings cannot automatically be translated into population-level losses or human health risks. A source-to-receptor framework is proposed that separates particle abundance from mass flux, identifies changes in particle characteristics across compartments, and links biological evidence to environmentally plausible exposure. Priorities include harmonised size-resolved measurements, paired surface-water–groundwater monitoring, event-based mass balances, realistic chronic exposure designs and intervention evaluation across the entire material lifecycle. Sustainable management requires upstream plastic prevention alongside independently assessed treatment and gear-retention measures, rather than reliance on end-of-pipe removal alone.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述整合2008年至2026年间实验、观测、建模及综合研究证据，提出从源头到受体的框架，考察塑料材料特性、水文连通性与处理工艺如何共同影响塑料在水体、废水系统、地下水、水产养殖设施和渔场间的迁移、滞留与生物暴露。研究发现，常规污水处理虽能截留大量颗粒，但截留物多转入污泥，大排放量下残余排放仍具意义；河流排放受事件性径流与洪泛区滞留/再悬浮强烈影响，瞬时浓度难以代表流域尺度输送；岩溶及浅层等脆弱含水层已记录地下水污染，但过滤、优先流和采样偏差限制了对地下通量的估算。水产养殖通过水源、设备、饲料和大气沉降输入塑料，捕捞活动则因丢失渔具产生额外大型塑料危害；实验室暴露可致氧化应激和生殖影响，但尚不能外推至种群损失或人体健康风险。管理需上游塑料预防与处理及渔具滞留措施并重，而非仅依赖末端去除。

papers.title: El Niño Events and Peruvian Fisheries: Multispecies Responses and Adaptive Management
papers.authors: Cornejo, Rodolfo; Alvites, Walter; Martinez Alban, Pascual Alejandro; Inga Ayala, Johnny Omar; Chiroque Zavala, Elver Alexis
papers.abstract: The warm El Niño event alters the productivity, distribution, catchability, and management of Peruvian fishery resources. A systematic review following PRISMA 2020 guidelines was conducted, complemented by a descriptive synthesis of scientific publications and official documents covering the period 2015--2026. The results revealed heterogeneous ecological and fisheries responses to warm conditions. Peruvian anchoveta exhibited coastal concentration, deeper schooling distributions, and changes in size structure, whereas jumbo flying squid, jack mackerel, and Pacific bonito showed temporary availability to certain fishing fleets. Fishery landings simultaneously reflected environmental variability, resource accessibility, fishing effort, and regulatory measures; therefore, they cannot be considered direct estimates of abundance. Strengthening adaptive, climate-responsive, and multispecies fisheries management is recommended through integrated hydroacoustic and oceanographic monitoring, dynamic spatial closures, and differentiated forecasting for coastal and offshore environments to support timely and evidence-based fisheries management decisions. The 2026 El Niño event is considered an ongoing episode.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于PRISMA 2020指南系统综述2015–2026年文献与官方文件，评估暖El Niño事件对秘鲁渔业资源生产力、分布、可捕性及管理的影响。结果显示物种响应异质：秘鲁鳀（anchoveta）向沿岸聚集、鱼群分布更深且体型结构改变，而茎柔鱼、智利竹筴鱼和太平洋狐鲣则对特定船队出现临时性可获得性。捕捞量同时受环境变动、资源可达性、捕捞努力量和管理措施影响，不能直接视为资源丰度指标。建议通过水声学与海洋学联合监测、动态空间禁渔区及近岸与离岸差异化预报，强化适应性、气候响应型多物种渔业管理。

papers.title: Evaluation of Urban Put-And-Take Channel Catfish Fisheries in Kansas
papers.authors: Koch, Jeff D.; Neely, Ben C.; Steffen, Susan F.; Conley, Jeff; Sowards, Bryan; Breth, David
papers.journal: Transactions of the Kansas Academy of Science
papers.abstract: Understanding how stocked fish contribute to recreational fisheries is critical for efficient management, especially when stocked fish can be a costly component of put-and-take programs. To examine how stocked, catchable-size Channel Catfish (Ictalurus punctatus) are utilized by Kansas anglers, we stocked marked Channel Catfish into four urban impoundments over two years (i.e. two impoundments were stocked in 2023 and two were stocked in 2024) and monitored angler catch with creel surveys. The probability of an angler catching zero fish on a trip was lower during stocked years in only one of four instances. Catch rate of successful anglers (i.e. anglers that caught at least one fish on their trip) was higher at one of four study impoundments during stocking years. In total, 57% of angled Channel Catfish were harvested, and marked fish comprised between 31% and 69% of total Channel Catfish harvest at each impoundment during the year of stocking. Approximately 50% of stocked Channel Catfish that were harvested by anglers in the study were caught within 23 days after stocking. Carryover fish from previous years' stockings also comprised 31% to 69% of harvest in stocked years. We also surveyed anglers about their angling preferences and awareness of stocking programs. Approximately half of surveyed anglers were seeking “catfish” and were not aware of programs aimed at urban fisheries management. In general, put-and-take Channel Catfish stockings provided variable results on angler catch and carryover fish from previous years' stockings were an important component of the fisheries. These results suggest decreases in stocking rates may be warranted and stocking dates should be strategically timed to coincide with popular angling times throughout the year to maximize catch of stocked fish.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过在两年的时间内向四个城市水体放流标记的斑点叉尾鮰（Ictalurus punctatus），结合钓获调查（creel survey）评估放流鱼对休闲渔业贡献。结果显示，放流年份仅一个水体钓鱼者空手而归的概率降低，一个水体的钓获率提高；放流鱼占各水体斑点叉尾鮰总渔获量的31%–69%，约50%的放流鱼在放流后23天内被捕获，往年放流残留鱼同样占渔获量的31%–69%。约半数受访钓鱼者目标鱼种为鲶类且不了解城市渔业管理项目，表明put-and-take放流效果不一，残留鱼是渔业的重要组成部分，建议降低放流密度并优化放流时间以匹配垂钓高峰。

papers.title: A framework for assessing producer empowerment in wild-capture marine fisheries: insights from MSC-certified fisheries in developing economies
papers.authors: Gammage, Louise C.; Ward, Catherine D.; Lejbowicz, Amanda; Longo, Catherine S.; Oloruntuyi, Oluyemisi; Watson, Ralph G.A.; Espinosa, Maria Jose; Halim, Abdul; Nyiawung, Richard A.; Putten, Ingrid van
papers.abstract: Abstract Empowerment is increasingly recognised as a critical dimension of sustainability in marine fisheries, particularly in promoting equity. Recognising and reporting empowerment dynamics could enhance sustainability outcomes and build resilience in fishing communities. However, little is known about how management interventions, such as eco-certification schemes, render producer empowerment visible or not. This paper makes two contributions. First, we present a framework for assessing producer empowerment in wild-capture marine fisheries, comprising 59 attributes organised around the four pillars of full-spectrum sustainability and operationalising the resources-agency-achievements scaffolding, with each attribute mapped to one of six equity dimensions. Second, we demonstrate the framework’s application through a case study of 35 MSC-certified fisheries operating in developing economies, interrogating how producer empowerment is made visible in MSC Principle 3 documentation. Combining attribute-level scoring with ordination and qualitative profiling, we find a consistent governance baseline - including secure or customary rights, access to information, producer organisations, and transparent processes - yet uneven visibility of social and economic attributes. Differences were context-dependent rather than regionally uniform, with many small-scale systems performing similarly to larger fleets in the presence of strong institutions. The results indicate that eco-certification could contribute to fishery producer empowerment by either reinforcing existing empowerment or acting as a catalyst, but outcomes are highly dependent on wider social and institutional contexts, where visibility is shaped by reporting architectures. The framework’s structure does not presume any particular certification scheme as its subject, and applied to other reporting regimes, such as national fisheries assessments or fishery improvement projects, it would reveal distinct visibility profiles. Importantly, through the development of this initial framework, we show how empowerment could be measured using certification schemes given their rigorous frameworks and reporting structures. By using the MSC as a case study, we are also able to examine how eco-certification could catalyse or reinforce producer empowerment. Looking forward, the framework provides a portable instrument for tracking producer empowerment across different reporting regimes, where its application alongside complementary policy, capacity, and reporting reforms could help translate institutional inclusion into substantive empowerment in marine fisheries.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究旨在构建野生捕捞海洋渔业生产者赋权评估框架，以弥补生态认证等管理干预对赋权可见性影响的认识不足。框架包含59项属性，围绕全谱可持续性四大支柱组织，操作化资源—能动性—成就（resources-agency-achievements）架构，并将每项属性映射至六个公平维度。通过对35个发展中国家MSC认证渔业的案例研究，结合属性评分、排序分析和定性剖析，发现治理基线一致（如权利保障、信息获取、生产者组织和透明流程），但社会与经济属性的可见性不均衡，差异呈情境依赖而非区域均一。结果表明生态认证可强化或催化生产者赋权，但成效高度依赖更广泛的社会与制度情境及报告架构。

papers.title: Gut Microbiome Assembly and Its Consequences for Disease Susceptibility in Fish
papers.authors: Behera, Gayatree; Hammer, Sabine E.; Holzer, Astrid S.; Saleh, Mona
papers.abstract: The assembly of the gut microbiome in fish is a dynamic and tightly regulated process influenced by host genetics, early-life environmental exposure, diet, and aquaculture practices. Increasing evidence indicates that deliberate manipulation of this assembly through probiotics, prebiotics, synbiotics, environmental microbiome management, and husbandry interventions can significantly alter host–microbe interactions and downstream health outcomes. This review synthesizes we have summarized the current understanding about the regulatory principles of gut microbiome assembly in fish and explored the impact of manipulating the microbiome assembly process. Emphasis will be given to the early-life microbial colonization process, which is an important time point for microbiota succession and plays an important role in the development of immunity and resistance against diseases. Aquaculture systems, like recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) and flow-through system, where there is variation in microbiome exposure and water quality, further influence the process of microbiome assembly and pathogen dynamics. Several manipulative techniques, such as live feed enrichment, the seeding of microbes, and the management of water microbiomes, have been successful in inducing the growth of beneficial microbes while suppressing opportunistic pathogens. However, the risk of microbiome dysbiosis, reduction in microbial resilience, and pathogen resistance due to microbiome manipulation cannot be overlooked. Understanding these trade-offs is essential for developing sustainable and effective strategies. By integrating insights from microbiology, immunology, and aquaculture science, this review carries out a systematic PRISMA analysis, highlights the consequences of microbiome manipulation on disease susceptibility, and provides a framework for designing microbiome-informed interventions to enhance fish health and productivity in modern aquaculture systems.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了鱼类肠道微生物组组装受宿主遗传、早期环境暴露、饲料及养殖方式调控的规律，重点聚焦早期微生物定植对免疫发育和抗病力的关键作用。通过PRISMA分析，评估了益生菌、益生元、合生元及水体微生物管理等干预手段对宿主-微生物互作和疾病易感性的影响，并比较了RAS与流水养殖系统中微生物暴露与病原动态的差异。指出微生物组操控虽可促进有益菌、抑制条件致病菌，但需权衡菌群失调、微生物韧性下降及病原耐药等风险，为基于微生物组的鱼类健康管理提供了框架。

papers.title: Species Diversity and Socioeconomic Conditions of Dry Fish Traders in Lalmonirhat and Kurigram Districts, Bangladesh
papers.authors: Haque, Md. Ahosanul; Mia, Md. Rahat; Nayem, Nayemul Hasan; Paul, Arpita; Sarkar, Tithi Rani; Akter, Moriom; Razzak, Rafay Ibna Abdur; Sutrodhar, Sawrup
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: Dry-fish trading provides market opportunities in northern Bangladesh, yet local evidence on species composition, trade patterns, and traders' circumstances remains limited. This study assessed dried-fish species diversity, supply routes, marketing practices, and the socioeconomic conditions of retailers in Lalmonirhat and Kurigram districts. A market survey was undertaken from March to December 2025 in six purposively selected markets. Questionnaire-based interviews were conducted with 30 retailers, and information was cross-checked with key informants. Descriptive data were processed using Microsoft Excel. Across the selected markets, 38 dried-fish species were recorded, comprising 21 freshwater and 17 marine species. Commonly available products included Loitta, Churi, Bata, Baim, Puti, Mola, Ilish, Poa, Rupchanda, Icha, Chela, and Kachki. Recorded prices ranged from BDT 240 to 1,300 per kilogram. The Teesta dried-fish market served as a distribution point for products supplied from several production and wholesale centres. The rainy season accounted for the largest reported share of peak marketing activity (56%), followed by winter (34%) and summer (10%). Among retailers, 53.3% were aged 35–50 years, while 46.6% reported daily earnings of BDT 1,000–2,000. Four marketing channels were identified. Respondents reported insufficient capital, high transportation costs, limited storage facilities, and unhygienic market conditions as major constraints. These findings describe the diversity and trading arrangements of the surveyed markets and indicate practical areas for improving storage, transportation, and market conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了孟加拉国Lalmonirhat和Kurigram两县干鱼贸易的物种多样性、供应链路径、营销方式及零售商社会经济状况，于2025年3—12月对6个市场30名零售商进行问卷调查。共记录38种干鱼（21种淡水种、17种海水种），价格范围为每公斤240~1300塔卡，Teesta干鱼市场为主要集散地，雨季为营销旺季（56%）。研究识别出4条营销渠道，零售商面临资金不足、运输成本高、储藏设施缺乏及市场卫生条件差等主要制约。

papers.title: Culturable bacterial diversity in a recirculating aquaculture system for sole fish farming: analysis of potential pathogens and putative bioremediation, probiotic and antimicrobial significance
papers.authors: Gonçalves, Bárbara; Suárez-Moo, Pablo; Prieto-Davó, Alejandra; Marques, Carlos; Sobral, Rita G.; Gaudêncio, Susana P.
papers.journal: Frontiers in Food Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Understanding the bacterial diversity present in recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS) is essential for identifying potential pathogens and taxa with bioremediation and biotechnological relevance, particularly as these artificial environments remain largely unexplored bioresources with untapped microbial potential. This study is the first to characterize the culturable bacterial diversity within a RAS for sole farming ( Solea senegalensis ) in Portugal, providing a comprehensive first insight into what seems to be a complex bacterial dynamic. Phylogenetic analysis of 193 strains, revealed that Pseudomonadota (76.4%) was the most abundant phylum, followed by Actinomycetia (10.7%), and Bacteroidota (9.8%). At the class level, Gammaproteobacteria (65.7%), Actinomycetia (10.7%), and Alphaproteobacteria (10.7%) dominated, with Alteromonadales (33.9%) and Vibrionales (13.7%) as the prevalent orders. A comparison with metagenomic studies previously reported for similar RAS systems showed some overlap in dominant phyla, however, different genera were also cultivated in the present study, particularly those from the orders Micrococcales and Vibrionales. In all, a total of 48 bacterial genera were identified, with 33 cultivated only from the RAS and 9 cultivated only from its water supply. Our findings reveal the presence of taxa closely related to bacterial strains previously reported for their biotechnological potential, including strains described as probiotics, as producers of antimicrobial compounds, and as agents of bioremediation. Although strains related to fish and human pathogenic bacteria were isolated and identified, their pathogenicity was not confirmed. The high bacterial diversity isolated from the S. senegalensis RAS highlights the use of these artificial systems as bioresources that offer opportunities for the development of sustainable products for both human and aquaculture health.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次对葡萄牙塞内加尔鳎（Solea senegalensis）循环水养殖系统（RAS）中的可培养细菌多样性进行表征，对193株菌进行系统发育分析，发现Pseudomonadota（76.4%）为优势门，Alteromonadales（33.9%）和Vibrionales（13.7%）为主要目，共鉴定48个细菌属，其中33属仅从RAS中分离、9属仅从供水系统中分离。与已有宏基因组研究比较显示优势门存在部分重叠，但本研究分离到Micrococcales和Vibrionales等不同属。分离菌株中包含与益生菌、抗菌化合物产生菌及生物修复菌密切相关的类群，虽分离到与鱼类和人类病原菌相关的菌株但致病性未获确认，表明RAS可作为开发水产养殖可持续产品的生物资源库。

papers.title: Nigella sativa-Based Extender Enhances Nilem (Osteochilus vittatus) Sperm Quality: Implications for Sustainable Aquaculture Practices
papers.authors: Astuti, Yuni; ., Abinawanto; Dewi, RRS. Pudji Sinarni; Dwiranti, Astari; Lestari, Retno; ., Fadhillah; Lestari, Suci
papers.abstract: Background and Aim Preservation of Nilem ( Osteochilus vittatus ) spermatozoa is essential for sustainable aquaculture and the development of reproductive biotechnology. This study evaluated the effectiveness of a commercial habbatussauda ( Nigella sativa ) extract as a natural antioxidant-based extender for maintaining sperm quality during 48 h cold storage at 4 °C. Materials and Methods Sperm samples were supplemented with commercial habbatussauda extract at concentrations of 1% (P 1 ), 2% (P 2 ), 3% (P 3 ), and 4% (P 4 ). Untreated sperm served as a negative control (P 0 ), while sperm treated with 0.005% pure thymoquinone acted as a positive control (P TQ ). All samples were stored at 4 °C for 48 hours with six replicates per treatment. Post-storage assessments included sperm viability, motility, and morphological abnormalities. Ultrastructural integrity of spermatozoa was qualitatively evaluated using Cryogenic Scanning Electron Microscopy (CRYO-SEM). Results The 2% habbatussauda extract (P 2 ) yielded the highest sperm viability (84.80 ± 5.54%) and motility (73.25 ± 10.82%) and significantly reduced abnormality rates compared to the untreated control. CRYO-SEM analysis revealed severe ultrastructural damage in untreated spermatozoa, including plasma membrane disruption, head deformation, and flagellar breakage. In contrast, spermatozoa preserved with 1–2% extract, particularly P 2 , maintained intact plasma membranes, normal head morphology, and well-preserved flagella. Higher extract concentrations (3–4%) induced mild ultrastructural alterations. Conclusion A 2% commercial habbatussauda ( Nigella sativa ) extract effectively preserves Nilem sperm quality and ultrastructure during short-term cold storage, supporting its application as a natural antioxidant protectant in aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了黑种草（Nigella sativa）提取物作为天然抗氧化剂型 extender 在4 °C短期保存48 h过程中对Nilem（Osteochilus vittatus）精子质量的保护效果，设置1%–4%提取物处理组并以0.005%百里醌及未处理组分别作为阳性和阴性对照。结果表明，2%提取物组精子存活率（84.80 ± 5.54%）和活力（73.25 ± 10.82%）最高，畸形率显著降低；CRYO-SEM观察显示该组精子质膜、头部形态及鞭毛结构保持完整，而高浓度（3%–4%）则引起轻度超微结构损伤。研究提示2%黑种草提取物可有效维持Nilem精子短期低温保存质量，具备作为水产养殖天然抗氧化保护剂的潜力。

papers.title: Delayed Transmural Migration of a Fish Bone Mimicking  a Gastric Submucosal Tumor and Resulting  in Lesser Sac Abscess: A Case Report
papers.authors: Son, Tran Que; Chi Trung, Nguyen; Van Vuong, Mai; Thu Huong, Tran; Ngoc Quang, Nong
papers.journal: VNU Journal of Science: Medical and Pharmaceutical Sciences
papers.abstract: Abstract: Introduction: Foreign body ingestion is a common clinical condition, with fish bones being the leading cause of gastrointestinal perforation. However, gastric wall perforation leading to a lesser sac abscess is extremely rare. Case presentation: A 65-year-old woman with a history of gastric GIST resection presented with epigastric pain. Retrospective review of endoscopy and CT from 21 months prior revealed a 25-mm gastric antrum lesion mimicking a submucosal tumor and localized inflammatory changes with a hyperdense linear structure. Current CT demonstrated a 49 × 29 mm lesser sac abscess containing a 21-mm linear foreign body. Diagnostic laparoscopy revealed a localized abscess cavity and fully migrated 25-mm fish bone. The gastric perforation site had completely self-sealed via fibrosis, requiring no closure. The patient recovered uneventfully after abscess drainage and foreign body removal. Conclusion: Delayed transmural migration of a fish bone can mimic a gastric submucosal tumor before causing a lesser sac abscess. Laparoscopic surgery is a safe, effective, and minimally invasive therapeutic approach. Keywords: Fish bone, Foreign bodies, Stomach perforation, Abscess, Laparoscopy.

papers.title: Multi‐Decadal Warming in Sweden Drove Fish Community Thermophilization Through Species Turnover in Marine Coastal Waters, but Was Limited in Brackish Coastal Waters and Lakes
papers.authors: Koehler, Birgit; Holmgren, Kerstin; Sundblad, Göran; Sandström, Alfred; Erlandsson, Mårten; Bergström, Lena
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Large‐scale biodiversity patterns are increasingly reshaped by climate change, yet long‐term empirical comparisons across aquatic systems remain scarce. Using 3–4 decades of incidence data from fish monitoring in Sweden we analyzed long‐term trends in species richness (SR), turnover, beta diversity, functional characteristics and individual species trajectories, for lakes of different sizes and coastal areas representing different salinity conditions. Differences in inventory completeness were accounted for by rarefaction‐extrapolation, enabling comparisons across systems and time using standardized SR (SR std ). Inventory completeness was high (69%–100%) and generally declined from systems with lower to higher SR. Fish SR remained largely unchanged over time in lakes, which had low connectivity with other water bodies. Fish SR std increased by 11%–32% in the more marine sub‐basins, a trend mainly driven by increasing SR of small/medium‐sized, demersal/demersal‐pelagic and warm‐affiliated marine species, whereas SR of cold‐affiliated and pelagic species decreased. Notably, while species appearances slowed down in recent years, local extirpations became more frequent. The community turnover led to biotic homogenization across the more marine sub‐basins over the years 2000–2017, when colonization‐resultant changes in beta diversity dominated, whereas biotic differentiation occurred during recent years, when extinction‐resultant changes dominated. In all, the observed patterns suggest that warming drove progressive thermophilization of the fish communities in the highly connected, more marine sub‐basins, while thermophilization was limited by the brackish conditions for the inner Baltic Sea, and by low hydrological connectivity for the lakes. With continued warming, further shifts in fish communities and associated ecosystem functions are expected, underscoring the importance of monitoring to support ecosystem‐based management and climate change adaptation. While constraining climate change is crucial to address the key driver of the ongoing thermophilization, targeted management actions such as habitat restoration and implementing climate refugia can help to strengthen local resilience of species and ecosystems under pressure.
papers.summary_cn: 基于瑞典鱼类监测3–4十年的分布数据，研究分析了不同大小湖泊及不同盐度沿海水域鱼类物种丰富度、周转率、beta多样性与功能特征的长期趋势，并以rarefaction-extrapolation校正调查完整性。结果显示湖泊鱼类丰富度基本不变，而海洋性较强的沿岸亚区标准化丰富度增加11%–32%，主要由小型/中型、底层/近底层及暖水affiliated海洋物种驱动，冷水及远洋物种减少；近年物种迁入减缓但局部灭绝更频繁。群落周转在2000–2017年导致海洋性亚区biotic homogenization，近年则因灭绝主导出现biotic differentiation，表明变暖通过物种周转推动海洋沿岸鱼类群落thermophilization，而半咸水与湖泊条件限制了该过程。

papers.title: Seasonal dynamics of eukaryotic microalgae in Osaka Bay revealed from time series data by 18S rRNA amplicon sequencing analysis
papers.authors: Yurioka, Saki; Tominaga, Kento; Yamamoto, Keigo; Kamikawa, Ryoma; Yoshida, Takashi
papers.abstract: Abstract Eukaryotic microalgae fundamentally contribute to marine primary production throughout the year. However, a comprehensive understanding of their year-round fluctuations in coastal ecosystems remains limited. In this study, we identified the major microalgae and their fluctuation patterns in Osaka Bay by analyzing the 18S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing of seawater samples collected monthly for 18 months. The eukaryotic community structure, comprising over 3000 amplicon sequence variants (ASVs), exhibited clear seasonal dynamics. In particular, Picochlorum geojense ( Trebouxiophyceae ) was the major microalga in Osaka Bay, reaching a relative abundance of over 60% in summer. The highest relative abundance of P. geojense was even higher than that of other bloom-forming species in Osaka Bay: the raphidophycean Heterosigma akashiwo and the diatom Skeletonema spp. The canonical correspondence analysis suggested that temperature and phosphate significantly influenced the community dynamics. Furthermore, co-occurrence network analysis identified a positive correlation between the heterotrophic bacterium Cryomorphaceae and P. geojense , suggesting a potential biotic association. Similarly, ASVs of major diatoms and dinoflagellates were estimated to function as highly connected ecological hubs, given their co-occurrence with multiple ASVs. These results showed that the seasonal dynamics of dominant microalgae in Osaka Bay were associated with environmental factors and showed co-occurrence patterns with specific prokaryotes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过18个月逐月采集大阪湾海水样品，利用18S rRNA基因扩增子测序分析真核微藻群落的季节动态。共鉴定出3000余个ASVs，群落结构呈现明显季节性变化，其中Picochlorum geojense（Trebouxiophyceae）为夏季优势种，相对丰度超过60%，高于Heterosigma akashiwo和Skeletonema spp.等赤潮种。典范对应分析表明温度和磷酸盐显著影响群落动态，共现网络分析揭示Cryomorphaceae异养细菌与P. geojense呈正相关，主要硅藻和甲藻ASVs作为生态枢纽与其他多个ASVs共现。

papers.title: CORRECTION: Isotopic niche of Centrostephanus rodgersii from barrens overlap with those from macroalgal forests in SE Australia
papers.authors: Day, Jeremy Karl; Raoult, Vincent; Knott, Nathan A; Ayre, David; Huggett, Megan J; Gaston, Troy F
papers.summary_cn: 该文为对 *Centrostephanus rodgersii* 同位素生态位研究的更正说明，原文比较了澳大利亚东南部贫藻区（barrens）与大型藻林中海胆的同位素生态位重叠情况。更正内容本身未提供新的研究数据或结论。

papers.title: Beyond Commodities: Centering Communities in Fisheries Improvement Efforts
papers.authors: Martínez Tovar, Iván; Tullos Anderson, Jada; Quiros, Jose; Jerí, Juan Carlos; Mejía‐Falla, Paola A.; Miller, Marissa Anne S.; Guzman, Ana Gloria; McNellis, Maureen; Valencia Martínez, Natasha; Finkbeiner, Elena M.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Small‐scale fisheries (SSFs) support local economies, contribute to food security, and provide livelihoods to millions of people worldwide. However, the SSF sector faces significant challenges, despite years of diverse interventions, including market‐based certifications and fisheries improvement projects. Many interventions have largely focused on narrow conceptions of environmental sustainability and overlooked SSF communities that target nonexport‐oriented resources, crucial for local food security and nutrition. In light of this, we developed a conceptual model for driving broader, comprehensive improvements in SSFs, including social, environmental, and financial conditions. Here, we present this conceptual model—the Community‐based Fishery Improvement Project—and lessons from its implementation in coastal communities of Colombia, Costa Rica, and Peru. These lessons learned offer valuable insights for small‐scale blue food systems, regionally and globally, where current governance and market‐based interventions are falling short of sustainability and equity goals.
papers.summary_cn: 小型渔业（SSF）虽支撑地方经济与粮食安全，但现有市场认证和渔业改良项目多聚焦环境可持续性，忽视了面向本地消费的社区。本研究构建了涵盖社会、环境与经济维度的“社区型渔业改良项目”概念模型，并在哥伦比亚、哥斯达黎加和秘鲁沿海社区实施。经验表明，该模式可为治理与市场干预未能实现可持续与公平目标的小型蓝色食物系统提供区域及全球借鉴。

papers.title: Seafood loss and waste as nutrient loss: Implications for nutrition security in the United States
papers.authors: Oyikeke, Tolulope Samuel; Love, David C.; Grinnell, Willow
papers.abstract: Seafood provides protein, long-chain omega-3 fatty acids, and micronutrients, yet consumption remains low in the United States. During 2014 to 2018, an estimated 22.7% of the United States edible aquatic animal food supply was lost or wasted, excluding processing by-products not sold as food. We reframe seafood loss and waste as nutrient loss and consider implications for nutrition security. This commentary draws on selected studies and official reports on intake, composition, processing, safety, loss and access. We propose nutrient-based measurement, loss prevention through product and market design, and safe, feasible recovery. An illustrative calculation links a specified processing fraction to its nutrient content, distinguishing it from nutrients that are recovered, consumed, or absorbed. Historical estimates and varied study settings limit conclusions about population benefits. Recovery could help use already-harvested seafood more effectively, provided products are safe, affordable, acceptable, and evaluated against alternative uses.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究将美国2014–2018年约22.7%的可食用水生动物食品供应损失与浪费重新定义为营养素损失，探讨其对营养安全的影响。作者基于摄入量、组成、加工、安全与可及性等研究与官方报告，提出以营养素为基础的计量方法、通过产品与市场设计预防损失，以及安全可行的回收利用途径。示例性计算将特定加工比例与其营养素含量关联，区分回收、消费与吸收的营养素。历史估算与不同研究背景限制了人群效益结论，回收利用需确保产品安全、可负担、可接受并与其他用途比较评估。

papers.title: Age and growth of the spiny butterfly ray G ymnura altavela ( E lasmobranchii, G ymnuridae) in the S outhwest A tlantic (in situ) and under human care in a public aquarium (ex situ): Plasticity and population patterns
papers.authors: Teixeira‐Leite, Clara V.; Vaz‐dos‐Santos, André Martins; Santana, Francisco Marcante; Santander‐Neto, Jones; Hauser‐Davis, Rachel Ann; Santos, Sergio Ricardo; Vianna, Marcelo
papers.abstract: Abstract This study provides the first age and growth assessment of the endangered spiny butterfly ray, Gymnura altavela (Linnaeus, 1758), in the Southwest Atlantic, while also updating the growth parameters (asymptotic disc width—DW ∞ and growth coefficient— k ) estimated in an ex situ a marine aquarium setting. In situ growth was assessed by analyzing the vertebrae of 95 individuals captured off the southeastern coast of Brazil. The Centrum Edge and Marginal Increment analyses indicated an annual annuli formation cycle. After applying a multi‐model approach, the Gompertz model was selected as the most appropriate for describing the in situ growth of both females (DW ∞ = 201.0 cm and k = 0.100 year −1 ) and males (DW ∞ = 139.4 cm and k = 0.170 year −1 ). In turn, ex situ growth was assessed by periodically measuring seven individuals kept in a marine aquarium for 8 years (2018–2025). The von Bertalanffy model modified by Fabens was used to estimate ex situ growth parameters for females (DW ∞ = 212.1 cm and k = 0.132 year −1 ) and males (DW ∞ = 120.1 cm and k = 0.255 year −1 ). A well‐marked sexual size dimorphism was observed in both in situ and ex situ, with females growing more slowly but reaching larger sizes than males. G. altavela grew faster in the controlled environment (ex situ). However, reaching the maturity size earlier may not necessarily result in anticipated reproduction events and it may also have a negative effect on longevity. Comparing the growth parameters and curves estimated in situ and ex situ provides valuable insight into how this population may respond to future environmental changes and impacts.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次对西南大西洋濒危物种刺蝶鳐（Gymnura altavela）进行年龄与生长评估，基于巴西东南沿海95尾个体的脊椎骨分析（in situ），同时更新了公共水族馆8年饲养7尾个体的ex situ生长参数。in situ数据经多模型拟合选择Gompertz模型最优（雌性DW∞=201.0 cm, k=0.100 yr⁻¹；雄性DW∞=139.4 cm, k=0.170 yr⁻¹），ex situ数据采用Fabens修正von Bertalanffy模型估算（雌性DW∞=212.1 cm, k=0.132 yr⁻¹；雄性DW∞=120.1 cm, k=0.255 yr⁻¹）。两种条件下均呈现明显的雌雄体型异形，雌性生长较慢但体型更大；ex situ环境中的个体生长更快，但提早达到性成熟未必导致繁殖事件提前，且可能对寿命产生负面影响。

papers.title: Independent origin of genomic imprinting in placental fish
papers.authors: Zhang, Ying; Campbell, Polly; Kingsley, Alec; Reynoso, Yuridia; Kang, Yuan; Huang, Chen-Che Jeff; Werren, John H.; Reznick, David; Wang, Xu
papers.abstract: Genomic imprinting results in biased expression of one parental allele. Such non-Mendelian expression occurs in angiosperms and placental mammals, which share having an active paternal genome during maternal offspring provisioning. It is hypothesized that imprinting modulates conflict between maternal control of resource allocation and paternal control of resource acquisition. If true, then imprinting should evolve in any organism that evolves a placenta. Here, we demonstrate genomic imprinting in a placental poeciliid fish, Poeciliopsis prolifica . Using transcriptomes from reciprocal crosses between two inbred strains, we identified 84 protein-coding genes with robust evidence of imprinting in P. prolifica placenta. These include the teleost ortholog of mammalian imprinted gene, grb10 , and a pair of adjacent genes, dpp4 and gcga , with opposing effects on glucose metabolism that are oppositely imprinted in a fashion that potentially resolves parental conflict. Significantly elevated allelic DNA methylation on the promoters of two focal imprinted genes suggests epigenetic mechanisms of imprinting similar to those in mammals. We also discovered the convergent recruitment of a gene network associated with nutrient transport in mammals. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of genomic imprinting in a non-mammalian vertebrate and supports the potential role of imprinting in resolving parental conflict.
papers.summary_cn: 以胎生鱼类 *Poeciliopsis prolifica* 为对象，通过正反交转录组分析首次在非哺乳类脊椎动物中鉴定出84个印记基因，包括哺乳类印记基因 grb10 的同源基因及一对对葡萄糖代谢具拮抗作用、印记方向相反的相邻基因 dpp4 和 gcga。研究发现焦点印记基因启动子区等位DNA甲基化显著升高，提示与哺乳类相似的表观遗传机制，并发现营养转运相关基因网络的趋同招募。该研究支持 genomic imprinting 在解决亲本冲突中的作用，并表明胎生鱼类中印记机制独立起源。

papers.title: Spatial assessment of land suitability for aquaculture in the Tena River basin, Napo‐Ecuador
papers.authors: Villacis, Blanca; Rojas, Byron Maza; Rodes‐Blanco, Marina; Celi, Jorge
papers.journal: Journal of the World Aquaculture Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Aquaculture in the Tena River Basin (Ecuador) is a key contributor to the local economy and food security; however, it also poses environmental risks, including water pollution and the decline of native species. This highlights the need for land‐use planning to identify suitable areas for its development, considering environmental, socioeconomic, and legal criteria. In this research, geographic information systems (GIS) and the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) were used to identify suitable areas for aquaculture. Two sub‐models representing five environmental criteria and four socioeconomic criteria were weighted and integrated. Risk and restriction criteria were also considered to protect the water resource and conservation areas of the basin. The results of the final suitability model identified that 1512 ha (6%) corresponds to suitable areas, 8283 ha (34%) moderately suitable, and 3381 ha (14%) unsuitable. The remaining area of 10.923 ha (45%) of the basin consists of sites where aquaculture cannot be carried out. Model validation using the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve yielded an area under the curve (AUC) value of 0.76, indicating an acceptable predictive performance. These findings provide a robust spatial framework that can guide local decision‐makers in strategically planning and regulating aquaculture activities to balance economic benefits with environmental sustainability and conservation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在通过土地利用规划识别厄瓜多尔Tena河流域适宜水产养殖的区域，综合考虑环境、社会经济和法律标准。采用GIS与层次分析法（AHP）构建两个子模型，分别整合五项环境标准和四项社会经济标准，并纳入风险与限制性标准以保护水资源和保护区。结果表明，流域内适宜养殖面积1512 ha（6%），中等适宜8283 ha（34%），不适宜3381 ha（14%），其余45%（10923 ha）不可开展养殖。ROC曲线验证AUC值为0.76，模型预测性能可接受，可为当地决策者规划与调控水产养殖提供空间框架。

papers.title: Distribution and habitat occurrence of flying fish (Exocoetidae) along a longitudinal gradient in the Southeast Pacific Ocean
papers.authors: Portflitt‐Toro, Matías; Serratosa, Juan; Luna, Nicolás; Luna‐Jorquera, Guillermo
papers.abstract: Abstract We characterized the distribution and relative density of flying fish across the Salas & Gómez, Nazca and Juan Fernández ridges to evaluate their relationship with key oceanographic variables using standardized visual strip‐transect surveys. Our results show that flying fish have a highly restricted distribution, occurring mainly in warm, oligotrophic waters, with peak densities concentrated around the Salas & Gómez Ridge. These observations offer new insight into the environmental constraints shaping Exocoetidae distribution, underscoring the need for further research on this family in the Southeast Pacific.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过标准化目视条带样带调查，描述了飞鱼（Exocoetidae）在东南太平洋Salas & Gómez、Nazca和Juan Fernández海脊沿经度梯度的分布与相对密度，并评估其与关键海洋学变量的关系。结果显示飞鱼分布高度受限，主要出现于温暖贫营养水域，密度峰值集中于Salas & Gómez海脊周边。研究揭示了塑造Exocoetidae分布的环境约束因素，强调需在东南太平洋对该科开展进一步研究。

papers.title: Oceanographic Variability Constrains Recovery of Overexploited Cod and Haddock on the Faroe Bank: Evidence for Environmental Recovery Windows at Low Stock Size
papers.authors: Salter, Ian; Hansen, Bogi; Hátun, Hjálmar; Vang, Helga Bára Mohr; Steingrund, Petur; Eliasen, Sólvá Káradóttir; Danielsen, Jóhannis; Gaard, Eilif; Eriksdóttir, Guðrið; Jacobsen, Sólvá
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT In a changing global ocean certain fish populations are approaching the upper limits of their thermal tolerance. Understanding how a warming climate and plankton dynamics affect stock recovery is thus a central challenge for fisheries management. Here we use the Faroe Bank ecosystem in the northeast Atlantic as a climate‐sensitive case study to investigate how environmental variability influences recovery of demersal fish stocks following overexploitation. Atlantic cod ( Gadus morhua ) and haddock ( Melanogrammus aeglefinus ) on the Faroe Bank declined rapidly after 2003, collapsed in 2005 and remained in a prolonged low‐abundance state until 2018–2020, despite a commercial fishing moratorium implemented in 2008. Using ~25 years of fisheries, biological and oceanographic observations, we evaluate environmental factors associated with this delayed recovery. Initial stock collapse was driven by heavy exploitation, whereas the prolonged low‐abundance state appears to have been reinforced by depensatory dynamics under relatively warm and less productive ecosystem conditions. Stock recovery began only when spring bottom temperatures declined in 2015–2016, coinciding with increased phytoplankton productivity, improved 0‐group fish growth and the return of sandeel ( Ammodytes spp.). We identify two interacting environmental bottlenecks limiting recovery at low abundance: (i) relatively warm and low‐productivity conditions limiting pelagic 0‐group growth and survival and (ii) temperature‐productivity constraints on 0‐group sandeel abundance reducing the availability of a key lipid‐rich prey resource for recovering stocks. The resurgence of 0‐group sandeel preceded increases in adult cod and haddock biomass and coincided with cooler, more productive conditions associated with variability in the subpolar gyre. These results suggest that the success of management actions to rebuild chronically depleted stocks can depend on “environmental recovery windows”, when reduced fishing pressure coincides with favourable temperature and trophic conditions. The Faroe Bank ecosystem therefore demonstrates how modest climatic variability can strongly influence stock rebuilding, with important implications for ecosystem‐based fisheries management under continued ocean warming.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用法罗群岛浅滩约25年的渔业、生物与海洋学观测数据，探讨过度捕捞后大西洋鳕（Gadus morhua）和黑线鳕（Melanogrammus aeglefinus）种群长期低迷及延迟恢复的环境机制。结果显示，初始种群崩溃由高强度捕捞驱动，而2005年后持续低丰度状态在偏暖、低生产力条件下被depensatory dynamics强化，尽管2008年已实施商业禁渔。恢复仅在2015–2016年春季底层水温下降、浮游植物生产力上升、0-group生长改善及玉筋鱼（Ammodytes spp.）回归后启动，表明低 stock size 下存在温度—生产力双重环境瓶颈。研究提出“environmental recovery windows”概念，即减捕措施需与有利温度和营养条件叠加方能奏效，对变暖背景下基于生态系统的渔业管理具有启示意义。

papers.title: Beyond illegal fishing: strengthening Somalia’s domestic fishing capacity to realize its fisheries potential
papers.authors: Dhore, Khalid Omar; Hashi, Sakariye Ahmed; Mohamed Farah Xirsi, Abdirahman; Abshir, Sadio Mohamed
papers.abstract: Somalia’s fisheries are characterized by substantial but largely unrealized development potential, yet domestic benefits remain limited. We introduce a Protection-Production–Value (PPV) framework that treats fisheries development as an integrated system of three interdependent pillars. In this framework, Protection ensures sustainable resource opportunity, Production converts that opportunity into harvest capacity, and Value determines how much of the resulting fisheries value is retained domestically. We identify three imbalance conditions – Protection without Production, Production without Protection, and Production without Value – each illustrating how weakness in one pillar constrains the others. For example, insufficient value capture limits reinvestment in infrastructure and monitoring, while data from harvest and markets can reinforce governance and sustainability. Our analysis emphasizes the need for holistic policies linking conservation, harvest, and value-chain development to maximize Somalia’s fisheries contributions to livelihoods, food security, and the economy.
papers.summary_cn: 针对索马里渔业开发潜力巨大但国内收益有限的现状，提出Protection-Production-Value（PPV）框架，将渔业发展视为保护、生产与价值留存三大相互依存支柱构成的整体系统。识别出“有保护无生产”“有生产无保护”“有生产无价值”三类失衡状态，揭示单一支柱薄弱如何制约其余支柱。强调需制定贯通养护、捕捞与价值链发展的整体性政策，以最大化渔业对生计、粮食安全和经济发展的贡献。

papers.title: Fish mislabeling on the market of Bosnia and Herzegovina
papers.authors: Fazlović, Neira; Lasić, Lejla; Čaklovica, Kenan; Stroil, Belma Kalamujić; Hanjalić, Jasna; Miralem, Merima; Šatrović, Lejla; Šatrović, Edin
papers.summary_cn: 该研究调查了波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那市场上鱼类产品的标签错误问题，但摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法、样本量及主要发现。建议补充摘要以全面评估其对该地区渔业管理与消费者权益的影响。

papers.title: IoT-Enabled Smart Aquaculture Monitoring System for Sustainable Freshwater Fish Farming in Telangana: A Field-Informed Framework
papers.authors: Vaishali, K; Manjula, A
papers.journal: International Journal of Applied Smart Interdisciplinary Technologies
papers.abstract: Freshwater aquaculture yield depends on water quality, stocking practices, feeding management, and timely identification of environmental stress. Conventional sporadic measurements may not capture short-term fluctuations in dissolved oxygen, pH, temperature, and ammonia that affect fish health. This paper presents a field-informed Internet of Things (IoT) framework for freshwater aquaculture monitoring in Karimnagar district, Telangana, India. The system requirements were derived from a structured farm valuation reported for 15 ponds. The proposed architecture separates the sensing layer, communication layer, cloud-storage layer sensor-interface and edge-processing layer, analytics layer, and farmer-interface layer. The framework is designed to monitor dissolved oxygen, pH, temperature, total ammonia nitrogen, turbidity, and water level, while maintaining related records of stocking, disease observations, feeding, and harvest. Wi-Fi, cellular communication, or LoRa-based transmission can be selected based on the farm connectivity and deployment requirements. The methodology incorporates data-quality checks, threshold-based alerts, historical visualization, local buffering, and a authentication methodology based on reference-instrument comparison. The planned assessment methods include mean absolute error, root mean square error, packet-delivery ratio, data completeness, Bland–Altman agreement alert latency, and system availability. The involvement of this study is a regionally informed system architecture and an integrated data model linking environmental monitoring with farm-management information. This work provides a basis for prototype implementation and empirical evaluation under freshwater aquaculture conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对印度特伦甘纳邦Karimnagar地区淡水养殖中传统 sporadic 水质监测难以捕捉溶解氧、pH、温度和氨氮短期波动的问题，基于15个池塘的结构化养殖场评估提出了一套 field-informed IoT 监测框架。框架采用分层架构（传感、通信、云存储、边缘处理、分析和养殖户界面），可监测溶解氧、pH、温度、总氨氮、浊度和水位，并整合放养、疾病、投喂和收获记录，支持Wi-Fi、蜂窝或LoRa传输。研究提出了基于参考仪器比对的数据质量检查、阈值警报和评估指标（MAE、RMSE、丢包率、数据完整性、Bland–Altman一致性、警报延迟和系统可用性），为原型实现和实证评估奠定基础。

papers.title: Assessment of Constraints and Prospects of Small-Scale Fish Farming in Jega LGA Area of Kebbi State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Wade, M. N
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF AGRICULTURE AND EARTH SCIENCE
papers.abstract: The survey was conducted to assess the constraints and prospects of small scale fish farming in Jega Local Government Area of kebbi State. Out of the eleven districts in the local government, four were purposively selected based on major dominance of fish farming practice. simple random sampling was used in the distribution of forty-one questionnaires, viz: Magaji A (10), Magaji B (16), Firchin (7), and Kokani (8). Results (table 4.1) shows the distribution of small scale fish farmers across the districts based on their locations in the study area and indicated Magaji B with 39.0%, Magaji A with 24.4%, and then Kokani having 19.5%, while the least was Firchin with 17.0%. It may be assumed that people who are fishermen by tradition and close to a perennial river may find it easier to adopt fish farming. In this case magaji B district has a greater number of small scale fish farmers 39.02%. The problems faced by fish farmers include lack of visitation by fisheries agencies, high cost of feeds, low product prices, high cost of various input, lack of marketing facilities, occurrence of some fish disease and lack of capital or credit facilities. As a recommendation, the local authorities may consider providing loan facilities to fish farmers with low interest rate.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了尼日利亚Kebbi州Jega地方政府区小规模水产养殖的制约因素与发展前景，采用目的性抽样选取4个主要养殖区并发放41份问卷。结果显示Magaji B区养殖户占比最高（39.0%），其次为Magaji A（24.4%）、Kokani（19.5%）和Firchin（17.0%），传统渔民身份及临近常年河流可能促进养殖采纳。养殖户面临的主要制约包括渔业机构缺乏走访指导、饲料成本高、产品价格低、投入品成本高、营销设施匮乏、鱼病发生及资金或信贷渠道缺失，建议地方当局提供低息贷款支持养殖户。

papers.title: Reduced Digestibility of Maize Starch in Freeze-Thaw Cycles: Mechanistic Insights into the Role of Fish Scale Peptides
papers.authors: Zheng, Yuxue; Wu, Zhilong; Ren, Yanming; Chen, Xu; Wang, Shaoyun
papers.abstract: Freeze-thaw (FT) cycles cause structural deterioration of maize starch (MS), accelerating starch digestibility and glycemic responses. This study investigated whether crimson snapper fish scale peptides (FSP) could modulate MS structure to reduce digestibility during FT cycles. FSP inhibited ice recrystallization and preserved bound water while suppressing free water increase. After three FT cycles, amylose content in MS-8FSP remained at 24.17% while 28.17% in MS, while Mw was unchanged. Hydrophobic interactions dominated FSP-starch binding, though hydrogen bonds weakened during freezing. SEM, XRD and DSC showed that MS-8FSP formed compact lamellar networks, with relative crystallinity increasing to 5.29% and Peak II enthalpy recovered after three FT cycles. Consequently, FSP reduced rapidly digestible starch and estimated glycemic index (MS-8FSP: 69.22; MS: 92.06). Pearson correlation analysis revealed that FSP binding and non-covalent bonds were negatively correlated with rapidly digestible starch and estimated glycemic index, whereas water permeability was positively correlated with both. In vivo, MS-8FSP significantly attenuated postprandial glucose responses in mice, with lower AUC than MS across all FT cycles. These findings suggest that FSP enhances starch FT stability and reduces digestibility, offering a promising ingredient for frozen starch-based foods with reduced glycemic potential.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨红鲷鱼鳞肽（FSP）在冻融循环中调控玉米淀粉（MS）结构以降低消化性的机制。FSP抑制冰重结晶、保留结合水并抑制自由水增加；经三次冻融后，MS-8FSP直链淀粉含量维持24.17%（MS为28.17%），疏水相互作用主导FSP-淀粉结合，形成致密层状网络，相对结晶度升至5.29%。FSP显著降低快速消化淀粉及估计血糖生成指数（MS-8FSP: 69.22；MS: 92.06），并在小鼠体内减弱餐后血糖反应。结果表明FSP可提升淀粉冻融稳定性并降低消化性，为低血糖潜能冷冻淀粉基食品提供潜在配料。

papers.title: Genomic Diversity, Predicted Serotype Distribution, and Antimicrobial Susceptibility of Tenacibaculum maritimum from Croatian Marine Aquaculture
papers.authors: Grbin, Dorotea; Zrnčić, Snježana; Alfier, Matea; Oraić, Dražen; Zupičić, Ivana Giovanna
papers.abstract: Tenacibaculum maritimum is an important bacterial pathogen of marine fish, causing disease outbreaks in aquaculture worldwide and raising concerns about antimicrobial resistance. This study investigated the genomic diversity, predicted serotype distribution, and antimicrobial susceptibility of T. maritimum isolates recovered from Croatian marine fish farms. Eight isolates obtained from European seabass (Dicentrarchus labrax) fry and Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) were characterized using whole-genome sequencing, multilocus sequence typing (MLST), phylogenetic and pangenome analyses, O-antigen gene cluster (O-AGC) typing, phenotypic antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and in silico screening for resistance and virulence-associated genes. The isolates showed high genomic similarity with average nucleotide identity (ANI) values exceeding >99%. MLST identified six sequence types, four of which were novel. O-AGC typing identified two predicted serotypes, with O3 predominating (6/8 isolates) and O2 detected in the remaining two. Phenotypic antimicrobial susceptibility testing revealed generally low minimum inhibitory concentrations (MICs) for most antimicrobials. However, all isolates exhibited reduced susceptibility to gentamicin, as indicated by elevated MICs and consistently small inhibition zones. Resistome analysis identified a limited repertoire of conserved resistance-associated homologs with no evidence of widespread acquired antimicrobial resistance determinants among the isolates examined. Virulence-associated homologs, including those encoding Type VI secretion system-related proteins, were highly conserved. These findings provide an initial genomic and phenotypic characterization of T. maritimum isolates from Croatian marine aquaculture and establish a basis for further investigations involving larger and more representative isolate collections.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究对克罗地亚海水养殖中分离的8株Tenacibaculum maritimum（来源于欧洲舌齿鲈幼鱼和大西洋鲑）进行了全基因组测序、MLST、系统发育与泛基因组分析、O-抗原基因簇分型、表型药敏试验及耐药与毒力基因的in silico筛查。分离株基因组高度相似（ANI>99%），MLST鉴定出6个序列型（4个为新序列型），O-AGC分型预测出O3（6/8）和O2两种血清型。所有菌株对庆大霉素敏感性降低（MIC升高、抑菌圈偏小），但未发现广泛获得的耐药决定因子，毒力相关同源基因（包括Type VI secretion system相关基因）高度保守。

papers.title: Using brewing industry byproducts to create feed additives for aquaculture-raised rainbow trout under thermal stress
papers.authors: Layton, Anna Rayne; Pough II, Jason D.; Kuhn, David D.; Stevens, Ann M.
papers.abstract: The aquaculture industry helps meet the seafood demands of a rapidly growing human population. The goal of this study was to determine the effects of feed additives, generated from byproducts of the beer brewing industry, on the growth rate, production parameters, and intestinal bacterial composition of aquaculture-raised rainbow trout ( Oncorhynchus mykiss ). Two prevalent brewery byproducts, brewer’s spent yeast (BSY) and brewer’s spent grain (BSG), were converted into high-value fish feed additives. To increase nutritional value of the byproducts, BSY was treated with exoenzymes, and BSG was used to cultivate black soldier fly (BSF; Hermetia illucens ) larvae, which was treated with proprietary chitinases. During a seven-week trial using a recirculating aquaculture system, 22.15 ± 0.24 g (mean ± standard error) fish were randomly separated with 12 fish/tank in quadruplicate for each of the six diets (48 fish per diet), and tanks were randomly assigned diets. Survival rates were recorded daily, and fish were weighed every two weeks to track growth rates, adjust feed amounts, and calculate feed efficiency at the tank level. Fish intestinal mucosa swabs were collected at the beginning and end of the trial to analyze changes in the bacterial communities. Due to a malfunction in the chiller that maintained cool water temperatures, temperature and dissolved oxygen became substantial chronic (two week) and then acute (12–24 hr) stress factors near the end of the trial. Therefore, the research focus shifted to understand the impacts of thermal and oxygen stress on fish fed these novel feed additives. Clear changes in the structure of the bacterial intestinal community were observed in the fish between the start and end of the study as evaluated by 16S rRNA gene analysis. Results suggest that fish fed three of the experimental diets benefitted by having higher survival rates and growth rates when subjected to the unplanned stress.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用啤酒酿造副产物开发水产饲料添加剂，包括经外酶处理的啤酒废酵母（BSY）和以啤酒废谷物（BSG）培养并经几丁质酶处理的黑水虻（BSF）幼虫，评估其对养殖虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）生长及肠道菌群的影响。7周循环水养殖试验中，因冷水机组故障导致试验后期出现持续两周的慢性及12–24小时的急性温度和溶氧胁迫，研究重点随之转向热胁迫下饲料添加剂的效果。16S rRNA基因分析显示鱼体肠道菌群结构在试验前后发生明显变化，三种试验饲料组在非计划胁迫下表现出更高的存活率和生长率。

papers.title: Review and Outlook for Aquaculture of Ornate Spiny Lobster (Panulirus ornatus)
papers.authors: Mai, Qianlin; Zhou, Falin; Zhang, Dianchang; Li, Erchao; Li, Yundong
papers.abstract: Panulirus ornatus is a high-value seafood species of the Indo-West Pacific. Anthropogenic pressures since the mid-20th century have led to noticeable declines in wild populations, prompting China to enact protective legislation, while other countries focus on aquaculture and germplasm research to sustain supply and preserve wild populations. Current practices rely on rearing wild-caught post-pueruli in sea net cages, as full-life-cycle commercial breeding faces challenges, high mortality of phyllosoma, poorly understood nutritional needs, and uncertain environmental factors. Juvenile cannibalism during moulting further hinders high-density culture, requiring advanced management to reduce aggression. This review synthesizes progress in P. ornatus aquaculture since 2000, covering germplasm resources, reproduction, larval development, artificial diets, culture techniques, and disease management. It discusses major constraints such as inadequate nutrient profiles for phyllosoma and ineffective cannibalism control for post-pueruli, which limit scalable breeding. The review identifies critical knowledge gaps, proposes research priorities, focusing on nutritional and artificial environment optimization, and underscores the need for technology to advance full-life-cycle breeding. These efforts are vital for sustainable P. ornatus aquaculture to meet global demand while conserving wild stocks.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了锦绣龙虾（Panulirus ornatus）养殖的研究进展与发展方向。由于野生种群下降，当前养殖依赖捕获的野生后期叶状幼体（post-pueruli）进行海网箱养殖，全生命周期商业化繁育仍受叶状幼体高死亡率、营养需求不清及环境因子不确定等因素制约，蜕壳期同类相残亦限制高密度养殖。文章系统梳理了2000年以来在种质资源、繁殖、幼体发育、人工饲料、养殖技术和疾病管理等方面的进展，指出叶状幼体营养配方不足和后期幼体相残控制不力是规模化繁育的主要瓶颈，并提出以营养优化和人工环境调控为重点的研究优先方向，强调推进全生命周期繁育技术对可持续养殖和野生种群保护的重要意义。

papers.title: First record of aurantiactinomyxon and saccimyxon type actinosporean stages of fish ınfecting myxozoan parasites (cnidaria) through morphological and molecular ıdentifications in Türkiye
papers.authors: Okkay, Sevilay; Aksan, Serdar; Gürkanlı, Cem Tolga; Çiftçi, Yılmaz; Ergül, Halim Aytekin; Özer, Ahmet
papers.summary_cn: 该研究首次在土耳其报道了感染鱼类的黏体动物（刺胞动物门）生活史中的aurantiactinomyxon与saccimyxon型放线孢子阶段，采用形态学与分子鉴定方法进行确认。

papers.title: Value Addition of Croaker (Johnius dussumieri) through Development of Ready-to-Cook Fish Fingers and Evaluation of Their Frozen Storage Stability
papers.authors: Jena, Geetanjali; Sahu, Brundaban; Roul, Chandan; Das, Nityananda; Choudhury, Dharitri; Pati, B. K.; Patro, Suryamani; Priyadarshini, Pooja
papers.journal: Journal of Advances in Biology & Biotechnology
papers.abstract: The utilisation of relatively less-preferred fish species through value-added processing can improve resource utilisation while providing convenient fish-based foods. The present study was undertaken to develop ready-to-cook frozen fish fingers from croaker (Johnius dussumieri) and evaluate their quality during prolonged frozen storage. Fresh croakers were procured from a local market, manually deboned and minced, followed by seasoning with pre-standardised ingredients, steam cooking, shaping, battering and breading. The prepared fish fingers were packed in food-grade polyethylene pouches and stored at −20°C for 180 days. Samples were evaluated at 30-day intervals for proximate composition, total volatile base nitrogen (TVBN), peroxide value (PV), free fatty acids (FFA), total plate count (TPC) and sensory characteristics to assess their frozen storage stability. Fresh croaker had 74.63% moisture, 17.29% crude protein, 6.46% crude fat and 1.08% ash; while such parameters for raw fish fingers were 58.23%, 18.06%, 6.13% and 1.50%, respectively. During frozen storage, the moisture content of the fingers decreased to 52.11%; whereas the apparent crude protein, fat and ash contents increased to 17.35, 9.07 and 1.81%, respectively. TVBN increased progressively from 4.28 to 10.47 mg/100 g, while PV increased from 3.16 to 6.33 mmol O2/kg fat and FFA from 3.33 to 9.56% of total lipid as oleic acid, indicating gradual biochemical and lipid deterioration during frozen storage. The TPC showed an initial increase followed by a marked decline during prolonged frozen storage. Sensory quality gradually decreased with storage, but overall acceptability remained at 4.0 on a five-point hedonic scale after 180 days. The findings demonstrate that croaker, a less preferred marine fish, can be effectively converted into value-added ready-to-cook frozen fish fingers that maintained acceptable nutritional, microbiological and sensory quality throughout six months of storage at −20°C. The study provides a practical approach for improving the utilisation and marketing of a relatively less-preferred marine fish through value addition.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以低偏好性海鱼白姑鱼（Johnius dussumieri）为原料，经去骨、绞碎、调味、蒸煮、裹糊裹粉等工序开发即烹冷冻鱼柳，并对其在−20°C下180天的冻藏稳定性进行评价。冻藏期间TVBN由4.28升至10.47 mg/100 g，PV由3.16升至6.33 mmol O₂/kg脂肪，FFA由3.33%升至9.56%（以油酸计），水分下降而表观蛋白、脂肪和灰分升高，TPC先升后降，感官评分逐渐降低但180天后总体可接受性仍达5分制中的4.0。结果表明白姑鱼可有效转化为附加值较高的即烹冷冻鱼柳，在6个月冻藏期内保持可接受的营养、微生物和感官品质，为低偏好性海鱼的增值利用提供了实用途径。

papers.title: Repurposed smart tuna-fishing buoys provide real-time intelligence for marine conservation and ocean observation
papers.authors: Lebrato, Mario; Gavira-O’Neill, Kathryn; Losada-Ros, Maria Teresa; Murie, Calum; Nhamussua, Nelson; da Graça, Maria; Jije-Gonçalves, Mauro; Kalashnikova, Ekaterina; Bravo, Alvaro
papers.abstract: Abstract End-of-use echosounder buoys developed for industrial tuna fishing offer a largely untapped opportunity to expand ocean monitoring using existing fisheries technology. Here we present a technology-transfer and pilot feasibility study testing whether repurposed smart-buoys can operate as short-term autonomous platforms for marine conservation monitoring and ocean observation. Through Satlink project ReCon, refurbished buoys were deployed in fixed-point and drifting configurations across one shelf technical test area, two coral reefs, and two seamount/pinnacle systems in the Western Indian Ocean (WIO) region (Bazaruto Archipelago, Mozambique). Fixed-point acoustic record spans ranged from 51.5 to 96.2 h per site. Across fixed-point and drifting configurations, the exported dataset contained 393 time-stamped acoustic records and 1,281 depth-layer relative acoustic biomass/backscatter observations, with buoy position and acoustic data transmitted by satellite (via INMARSAT) to shore-based systems. Integration with the long-term BCSS Ocean Observatory time-series provided concurrent weather and oceanographic context across > 20 in-situ variables, while scuba-based megafauna surveys recorded 14–20 megafauna taxa per site as biological context for the acoustic records. The pilot time-series captured consistent diel structure, with 20–40% higher nocturnal relative acoustic biomass/backscatter values, alongside exploratory temporal co-occurrences with cooler bottom-water pulses, transient chlorophyll-a increases, and site-level differences in megafauna assemblage structure. While these short time-series cannot be used to infer ecological baselines, reef health, fishing impacts, environmental drivers, or absolute biological biomass, they demonstrate the capacity of repurposed smart-buoys to generate high-frequency acoustic and contextual ecological information in data-poor and remote marine regions. Our study establishes a practical pathway for integrating recovered fishing infrastructure into marine observatories, while highlighting the need for longer deployments, broader replication, quantitative habitat characterization, and independent biological calibration before robust ecological inference can be made.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在评估将工业金枪鱼捕捞淘汰的 echosounder 浮标改造为海洋保护监测与海洋观测自主平台的可行性。通过 Satlink ReCon 项目，翻新浮标以固定点和漂流方式部署于西印度洋莫桑比克 Bazaruto 群岛的陆架试区、珊瑚礁及海山系统，获取了393条声学记录和1,281条深度层相对声学生物量/回散射观测，并经卫星传输至岸基系统。试点数据呈现一致的昼夜节律，夜间相对声学生物量/回散射值高出20–40%，并与冷水脉冲、叶绿素-a 瞬时升高及大型动物群落结构站点差异存在探索性时间共现。短时序数据尚不足以推断生态基线或渔业影响，但证明了改造智能浮标在数据匮乏的偏远海域生成高频声学与生态背景信息的能力。

papers.title: Effect of ultrasound-assisted extraction on the physicochemical and structural properties of red seaweed (Porphyra haitanensis) protein
papers.authors: Thirawattanavong, Thitipa; Geng, Jie-Ting; Osako, Kazufumi
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨超声辅助提取对坛紫菜（Porphyra haitanensis）蛋白理化及结构性质的影响，摘要缺失，具体方法、结果与结论无法获知。

papers.title:
Comparison of
                    <scp>EBER</scp>
                    flow
                    <scp>FISH</scp>
                    results from two facilities
papers.authors: Nishimura, Madoka; Tomomasa, Dan; Watanabe, Eri; Tsuchiya, Kazumi; Sato, Natsuko; Takachi, Takayuki; Imai, Kohsuke; Akiyama, Hiroki; Ueki, Masahiro; Yoshifuji, Kota
papers.abstract: Abstract Epstein–Barr virus (EBV) primarily infects B cells but can occasionally target T and/or NK cells, leading to chronic active EBV disease or EBV‐associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, which are often difficult to treat. EBV‐associated diseases exhibit a wide range of phenotypes. EBV‐infected cells play a major role in pathogenesis, making their identification essential for diagnosis. EBV‐encoded small RNA (EBER) flow fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH), combined with multicolor flow cytometry, allows highly sensitive detection of EBV‐infected cells, even from limited samples. However, EBER flow FISH is labor‐intensive and requires technical expertise, limiting its use in standard facilities. We investigated whether the technique used in our department could be successfully implemented in other facilities. We performed EBER flow FISH at our department (Facility A) on cryopreserved peripheral blood mononuclear cell samples from seven patients diagnosed with EBV‐associated diseases. The same assay was then conducted at Facility B, and results were compared for cell populations and the frequency of EBER‐positive cells within each population. Significant correlations were observed between facilities for both cell fraction proportions and the proportion of EBER‐positive cells. Among data points where both facilities detected ≥5% EBER‐positive cells, 6 of 8 data points (75%) were within the acceptance interval of ±20%. Although one patient with very low proportions of EBER‐positive cells showed inconsistent findings, overall results did not differ significantly between facilities. Although further validation in larger multicenter studies is required, these findings suggest preliminary interlaboratory comparability and support the potential transferability of EBER flow FISH across institutions.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究比较了两个实验室开展EBER flow FISH检测EBV感染细胞的结果一致性，以评估该技术在不同机构间推广的可行性。研究对7例EBV相关疾病患者的冻存外周血单个核细胞样本在A、B两个实验室分别进行EBER flow FISH检测，比较各细胞亚群比例及EBER阳性细胞频率。结果显示两机构间细胞组分比例及EBER阳性细胞比例均呈显著相关，在双方均检出≥5% EBER阳性细胞的8个数据点中有6个（75%）落在±20%的可接受区间内。尽管1例EBER阳性细胞比例极低的患者结果不一致，总体结果无显著差异，提示该技术具有初步的实验室间可比性和跨机构转移潜力。

papers.title: Corrigendum to “Drivers of bull shark (Carcharhinus leucas) occurrence in nearshore waters: Insights from the Queensland Shark Control Program, Australia” [Fish. Res. 303 (2026) 107882]

papers.authors: Fei, Xintong; Xie, Xinyi; Tarique, Imran; Liu, Xiuhong; Fang, Xingxing; Yang, Ping

papers.title: Publicly available neural network services in fisheries research: applications and limitations
papers.authors: Fedoseeva, E. A.; Sitova, M. V.; Terpugova, N. Yu.
papers.abstract: The potential of publicly available neural network services for fisheries research is considered. Using the authors’ research materials, their application for information retrieval and systematization, verification of source tables, calculations, data visualization, and preliminary analysis of histological images is demonstrated. The most reliable applications are those whose results can be directly verified against the source data. As tasks shift towards biological interpretation, expert assessment and verification of the generated conclusions become increasingly important.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨了公开可用神经网络服务在渔业研究中的应用潜力与局限。基于作者自身研究材料，展示了其在信息检索与系统化、源表格核验、计算、数据可视化及组织学图像初步分析中的实际应用。结果表明，结果可直接对照源数据验证的应用最为可靠；随着任务向生物学解释层面延伸，专家评估与对生成结论的核验愈发重要。

papers.title: Web-based Direct-to-Consumer Marketplace for Small-Scale Fisheries Products: Rapid Application Development and Functional Evaluation in Jaring Halus Village, Langkat, Indonesia
papers.authors: Supiyandi, Supiyandi; Mailok, Ramlah Binti; Herdianto, Herdianto
papers.journal: International Journal of Engineering, Science and Information Technology
papers.abstract: Fishery and micro-enterprise products in Jaring Halus Village, Langkat Regency, Indonesia, are sold primarily within the village through face-to-face transactions and manual record keeping. This condition limits producers’ market reach to physically present consumers and provides no persistent transaction data for monitoring or business development. Previous studies on digital technology in small-scale fisheries have focused largely on catch recording and traceability, while applied marketplace development studies rarely describe their evaluation scope with sufficient precision to support replication. This study designs, develops, and functionally evaluates a web-based direct-to-consumer marketplace to address this gap. The system was developed using the Rapid Application Development model, with requirements elicited from fishers, sellers, and prospective buyers through interviews and observations, followed by public deployment. The marketplace integrates account management, product catalogue administration with stock and discount attributes, shopping cart and order management, delegated electronic payment settlement, and content management. Functional performance was evaluated using black-box testing across eight interface areas involving seventeen test cases. All test cases produced results consistent with their specified requirements. Partition analysis showed that eleven test cases exercised valid input classes, while six addressed invalid input classes. Four interface areas contained no invalid-input test cases, and the content-management module was not covered by the testing process. The study contributes a transferable reference architecture for direct-to-consumer fisheries marketplaces in low-connectivity rural environments, a traceable requirement-to-test structure, and prioritized recommendations based on identified testing gaps. The evidence is limited to functional conformance; therefore, usability, technology acceptance, user satisfaction, and economic outcomes were not measured and are not claimed. The findings provide a foundation for subsequent evaluation and iterative improvement of digital marketplaces for rural fishery micro-enterprises
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对印度尼西亚Langkat县Jaring Halus村小规模渔业产品仅限村内面对面交易、缺乏交易数据的问题，采用Rapid Application Development模型，基于渔民、卖家和潜在买家的需求设计并开发了一个面向消费者的渔业产品直销网络市场平台，集成账户管理、产品目录与库存管理、购物车与订单管理、电子支付结算及内容管理等功能。通过覆盖8个界面区域、17个测试用例的黑盒测试进行功能评估，所有用例结果均符合既定需求，但4个界面区域缺少无效输入测试用例，内容管理模块未被测试覆盖。研究为低连通性农村环境下的渔业直销市场提供了可迁移的参考架构和可追溯的需求—测试结构，但评估仅限于功能符合性，未涉及可用性、技术接受度及经济效果。

papers.title: Emerging Artificial Intelligence Applications in Capture Fisheries Monitoring and Assessment: A Bibliometric and Synthesis Review
papers.authors: Patangngari, Fijwal; Musbir, Musbir; Najamuddin; Putra, Chi
papers.journal: New Zealand Journal of Marine and Freshwater Research
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used to monitor and assess capture fisheries, addressing persistent limitations of conventional observation systems that are labor‐intensive, costly, and difficult to scale. Despite rapid technological expansion, AI development in this field remains fragmented, limiting a comprehensive understanding of its structure and direction. This study aimed to map the development, intellectual structure, and thematic evolution of AI research in capture fisheries monitoring and assessment through a bibliometric and synthesis‐based review of Scopus‐indexed literature (2015–2026). Following a documented, large language model‐assisted screening protocol with human verification, a final corpus of 495 journal articles was analyzed using an integrated bibliometric and science‐mapping workflow. Results showed a marked, near‐exponential increase in publication output after 2020. Rather than confirming a pre‐defined three‐domain structure, keyword co‐occurrence analysis revealed that the field's thematic organization follows technical task type (detection, classification, and operational/vessel management) more closely than application domain, with acoustic AI failing to form an independent thematic cluster and representing the smallest share of the corpus (8.1%), behind visual AI (44.0%) and vessel monitoring (28.9%). For synthesis, we nonetheless compare the field across three functional categories visual AI for fish detection and measurement, vessel monitoring using AIS/VMS data, and acoustic survey support finding that the field is methodologically converging around a shared AI/ML toolkit while remaining largely siloed at the technical‐application level. Although research productivity remains heavily concentrated in China (85.9% of records) and international collaboration is limited (23.64%), the field is moving beyond isolated proof‐of‐concept studies toward more operational, management‐relevant applications. Overall, this study provides an evidence‐grounded, rather than assumed, understanding of how AI research in capture fisheries is thematically structured, and identifies acoustic AI and cross‐domain integration as priority areas for future development toward fisheries‐oriented, evidence‐based management.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究通过文献计量与综述方法，基于Scopus数据库2015–2026年495篇期刊论文，绘制了AI在捕捞渔业监测与评估中的研究结构与发展脉络。结果显示2020年后发文量近指数增长，主题组织更倾向于按技术任务类型（检测、分类、运营/船舶管理）而非应用领域划分，声学AI未形成独立主题簇且占比最小（8.1%），远低于视觉AI（44.0%）和船舶监测（28.9%）。研究在方法上趋于共享AI/ML工具集，但技术-应用层面仍呈孤岛状态，且研究产出高度集中于中国（85.9%），国际合作有限（23.64%）。该研究为理解AI在捕捞渔业中的主题结构提供了循证基础，并指出声学AI与跨领域整合为未来优先发展方向。

papers.title: Problems and prospects of ensuring Russia’s food security by means of fisheries
papers.authors: Vasiliev, A. M.; Lisunova, E. A.
